The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in a brake pressure sensor. Pressure information is used by ESP and brake assist to determine driver intent and modulation pressure during regulation.
The ABS warning lamp control circuit is shorted or open. The driver may see a permanently lit or non-functional ABS warning lamp.

d.en: The PWM control of the brake pressure modulation valves is faulty.

The ABS control module has detected that the frequency of one wheel speed sensor signal does not match the others under stable driving conditions. This often indicates a tone ring with extra or missing teeth or a sensor with degraded signal quality.
Internal plausibility check of the combined ABS/TCS control module fails.

The power steering control module has detected an implausible pressure or load signal from the steering pump. On hydraulic systems this may indicate low fluid or a worn pump; on electric systems it may indicate excessive motor load.
The pump motor ground return is open. The motor cannot run, and the system disables ABS and stability control.

The brake booster vacuum sensor reports an implausible signal; brake assist functions are reduced. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

The Electronic Brake Control Module has detected a fault in its main supply relay circuit. Without proper relay supply the EBCM cannot operate the hydraulic unit and ABS as well as stability control are disabled.

The brake control module has detected a fault in the active (electric or vacuum-controlled) brake booster. Active boosters are used by emergency brake assist and adaptive cruise control to autonomously build brake pressure.

The ABS or brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the brake pump motor circuit. The pump is used to build brake pressure during ABS, ESP and brake-by-wire operations and a fault disables these functions.

The brake control module has detected that the brake pump has run longer than the allowed maximum time. This typically indicates the pump cannot reach target pressure due to a hydraulic leak, air in the system or a worn pump.

The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the vacuum sensor on the brake booster. Modern systems monitor booster vacuum to ensure brake assist is available, especially with stop-start engines and electric vacuum pumps.

C066D.ru: Датчик давления в камере рабочего/стояночного тормоза

d.en: Generic fault on service/park brake chamber pressure sensor — used on air-brake systems with combined service and spring-applied parking brake chamber.

C066E.en: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too High
C066E.ru: Давление в камере рабочего/стояночного тормоза — слишком высокое

d.en: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber exceeded safe limit.

C066F.en: Service/Park Brake Chamber Pressure Too Low
C066F.ru: Давление в камере рабочего/стояночного тормоза — слишком низкое

d.en: Pressure in the service/park brake chamber dropped below required minimum — risk of insufficient braking force.

C0670.en: Electric Park Brake Actuator Left Circuit
C0670.ru: Привод электронного стояночного тормоза, левый — цепь

d.en: The left electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0671.en: Electric Park Brake Actuator Right Circuit
C0671.ru: Привод электронного стояночного тормоза, правый — цепь

d.en: The right electric park brake caliper actuator does not respond as commanded.

C0680.en: Electric Park Brake Module Internal Fault
C0680.ru: Блок электронного стояночного тормоза — внутренняя неисправность

d.en: The EPB control module fails its internal self-test and the park brake function may be limited.

C0700.ru: Связь с блоком активного рулевого управления

d.en: A communication fault between the chassis control module and the active steering module has been detected. Active steering varies the steering ratio with speed, and a fault disables this assistance and may store secondary codes in other modules.

The chassis or stability control module has received an invalid or missing steering position signal — often via the communication bus from the steering control module. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited.

C0712.ru: Датчик положения рулевого управления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The power steering control module has detected that the rack or column position signal is out of range or implausible. Steering assist may be reduced.

C0715.ru: Датчик давления усилителя руля — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The power steering module has detected that the hydraulic pressure sensor signal is out of range — relevant for hydraulic and electro-hydraulic systems. Assist regulation may run in fallback mode.

C0720.en: Electric Power Steering Torque Sensor Circuit

d.en: The torque sensor in the EPS column or rack reports an electrical fault. Power assist is reduced or disabled.
The EPS assist motor circuit reports an electrical fault.

The chassis or trailer brake module has detected a fault in the trailer wiring connector — for example open lighting circuit or short to ground. Trailer brake and lighting functions may be unavailable.

C0730.en: Electric Power Steering Motor Position Sensor Circuit
C0730.ru: Датчик положения мотора электроусилителя руля — цепь

d.en: The EPS motor position sensor (resolver/Hall) reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0735.en: Electric Power Steering Module Internal Fault

d.en: The EPS control module fails its internal self-test. Power assist is disabled.
The supply voltage to the EPS module is out of range, reducing or disabling power assist.
The EPS module has reduced or disabled assistance to protect the motor from overheating, typically after extended low-speed manoeuvring.

The cruise control or chassis module has detected an implausible signal from the dedicated cruise control brake switch. This switch is independent from the stop lamp switch and disengages cruise control when the driver brakes.

C0784.en: Trailer Brake Force Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0784.ru: Датчик тормозного усилия прицепа — неисправность цепи

d.en: The integrated trailer brake controller has detected an electrical fault in the brake force sensor circuit. Proportional trailer brake control is disabled — the controller defaults to a manual or fixed-gain mode.

The chassis control module has detected that the supply voltage is below the operating threshold required for ABS, ESP or steering systems. Many chassis functions are limited or disabled until the voltage returns to a normal range.

The chassis or stability control module reports that the steering angle sensor has not been calibrated or that the calibration data has been lost. ESP requires a calibrated zero position and is disabled until calibration is performed.
The air suspension compressor motor circuit reports an electrical fault. Levelling is disabled.
The air suspension compressor has been disabled to protect against overheating, typically after a slow leak.

C0820.en: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Left
C0820.ru: Датчик высоты пневмоподвески переднего левого колеса

d.en: The front left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0821.en: Air Suspension Height Sensor Front Right
C0821.ru: Датчик высоты пневмоподвески переднего правого колеса

d.en: The front right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0822.en: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Left
C0822.ru: Датчик высоты пневмоподвески заднего левого колеса

d.en: The rear left ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0823.en: Air Suspension Height Sensor Rear Right
C0823.ru: Датчик высоты пневмоподвески заднего правого колеса

d.en: The rear right ride height sensor reports an implausible or missing signal.

C0825.ru: Датчик усилия на руле — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The electric power steering module has detected that the torque (effort) sensor signal is out of the expected range. Steering assist is reduced or disabled.
The power steering module has detected that the torque sensor signal does not change despite steering input — the sensor appears stuck. Assist is disabled to avoid uncontrolled steering torque.

C0830.en: Steering Wheel Angle Sensor Center Position Not Learned
C0830.ru: Датчик угла поворота руля — центральное положение не обучено

d.en: The chassis control module has not stored a valid center (zero) position for the steering wheel angle sensor. ESP, lane assist and electric power steering may be limited until calibration is performed.
One of the level control solenoid valves reports an electrical fault. The corresponding axle cannot be levelled.
The front left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.
The front right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.
The rear left adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.
The rear right adjustable damper reports an electrical fault.
The trailer stability assist function detects implausible trailer sway response or sensor input.

C0870.en: Adaptive Cruise Control Brake Request Performance

d.en: A brake request from adaptive cruise control or AEB cannot be executed within the expected response time.
TPMS Sensor 1 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.
The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 1 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.
TPMS Sensor 2 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.
The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 2 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.
The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 3 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.
The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 4 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.
The body or chassis module has detected a fault in the TPMS RF receiver — for example open antenna or internal failure. No tire pressure data can be received.
The TPMS module has detected an electrical fault in the front low-frequency initiator (used to wake and locate sensors). Position learning of the front sensors fails.

C0915.en: Active Roll Stabilisation Front Actuator Circuit
C0915.ru: Привод активной стабилизации крена спереди — цепь

d.en: The front active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

C0916.en: Active Roll Stabilisation Rear Actuator Circuit
C0916.ru: Привод активной стабилизации крена сзади — цепь

d.en: The rear active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.
The suspension control module fails its internal self-test. Adaptive damping or air suspension is disabled.

C0950.en: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Left
C0950.ru: Датчик давления в шине переднего левого колеса

d.en: The TPMS sensor at the front left wheel does not transmit a valid signal. Indirect TPMS variants raise this when the wheel-speed-based estimation fails for that wheel.

C0951.en: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Right
C0951.ru: Датчик давления в шине переднего правого колеса

d.en: The TPMS sensor at the front right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0952.en: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Left
C0952.ru: Датчик давления в шине заднего левого колеса

d.en: The TPMS sensor at the rear left wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0953.en: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Right
C0953.ru: Датчик давления в шине заднего правого колеса

d.en: The TPMS sensor at the rear right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0960.en: Tire Pressure Monitoring Module Internal Fault
C0960.ru: Модуль контроля давления в шинах — внутренняя неисправность

d.en: The tire pressure monitoring module fails its internal self-test.

P0001.en: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit/Open
P0001.ru: Регулятор объёма топлива A, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The ECU detects an open circuit in the control of fuel volume regulator A (often the metering valve on the high-pressure fuel pump). The actuator does not respond, so rail pressure cannot be controlled accurately.

P0002.en: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit Range/Performance
P0002.ru: Регулятор объёма топлива A, цепь управления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The control signal of fuel volume regulator A is electrically present but the actual rail pressure does not follow the target value within tolerance. Indicates a mechanical or hydraulic issue rather than pure wiring.

P0003.en: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit Low
P0003.ru: Регулятор объёма топлива A, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The ECU sees the control voltage of fuel volume regulator A pulled below the expected range, typically a short to ground or a low-resistance fault in the wiring or coil.

P0004.en: Fuel Volume Regulator A Control Circuit High
P0004.ru: Регулятор объёма топлива A, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: The ECU sees the control voltage of fuel volume regulator A above the expected range, typically a short to power or open ground return.

P0005.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit/Open
P0005.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива A, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: Open circuit detected at the fuel shutoff valve A solenoid (used on diesels to stop fuel flow at engine-off and as anti-theft). Engine may not start or not stop cleanly.

P0006.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit Low
P0006.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива A, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Control voltage of fuel shutoff valve A is below the expected range, typically caused by a short to ground or low-resistance fault in the solenoid circuit.

P0007.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve A Control Circuit High
P0007.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива A, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Control voltage of fuel shutoff valve A is above the expected range, typically caused by a short to power or open ground return.
The ECU detects an implausible relationship between crankshaft and camshaft signals on bank 1, indicating timing chain stretch, jumped tooth, or sensor reluctor wear.
Same fault pattern as P0008 but on bank 2 of a V or boxer engine. Crank/cam correlation outside spec on the second cylinder bank.

P000A.en: A Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 1

d.en: The intake camshaft phaser on bank 1 responds too slowly to commanded position changes. Often caused by VVT solenoid sticking, oil aging, or low oil pressure.

P000B.en: B Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 1

d.en: The exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 1 responds too slowly to commanded position changes. Same root causes as P000A but on the exhaust cam.

P000C.en: A Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 2

d.en: Intake camshaft phaser on bank 2 responds too slowly. Same fault pattern as P000A on the second cylinder bank.

P000D.en: B Camshaft Position Slow Response Bank 2

d.en: Exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 2 responds too slowly. Same fault pattern as P000B on the second cylinder bank.

P000E.en: Fuel Volume Regulator Control Exceeded Learning Limit
P000E.ru: Регулятор объёма топлива — превышен предел обучения

d.en: The ECU's adaptive correction of fuel volume regulator A has reached its learning limit. Indicates a long-term drift between commanded and actual rail pressure that could no longer be compensated.

P000F.en: Fuel System Over Pressure Relief Valve Activated
P000F.ru: Сработал предохранительный клапан избыточного давления топливной системы

d.en: The mechanical pressure relief valve on the fuel rail has opened due to overpressure. Indicates a malfunction of the rail pressure regulation that drove pressure beyond the safe limit.

An electrical fault in the bank 1 intake camshaft position actuator solenoid (variable valve timing). The ECU monitors current and feedback on the oil control valve and sets this code when the circuit is open, shorted, or out of range.

P0011.en: "A" Camshaft Position - Timing Over-Advanced or System Performance (Bank 1)
P0011.ru: Распредвал "A" — чрезмерное опережение или характеристика системы, банк 1

d.en: The bank 1 intake camshaft is more advanced than commanded, or the actuator does not respond as expected. Often caused by stuck-open oil control valves, sludge in VVT passages, or low oil pressure.
The bank 1 intake camshaft remains retarded compared to commanded position. Common causes include a stuck-closed oil control valve, blocked oil passages, or a worn cam phaser.
Electrical fault in the bank 1 exhaust camshaft position actuator solenoid. Same diagnostic principle as P0010 but on the exhaust cam.

Exhaust camshaft position bank 1 over-advanced or system performance — the actual cam phase exceeds the commanded value. Usually caused by a stuck-open oil control valve, low oil pressure, sludged passages, or a worn cam phaser. Confirm with a scan tool live data: command 0° advance and watch actual.
The bank 1 exhaust camshaft remains retarded relative to commanded position. Same root causes as P0012 but on the exhaust cam.

P0016.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor A)
P0016.ru: Положение коленвала / положение распредвала — рассогласование (банк 1, датчик A)

d.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor A): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.

P0017.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B)
P0017.ru: Положение коленвала / положение распредвала — рассогласование (банк 1, датчик B)

d.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 1 Sensor B): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.

P0018.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor A)
P0018.ru: Положение коленвала / положение распредвала — рассогласование (банк 2, датчик A)

d.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor A): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.

P0019.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor B)
P0019.ru: Положение коленвала / положение распредвала — рассогласование (банк 2, датчик B)

d.en: Crankshaft Position - Camshaft Position Correlation (Bank 2 Sensor B): the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.

P001A.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 1
P001A.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 1

d.en: Open circuit at the camshaft profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Used by systems with discrete cam-lift levels (e.g. BMW Valvetronic, Honda VTEC, Audi AVS) — the actuator that selects the lift profile cannot be driven.

P001B.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P001B.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Low control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Typically a short to ground in the wiring or actuator coil.

P001C.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 1
P001C.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Excessively high control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 1). Typically a short to power or open ground.

P001D.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 2
P001D.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 2

d.en: Open circuit at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001A but on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

P001E.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 2
P001E.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Low control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001B on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

P001F.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 2
P001F.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Excessively high control voltage at the cam profile actuator (intake, profile A, bank 2). Same fault as P001C on bank 2. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.
Electrical fault in the bank 2 intake camshaft position actuator. Same diagnostic principle as P0010 but on the second cylinder bank.
The bank 2 intake camshaft is more advanced than commanded, or the actuator does not respond as expected. Often caused by stuck-open oil control valves, sludge in VVT passages, or low oil pressure.
The bank 2 intake camshaft remains retarded compared to commanded position. Common causes include a stuck-closed oil control valve, blocked oil passages, or a worn cam phaser.
Electrical fault in the bank 2 exhaust camshaft position actuator. Same diagnostic principle as P0013 but on the second cylinder bank.
The bank 2 exhaust camshaft is more advanced than commanded. Same root causes as P0011 but on the exhaust cam.
The bank 2 exhaust camshaft remains retarded relative to commanded position. Same root causes as P0012 but on the exhaust cam.

P0026.en: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
P0026.ru: Соленоид управления впускными клапанами, банк 1 — вне диапазона

d.en: The ECU detected that the bank 1 intake valve oil control solenoid does not respond as expected. Common causes are sludge in the oil passages, a sticking solenoid, or low oil pressure that prevents proper VVT phasing on the intake side.

P0027.en: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1
P0027.ru: Соленоид управления клапанами выпуска, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 1

d.en: The ECU detects that the exhaust camshaft oil control valve on bank 1 does not respond to commanded duty cycle within expected limits. Camshaft phase deviates from target during phaser actuation tests.

P0028.en: Intake Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2)
P0028.ru: Соленоид управления впускными клапанами, банк 2 — вне диапазона

d.en: The ECU detected that the bank 2 intake valve oil control solenoid does not respond as expected. Common causes are sludge in the oil passages, a sticking solenoid, or low oil pressure that prevents proper VVT phasing on the intake side.

P0029.en: Exhaust Valve Control Solenoid Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2
P0029.ru: Соленоид управления клапанами выпуска, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 2

d.en: The ECU detects that the exhaust camshaft oil control valve on bank 2 does not respond to commanded duty cycle within expected limits. Camshaft phase deviates from target during phaser actuation tests.

P002A.en: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit/Open Bank 1
P002A.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала B — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 1

d.en: Open circuit at the cam profile actuator on the exhaust cam (profile A, bank 1). Same diagnosis as P001A but for the exhaust profile actuator.

P002B.en: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit Low Bank 1

P002F.en: B Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Circuit High Bank 2

P0036.ru: Подогрев датчика O2 Б1Д2 — цепь управления

P0039.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve A Control Circuit Range/Performance

P003B.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Position Exceeded Learning Limit

d.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Position Exceeded Learning Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.

P003D.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Stuck On Bank 1
P003D.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — управление, заклинил включённым, банк 1

d.en: The intake cam profile actuator (profile A, bank 1) stays engaged when commanded off — stuck in high-lift profile. Idle quality and emissions affected.

P003E.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Performance/Stuck Off Bank 2
P003E.ru: Привод A профиля распредвала A — управление, характеристика / заклинил выключенным, банк 2

P003F.en: A Camshaft Profile Actuator A Control Stuck On Bank 2

P0046.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit Range/Performance

d.en: Boost control actuator A is electrically active but boost pressure deviates from target. Mechanical or hydraulic limitation.

P0047.ru: Управление наддувом турбины/нагнетателя A — низкий сигнал

P0048.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control A Circuit High

d.en: Boost control circuit A voltage above expected range — short to power or open ground in solenoid wiring.
The turbocharger A turbine speed exceeded its safe limit. Risk of bearing damage and shaft fracture. Often caused by a stuck-closed wastegate or boost control fault.
Open circuit at boost control solenoid B (twin-turbo or two-stage system). Same diagnosis as P0045 on actuator B.

P004B.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Circuit Range/Performance
P004B.ru: Управление наддувом турбины/нагнетателя B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Boost control B mechanical/hydraulic deviation from target. Same as P0046 on actuator B. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P004C.ru: Управление наддувом турбины/нагнетателя B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Intermittent dropouts or noise on boost control A circuit. Loose connector, partial wiring break, or solenoid degrading.

P004F.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Control B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P004F.ru: Управление наддувом турбины/нагнетателя B — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same intermittent fault pattern as P004E on boost control B. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

d.en: HO2S Heater Control Circuit (Bank 2 Sensor 1): the control circuit has an electrical fault. The heater brings the oxygen sensor to operating temperature for closed-loop fuel control.

P0051.ru: Подогрев датчика O2 Б2Д1 — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: HO2S Heater Control Circuit Low (Bank 2 Sensor 1): the control-circuit voltage is below the expected range. The heater brings the oxygen sensor to operating temperature for closed-loop fuel control.

P0052.ru: Подогрев датчика O2 Б2Д1 — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust cam profile actuator A on bank 1 stuck disengaged. Same fault pattern as P003C but on the exhaust cam. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

P005F.ru: Питание управления наддувом турбины/нагнетателя B — высокое напряжение

d.en: Supply voltage feeding boost control actuator B is above the expected range. Likely charging system overvoltage or wiring shorted to a higher potential.

P0062.en: HO2S Heater Control Circuit Bank 2 Sensor 3
P0062.ru: Подогрев датчика O2 Б2Д3 — цепь управления

P0066.en: Air Assisted Injector Control Circuit Low

P0067.en: Air Assisted Injector Control Circuit High
P0067.ru: Форсунка с воздушным впрыском — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Control voltage of the air-assist injector valve is above the expected range — short to power or open ground. A flow-deviating injector throws off cylinder balance — adjacent cylinders run leaner/richer to compensate, often masking the root cause until the trim limit is hit.
The ECU detects implausibility between throttle position and the airflow or intake manifold pressure measured. At a given throttle angle the air mass deviates beyond rationality limits.

P0069.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure - Barometric Pressure Correlation

d.en: At engine cranking or key-on the intake manifold pressure should equal barometric pressure within tolerance. The ECU detects a deviation indicating sensor drift or vacuum line issues.

P006A.en: MAP - Mass or Volume Air Flow Correlation Bank 1

d.en: The expected relationship between manifold absolute pressure (MAP) and mass airflow (MAF) on bank 1 is violated. One of the two sensors is reading incorrectly.
The relationship between manifold absolute pressure and exhaust back pressure is implausible. One of the two pressure sensors is faulty or there is a major leak in either path.

P006C.ru: MAP — давление на входе турбины/нагнетателя — рассогласование

d.en: The relationship between manifold absolute pressure and turbocharger inlet pressure is implausible. Indicates a leak between turbo inlet and intake manifold or a sensor fault.

P006D.en: Barometric Pressure - Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Correlation Bank 1
P006D.ru: Барометрическое давление — давление на входе турбины/нагнетателя, рассогласование, банк 1

d.en: The relationship between barometric pressure and turbo inlet pressure (bank 1) is implausible — at engine off the two should match. Indicates an inlet sensor or barometric sensor fault.

P007F.en: Charge Air Cooler Temperature Sensor Bank1/Bank2 Correlation

The ECU detects fuel rail pressure below the desired setpoint despite maximum pump and metering valve commands. Common in direct injection diesel and gasoline systems where high-pressure pump or rail pressure regulator fails.
The ECU detects fuel rail pressure above the desired setpoint and cannot reduce it through pressure regulator commands. Risk of injector damage and rail seal failure if not addressed.
The ECU detects that fuel rail pressure does not respond to commanded changes of the pressure regulator within expected dynamics. Indicates a sluggish or partially failed regulator.

P008A.ru: Давление в системе низкого давления топлива — слишком низкое

d.en: The low-pressure (lift pump) fuel pressure is below the expected value. Insufficient supply to the high-pressure pump leads to power loss and possible HP pump cavitation.

P008B.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure - Too High
P008B.ru: Давление в системе низкого давления топлива — слишком высокое

d.en: The low-pressure fuel pressure is above the expected value. Often caused by a stuck-closed fuel return valve or a faulty pressure regulator.

d.en: Open circuit at the fuel cooler pump control. The pump that circulates fuel through a cooler (used on diesels and some hot-fuel applications) cannot be driven.

P00FD.en: Battery B State of Charge Performance

d.en: State of charge of battery B (typically auxiliary or hybrid battery) shows performance fault — does not behave according to charging model.

P00FE.en: EVAP System Tank Vapor Line Restricted/Blocked
P00FE.ru: Система EVAP, линия паров бака — ограничена / заблокирована

d.en: The EVAP tank vapor line is restricted or blocked. Tank pressure cannot equalize properly. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P00FF.en: Body Control Module Requested MIL Illumination
P00FF.ru: Блок BCM — запрос включения лампы MIL

d.en: The Body Control Module (BCM) sent a request to the engine ECU to illuminate the MIL — actual fault is in a body system; this is a forwarded request, not a powertrain fault.

P0100.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Malfunction

d.en: The ECU detects a general electrical malfunction in the mass air flow (MAF) sensor circuit. The signal is missing, out of plausible range, or the wiring shows continuity issues. Used as a generic fault when no more specific MAF code applies.

P0101.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Range/Performance

d.en: The mass air flow (MAF) sensor signal is outside the expected range or does not track engine load plausibly. The ECU compares MAF readings against load calculated from RPM, throttle position and intake pressure; persistent disagreement triggers this code.

P0102.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Low Input

d.en: The MAF sensor reports an air flow value below the plausible minimum for current engine speed and load. The ECU substitutes a calculated load value while the fault is active.

P0103.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit High Input

d.en: The MAF sensor reports an air flow value above the plausible maximum for current engine speed and load. Often indicates a sensor that is failing in a way that produces excess output, or a short to supply voltage in the signal path.

P0104.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Intermittent

d.en: The ECU detects intermittent signal dropouts or noise on the mass air flow (MAF) sensor circuit. The fault is not constantly present, suggesting a loose connection, intermittent wiring break, or a failing sensor under specific conditions (vibration, temperature).

P0105.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure / Barometric Pressure Circuit Malfunction

d.en: The ECU detects a general electrical malfunction in the manifold absolute pressure (MAP) or barometric pressure sensor circuit. Signal missing, implausible, or wiring broken. Generic fault when no more specific MAP code applies.

The manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor signal is implausible relative to throttle position and engine speed. The ECU expects MAP to rise with throttle opening and fall under deceleration; deviation triggers the code.

P0107.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor Low Input

d.en: The MAP sensor reports a pressure below the lower threshold the ECU expects at any engine state. Typically indicates a hard electrical fault rather than a slow drift.

P0108.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor High Input

d.en: The MAP sensor reports a pressure above the upper threshold the ECU expects in any engine state. Typically caused by a short in the signal circuit or a sensor that has failed producing a fixed high output.

P0109.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure / Barometric Pressure Circuit Intermittent

d.en: The ECU detects intermittent signal dropouts on the MAP/BARO sensor circuit. Fault is not constantly present — typically caused by loose connectors, chafed wiring, or a sensor failing under thermal load.

P010A.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor B Circuit

d.en: Generic electrical fault on MAF sensor B (second sensor for redundancy or twin-intake systems).

P010B.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P010B.ru: Датчик MAF B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: MAF sensor B reading implausible. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P010C.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor B Circuit Low

d.en: MAF B signal voltage below expected range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P010D.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor B Circuit High

d.en: MAF B signal voltage above expected range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P010E.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

d.en: Intermittent signal from MAF sensor B. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P010F.en: Mass or Volume Air Flow Sensor A/B Correlation

d.en: MAF sensor A and B disagree beyond plausible deviation. One is reading incorrectly.

P0110.en: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Malfunction
P0110.ru: Датчик температуры воздуха на впуске — неисправность цепи

d.en: The ECU detects a general electrical fault in the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor circuit. Signal absent, shorted or out of plausible range. Generic catch-all when no more specific IAT code (low/high/range) is set.

P0111.ru: Датчик температуры воздуха на впуске — вне диапазона

d.en: The intake air temperature (IAT) sensor reading does not change plausibly with engine warm-up or after driving begins. Many vehicles share the IAT into the MAF housing; on those, MAF replacement also replaces IAT.

P0112.en: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Low Input
P0112.ru: Датчик температуры воздуха на впуске — низкий сигнал

d.en: The IAT signal voltage is below threshold, which the ECU interprets as an implausibly hot intake (low NTC resistance). Usually a wiring short to ground or a failed sensor.

P0113.en: Intake Air Temperature Sensor High Input
P0113.ru: Датчик температуры воздуха на впуске — высокий сигнал

d.en: The IAT signal voltage is above threshold, which the ECU interprets as an implausibly cold intake (open-circuit-like behaviour). Usually open wiring or a sensor that has failed open.

P0114.ru: Датчик температуры воздуха на впуске — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The IAT signal shows intermittent dropouts or jumps that fall outside slope expectations but do not stay above or below threshold long enough to trigger P0112/P0113. Usually a wiring or connector issue.

P0115.en: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Malfunction
P0115.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя, цепь — неисправность

d.en: A general fault has been detected in the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor circuit. The ECU uses ECT for fuel enrichment during cold start, fan control, and closed-loop entry timing.

P0116.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The coolant temperature sensor reading does not change plausibly during warm-up, or its value disagrees with the intake air temperature when the engine has been off long enough that they should match. Often caused by a sensor that reports near a fixed value despite engine warm-up.

P0117.en: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Low Input
P0117.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя — низкий сигнал

d.en: The ECT signal voltage is below threshold, which the ECU interprets as an implausibly hot coolant temperature (typical NTC sensor characteristic — low resistance at high temperature).

P0118.en: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor High Input
P0118.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя — высокий сигнал

d.en: The ECT signal voltage is above threshold, which the ECU interprets as an implausibly cold temperature (open-circuit-like behaviour). When this code is active, the ECU runs a default cold-start enrichment that wastes fuel and may cause black smoke.

P0119.en: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
P0119.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The ECU detects intermittent signal dropouts on the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor circuit. Fault not constantly present, typically due to loose connector, chafed wiring or a sensor failing thermally.
ECT sensors 1 and 2 readings disagree beyond plausible limits — typically near startup both should match within tolerance.

P011B.ru: Температура ОЖ двигателя / температура воздуха на впуске — рассогласование

d.en: ECT and IAT readings disagree at long soak (engine off for hours) when both should match ambient. The intake air temperature sensor feeds the ECM's density calculation — a drifted reading miscalculates fuel mass and pushes mixture lean (cold reading) or rich (hot reading).

P011C.ru: Температура охладителя наддувочного воздуха / температура воздуха на впуске, банк 1 — рассогласование

P011D.en: Charge Air Cooler Temperature/Intake Air Temperature Correlation Bank 2
P011D.ru: Температура охладителя наддувочного воздуха / температура воздуха на впуске, банк 2 — рассогласование

d.en: CAC temperature and IAT on bank 2 disagree at long soak. The intake air temperature sensor feeds the ECM's density calculation — a drifted reading miscalculates fuel mass and pushes mixture lean (cold reading) or rich (hot reading).

P011E.en: Engine Coolant Temperature 1 / Ambient Air Temperature Correlation
P011E.ru: Температура ОЖ двигателя 1 / температура окружающего воздуха — рассогласование

d.en: Engine Coolant Temperature 1 / Ambient Air Temperature Correlation: the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern.

P011F.en: Engine Coolant Temperature 2 / Ambient Air Temperature Correlation
P011F.ru: Температура ОЖ двигателя 2 / температура окружающего воздуха — рассогласование

d.en: Engine Coolant Temperature 2 / Ambient Air Temperature Correlation: the value does not correlate with the related sensor or expected pattern.

P0120.en: Throttle Position Sensor / Switch A Circuit Malfunction
P0120.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя A — неисправность цепи

d.en: The ECU detects a general electrical fault on the throttle position sensor/switch A circuit. Signal missing, implausible, or wiring broken. Generic catch-all when no more specific TPS-A code applies.

P0121.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали «A» — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The throttle position sensor (TPS) signal does not match the expected range for the commanded pedal position. On drive-by-wire vehicles, two redundant sensors are compared; a divergence between them or implausible motion triggers this code.

P0122.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали «A» — низкий входной сигнал

d.en: The TPS signal voltage is below the lower acceptable threshold. The ECU usually enters limp-home mode and limits engine torque while the fault is active.

P0123.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали «A» — высокий входной сигнал

d.en: The TPS signal voltage exceeds the upper acceptable threshold. As with P0122, limp-home mode is typical until the fault clears.

The TPS signal shows intermittent dropouts that do not stay outside threshold long enough to trigger P0122/P0123. Drive-by-wire systems are sensitive to this and may briefly enter limp-home mode each time.

P0125.en: Insufficient Coolant Temperature for Closed Loop Fuel Control
P0125.ru: Температура ОЖ недостаточна для замкнутого контура топливоподачи

d.en: The engine has run long enough that closed-loop fuel control should be active, but the coolant temperature has not risen high enough. Often caused by a stuck-open thermostat or a failed coolant temperature sensor.

P0126.en: Insufficient Coolant Temperature for Stable Operation
P0126.ru: Температура ОЖ недостаточна для стабильной работы

d.en: Coolant temperature stays below the value expected for stable engine operation. Almost always points to a thermostat stuck open or a sensor reading lower than the actual engine temperature.

P0127.ru: Температура воздуха на впуске слишком высокая

d.en: Intake air temperature exceeds the safe maximum. Risk of preignition or knock; ECU may reduce power.

The engine has been running long enough to reach operating temperature, but coolant temperature stayed below the thermostat's regulating value. Almost always caused by a thermostat stuck open. Costs fuel economy and increases cold-engine emissions.
Barometric pressure reading below the plausible minimum. Either operating at extreme altitude or sensor fault.

P012A.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor A Circuit
P012A.ru: Датчик давления на входе турбины/нагнетателя A — цепь

d.en: Generic electrical fault on turbo/supercharger inlet pressure sensor A. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P012B.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
P012B.ru: Датчик давления на входе турбины/нагнетателя A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Turbo inlet pressure sensor A reading implausible. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P012C.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor A Circuit Low
P012C.ru: Датчик давления на входе турбины/нагнетателя A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Turbo inlet pressure sensor A signal voltage below expected range. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P012D.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor A Circuit High
P012D.ru: Датчик давления на входе турбины/нагнетателя A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Turbo inlet pressure sensor A signal voltage above expected range. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P012E.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Inlet Pressure Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P012E.ru: Датчик давления на входе турбины/нагнетателя A — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Intermittent signal from turbo inlet pressure sensor A. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P012F.en: Engine Coolant Temperature / Engine Oil Temperature Correlation
P012F.ru: Температура ОЖ двигателя / температура масла двигателя — рассогласование

d.en: Engine coolant and oil temperature readings disagree beyond plausible limits. The engine coolant temperature sensor feeds warm-up enrichment, fan control and closed-loop entry — a stuck-cold reading keeps the engine in open loop and rich forever.

The upstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 reports an implausible signal — typically stuck mid-range, no switching between rich and lean, or no signal at all. Closed-loop fuel control cannot run while this fault is active.

P0131.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 1)

d.en: The upstream oxygen sensor signal is fixed at a low voltage, indicating the ECU sees a continuously lean exhaust on bank 1 — or the sensor signal path is shorted to ground.

P0132.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 1)

d.en: The upstream oxygen sensor signal is fixed at a high voltage, indicating either a continuously rich exhaust on bank 1 or a short to supply voltage in the signal circuit.
The upstream oxygen sensor switches between rich and lean too slowly. Aged sensors lose response speed before they fail outright; this code typically appears before P0130/P0131/P0132.

P0134.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
P0134.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects that the upstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 shows no switching activity or responds too slowly to changing exhaust gas composition. Often the sensor is aged, contaminated by silicone or fuel additives, or the heater circuit is degraded.

P0135.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1, Sensor 1)
P0135.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The heating element inside the upstream oxygen sensor draws no current, draws too much current, or is open-circuit. The heater brings the sensor to operating temperature so closed-loop control can start within seconds rather than minutes.

A general fault has been detected in the downstream (post-catalyst) oxygen sensor on bank 1. The downstream sensor monitors catalyst efficiency rather than fuel mixture; with no signal, the catalyst monitor cannot run.

P0137.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 2)

d.en: The downstream oxygen sensor signal is fixed at a low voltage. Either the catalyst is letting unburned oxygen through (sensor sees lean), the sensor itself is shorted to ground, or the catalyst is so degraded that the downstream signal mirrors a lean upstream condition.

P0138.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1, Sensor 2)

d.en: The downstream oxygen sensor signal is fixed at a high voltage, indicating either a continuously rich downstream reading (less common, since post-cat exhaust should be more stable) or a short to supply voltage in the signal circuit.

P0139.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 2)

d.en: The ECU detects that the downstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 reports an abnormally high voltage signal, suggesting a persistently rich exhaust condition past the catalyst, a shorted sensor, or wiring shorted to a voltage source.

P013A.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Rich to Lean Bank 1 Sensor 2
P013A.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — медленный отклик, с богатой на бедную

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 1 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from rich to lean. Sensor aging or contamination.

P013B.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich Bank 1 Sensor 2
P013B.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — медленный отклик, с бедной на богатую

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 1 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from lean to rich. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P013C.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Rich to Lean Bank 2 Sensor 2
P013C.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — медленный отклик, с богатой на бедную

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from rich to lean. Sensor aging or contamination.

P013D.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich Bank 2 Sensor 2
P013D.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — медленный отклик, с бедной на богатую

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from lean to rich. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P013E.en: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Rich to Lean Bank 1 Sensor 2
P013E.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — запаздывающий отклик, с богатой на бедную

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 1 reacts only after delay when mixture switches rich to lean. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P013F.en: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Lean to Rich Bank 1 Sensor 2
P013F.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — запаздывающий отклик, с бедной на богатую

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 1 reacts only after delay when mixture switches lean to rich. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P0140.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P0140.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects no switching or excessively slow response from the downstream oxygen sensor on bank 1. Typical for an aged or poisoned sensor; downstream sensors should show a relatively flat signal but must respond to fueling changes during diagnostic monitor runs.

P0141.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1, Sensor 2)
P0141.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The heating element inside the downstream oxygen sensor on bank 1 is open-circuit, drawing no current, or drawing too much. Without heater, the sensor takes much longer to reach operating temperature, delaying catalyst diagnosis.

P0142.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P0142.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The ECU detects an electrical fault in the heater circuit of the downstream oxygen sensor on bank 1. The heater current is out of range, suggesting an open or shorted heater element, blown fuse or wiring fault.
The ECU detects a general electrical fault on the third oxygen sensor in the bank 1 exhaust path (typically located after a second catalyst on diesel or large engines with multi-cat exhausts).

P0144.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 3)

d.en: The ECU detects an abnormally low voltage from the third O2 sensor on bank 1. Indicates persistently lean exhaust, an open sensor or wiring shorted to ground.

P0145.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 3)

d.en: The ECU detects an abnormally high voltage from the third O2 sensor on bank 1. Indicates persistently rich exhaust, a shorted sensor or wiring shorted to a voltage source.

P0146.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 1 Sensor 3)
P0146.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д3 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects no switching activity or too slow a response from the third O2 sensor on bank 1. Typical for aged or poisoned sensor.

P0147.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 3)
P0147.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д3 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The ECU detects an electrical fault in the heater circuit of the third O2 sensor on bank 1. Heater current out of range, indicating open/shorted heater element, blown fuse or wiring fault.
Fuel quantity actually delivered does not match the commanded value over a long observation window. Mechanical issue in the fuel system.
Injection timing deviates from target. Often caused by chain wear, sensor offset, or injector response drift.

P014A.en: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Rich to Lean Bank 2 Sensor 2
P014A.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — запаздывающий отклик, с богатой на бедную

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 reacts only after delay when mixture switches rich to lean. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

d.en: Post-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 reacts only after delay when mixture switches lean to rich. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

d.en: Pre-cat O2 sensor on bank 1 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from rich to lean. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P014D.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich Bank 1 Sensor 1
P014D.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — медленный отклик, с бедной на богатую

d.en: Pre-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from rich to lean. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.

P014F.en: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Lean to Rich Bank 2 Sensor 1
P014F.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — медленный отклик, с бедной на богатую

d.en: Pre-cat O2 sensor on bank 2 responds too slowly when mixture transitions from lean to rich. A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.
Same condition as P0130 but on bank 2 of a multi-bank engine. Closed-loop fuel control on bank 2 is disabled while this fault is active.

P0151.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 2, Sensor 1)

d.en: Same condition as P0131 but on bank 2. The upstream sensor sees a continuously lean exhaust on bank 2 or has a signal short to ground.

P0152.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2, Sensor 1)

d.en: Same condition as P0132 but on bank 2. The upstream sensor reports a continuously rich condition or has a short to supply voltage.

P0153.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 1)

d.en: The ECU detects an abnormally high voltage from the upstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Indicates persistently rich exhaust, shorted sensor or wiring shorted to voltage.

P0154.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
P0154.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects no switching activity or too slow a response from the upstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Typically aged or poisoned sensor, weak heater, or upstream exhaust leak.

P0155.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2, Sensor 1)
P0155.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: Same condition as P0135 but on the upstream sensor of bank 2. The sensor heater warms the element to operating temperature (~600 °C); without it the lambda sensor stays inactive in closed loop and the ECM cannot trim mixture.
Same condition as P0136 but on the downstream sensor of bank 2. The catalyst efficiency monitor for bank 2 cannot run while this fault is active.

P0157.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 2)

d.en: The ECU detects abnormally low voltage from the downstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Indicates persistently lean exhaust past the catalyst, open sensor or wiring shorted to ground.

P0158.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 2)

d.en: The ECU detects abnormally low voltage from the downstream O2 sensor on bank 2 (alternate definition mapping in some manufacturers' interpretation). Indicates persistent lean reading, open sensor or wiring shorted to ground.

P0159.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 2)

d.en: The ECU detects an abnormally high voltage from the downstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Indicates persistently rich exhaust past the cat, shorted sensor or wiring shorted to voltage.

P015A.en: O2 Sensor Delayed Response - Rich to Lean Bank 1 Sensor 1
P015A.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — запаздывающий отклик, с богатой на бедную

P015E.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления углом впрыска

d.en: ECU took longer than allowed to enter closed-loop control of fuel injection timing. Often slow sensor warm-up.

P015F.en: Excessive Time to Enter Closed Loop Cylinder Balance Control
P015F.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур балансировки цилиндров

d.en: ECU took longer than allowed to enter closed-loop cylinder balance control.

P0160.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
P0160.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects no switching or too slow a response from the downstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Often aged or poisoned sensor; downstream sensors usually flat but must respond on diagnostic monitor runs.

P0161.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2, Sensor 2)
P0161.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: Same condition as P0141 but on the downstream sensor of bank 2. The sensor heater warms the element to operating temperature (~600 °C); without it the lambda sensor stays inactive in closed loop and the ECM cannot trim mixture.

P0162.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
P0162.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The ECU detects an electrical fault in the heater circuit of the downstream O2 sensor on bank 2. Heater current out of range — open or shorted heater element, blown fuse, or wiring fault.
The ECU detects a general electrical fault on the third O2 sensor in the bank 2 exhaust path (typically post-second-cat in multi-cat exhausts).

P0164.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 3)

d.en: The ECU detects abnormally low voltage from the third O2 sensor on bank 2. Indicates lean exhaust, open sensor or wiring shorted to ground.

P0165.en: O2 Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 3)

d.en: The ECU detects abnormally high voltage from the third O2 sensor on bank 2. Indicates rich exhaust or wiring shorted to voltage.

P0166.en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity / Slow Response (Bank 2 Sensor 3)
P0166.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д3 — нет активности / медленный отклик

d.en: The ECU detects no switching or too slow a response from the third O2 sensor on bank 2. Typically aged or poisoned sensor or weak heater.

P0167.en: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2 Sensor 3)
P0167.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д3 — цепь подогрева, неисправность

d.en: The ECU detects an electrical fault in the heater circuit of the third O2 sensor on bank 2. Heater current out of range — open or shorted heater, blown fuse, wiring fault.
Fuel temperature exceeds the safe maximum. Risk of fuel pump damage and injection imprecision.
Fuel composition (e.g. ethanol fraction on flex-fuel vehicles) outside expected range. Wrong fuel filled or sensor fault.

P016A.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Air/Fuel Ratio Control
P016A.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления соотношением воздух/топливо

d.en: ECU took longer than allowed to enter closed-loop air/fuel ratio control. Most often O2 sensor heater aging or coolant temperature reading wrong.

P016B.en: Closed Loop Air/Fuel Ratio Control At Limit - System Too Rich
P016B.ru: Регулирование состава смеси в замкнутом контуре на пределе — слишком богатая смесь

d.en: Closed-loop fuel trim hit its lean correction limit because mixture is structurally too rich. Likely fuel pressure too high, leaking injector, or O2 sensor reporting too lean.

P016C.en: Closed Loop Air/Fuel Ratio Control At Limit - System Too Lean
P016C.ru: Регулирование состава смеси в замкнутом контуре на пределе — слишком бедная смесь

d.en: Closed-loop fuel trim hit its rich correction limit because mixture is structurally too lean. Likely vacuum leak, low fuel pressure, or contaminated MAF.

P016D.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Fuel Pressure Control
P016D.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления давлением топлива

d.en: ECU took longer than allowed to close the loop on fuel pressure control. Pressure rise too slow at start.

P016E.en: Closed Loop Fuel Pressure Control At Limit - Pressure Too High
P016E.ru: Регулирование давления топлива в замкнутом контуре на пределе — давление слишком высокое

d.en: Closed-loop fuel pressure control hit its lower limit because rail pressure is structurally too high.

P016F.en: Closed Loop Fuel Pressure Control At Limit - Pressure Too Low
P016F.ru: Регулирование давления топлива в замкнутом контуре на пределе — давление слишком низкое

d.en: Closed-loop fuel pressure control hit its upper limit because rail pressure is structurally too low.

The ECU detects that short-term and long-term fuel trim values on bank 1 are outside acceptable limits. Engine cannot maintain stoichiometric mixture — typically a vacuum leak, fuel pressure issue, or failing MAF/O2 sensor.

Long-term fuel trim on bank 1 is at the upper limit — the ECU is adding more fuel than baseline to maintain stoichiometric mixture but cannot reach target. Indicates unmetered air entering the intake or insufficient fuel delivery.

Long-term fuel trim on bank 1 is at the lower limit — the ECU is removing fuel from baseline but mixture remains too rich. Indicates excess fuel delivery, restricted air flow, or a faulty oxygen sensor reporting falsely lean.
Fuel trims on bank 2 exceed adaptation limits in either lean or rich direction. The ECU cannot maintain stoichiometric mixture within calibrated boundaries.

Same condition as P0171 but on bank 2 of a multi-bank engine (V6, V8, flat-six, etc.). When P0171 and P0174 appear together, the cause is usually a shared component such as the MAF sensor or a central vacuum leak rather than a bank-specific fault.
Same condition as P0172 but on bank 2. When paired with P0172, suspect shared causes (fuel pressure, blocked air filter); when alone, suspect a bank-specific injector or oxygen sensor.
The ECU detects an electrical fault in the flex-fuel composition sensor circuit. The sensor measures ethanol content (E0–E85) in the fuel; signal missing, shorted or out of plausible range.

P0177.en: Fuel Composition Sensor Circuit Range / Performance
P0177.ru: Датчик состава топлива, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

P0179.en: Fuel Composition Sensor Circuit High Input
P0179.ru: Датчик состава топлива, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: The flex-fuel composition sensor signal exceeds the maximum threshold. Likely shorted to voltage, open ground or failed sensor.

d.en: CHT sensor A reading implausible.

P017C.en: Cylinder Head Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
P017C.ru: Датчик температуры ГБЦ A — низкий сигнал

d.en: CHT sensor A signal voltage below expected range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0182.ru: Датчик температуры топлива A, цепь — низкий сигнал

P02E0.ru: Заслонка впуска дизеля A — обрыв цепи управления

d.en: The drive circuit for the diesel intake air-flow control valve A is open. This valve (also called intake throttle, swirl flap actuator, or anti-shudder valve) closes the diesel intake to control airflow during regeneration and shutdown.

P02E1.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Control Performance

d.en: Diesel intake air-flow control A is electrically OK but does not move the throttle plate as commanded — typically carbon buildup or seized actuator.

P02E2.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Control Circuit Low
P02E2.ru: Заслонка впуска дизеля A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Diesel intake air-flow control A drive line stuck low — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P02E4.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Control Stuck Open
P02E4.ru: Заслонка впуска дизеля A — заклинил открытым

d.en: Diesel intake throttle A is mechanically stuck open — anti-shudder function on shutdown will not work and DPF regen airflow control is lost.

P02E5.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Control Stuck Closed
P02E5.ru: Заслонка впуска дизеля A — заклинил закрытым

P02E7.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P02E7.ru: Датчик положения заслонки впуска дизеля A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Position sensor reads in range but plausibility check fails — does not match commanded throttle position.

P02E8.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Position Sensor Circuit Low
P02E8.ru: Датчик положения заслонки впуска дизеля A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Diesel Intake Air Flow A Position Sensor Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.

The ECU has detected misfires that are not concentrated on a single cylinder. The misfire monitor measures crankshaft acceleration after each combustion event; missing acceleration on multiple cylinders, or randomly across cylinders, triggers this code.

Misfires concentrated on cylinder 1. A cylinder-specific code points away from shared causes (fuel pressure, MAF) toward components dedicated to that cylinder — coil, spark plug, injector, compression.
Misfires concentrated on cylinder 2. Diagnostic approach is identical to P0301 — swap the suspect coil or plug with a known-good cylinder and see if the misfire follows.

Misfires concentrated on cylinder 3. A cylinder-specific code points away from shared causes (fuel pressure, MAF) toward components dedicated to that cylinder — coil, spark plug, injector, compression. Verify by swapping the suspected coil/plug to a different cylinder; if the code follows, the part is bad.

d.en: Misfires are detected while the fuel level is low. The ECM disables further misfire reporting under this condition because intermittent fuel starvation can cause false positives in catalyst-damaging logic.

P0314.ru: Пропуски зажигания в одном цилиндре — цилиндр не определён

P0315.ru: Отклонение системы положения коленвала не обучено

d.en: The PCM has not yet learned the crankshaft position variation table required for accurate misfire detection. After flywheel/sensor replacement or PCM relearn, a procedure must be performed (typically deceleration from a defined RPM with closed throttle).

P0316.en: Engine Misfire Detected on Startup (First 1000 Revolutions)

d.en: The misfire monitor detected misfires during the first 1000 revolutions after startup but the engine then settled. Often caused by fouled spark plugs that warm up clean, weak ignition coils, or a borderline cold-start fuel mixture.

The PCM has been configured to use rough-road sensor input for misfire detection (to mask false positives on bumpy surfaces) but the expected hardware is not detected on the network. Typically a configuration mismatch after replacement.

d.en: B Camshaft Position Actuator Position Sensor C Circuit (Bank 1): an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This relates to engine timing; a fault can cause rough running, a no-start, or timing errors.

P03F7.en: B Camshaft Position Actuator Position Sensor C Range/Performance (Bank 1)

P03F8.en: B Camshaft Position Actuator Position Sensor C Circuit Low (Bank 1)
P03F8.ru: Датчик положения C привода распредвала B — низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Ignition K Control Signal Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. This line drives an ignition coil group; a fault causes misfire on those cylinders.

A general fault has been detected in the exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system. EGR routes a portion of exhaust back into the intake to reduce combustion temperature and NOx emissions. Most EGR codes today are caused by carbon buildup blocking the valve.

P0401.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Flow Insufficient Detected
P0401.ru: Рециркуляция выхлопных газов — обнаружен недостаточный поток

d.en: When the ECU commands EGR open, the actual flow measured by the DPFE sensor or the resulting MAP/MAF change is below threshold. By far the most common cause is a carboned-up EGR valve or blocked intake passages.

P0402.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Flow Excessive Detected
P0402.ru: Рециркуляция выхлопных газов — обнаружен чрезмерный поток

d.en: EGR flow is higher than expected when the valve should be closed, or higher than commanded when partially open. Typically a valve that has stuck open due to carbon, causing rough idle and stalling.
The control circuit for the EGR valve solenoid is open or shorted. The ECM cannot drive the valve to the commanded position.

The EGR valve does not move through its expected range or its position feedback does not track command. The valve may be sticking, the position sensor may be drifting or carbon buildup is preventing full travel.

P0405.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit Low
P0405.ru: Датчик рециркуляции выхлопных газов "A", цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P0406.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit High
P0406.ru: Датчик рециркуляции выхлопных газов "A", цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "A" Circuit High: the signal voltage is above the expected range. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P0407.ru: Датчик EGR B, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: The signal from EGR position or pressure sensor B is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Indicates a short to ground, open signal wire or sensor fault.

P0408.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "B" Circuit Low
P0408.ru: Датчик рециркуляции выхлопных газов "B", цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "B" Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P0409.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "B" Circuit High
P0409.ru: Датчик рециркуляции выхлопных газов "B", цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Sensor "B" Circuit High: the signal voltage is above the expected range. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.
A general electrical fault on EGR temperature sensor A — open, shorted, or out of plausibility. The sensor monitors recirculated exhaust gas temperature for EGR cooler protection and dosing.

P040B.en: EGR Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
P040B.ru: Датчик температуры EGR A, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: EGR temperature sensor A reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P040C.en: EGR Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
P040C.ru: Датчик температуры EGR A, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: EGR temperature sensor A below lower plausibility — short to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P040D.en: EGR Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
P040D.ru: Датчик температуры EGR A, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: EGR temperature sensor A above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P040E.en: EGR Temperature Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P040E.ru: Датчик температуры EGR A, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: EGR temperature sensor A signal jumps or drops out intermittently. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

EGR temperature sensors A and B disagree by more than the allowed tolerance over a drive cycle. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

A general fault in the secondary air injection system. The system pumps fresh air into the exhaust during cold start to accelerate catalyst light-off; common faults are a seized pump, blocked passages or a stuck valve.

P0411.en: Secondary Air Injection System Incorrect Flow

d.en: When the ECU commands secondary air injection, the actual flow measured by the front oxygen sensor (or a dedicated mass flow meter) does not match the expected value. Usually a partially blocked passage or a leaking combi valve.

P0412.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit
P0412.ru: Переключающий клапан A системы вторичного воздуха — цепь

d.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P0413.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit Open
P0413.ru: Переключающий клапан A системы вторичного воздуха — цепь, обрыв

d.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit Open: the circuit is open. Likely a broken wire, disconnected connector, or failed component.

P0414.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve "A" Circuit Shorted
P0414.ru: Переключающий клапан "A" системы вторичного воздуха — замыкание цепи

d.en: The ECU detected a short circuit in the secondary air injection switching valve A control circuit. With the valve unable to switch correctly, the cold-start emissions strategy fails and the catalyst takes longer to reach light-off.

P0415.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit
P0415.ru: Переключающий клапан B системы вторичного воздуха — цепь

d.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P0416.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit Open
P0416.ru: Переключающий клапан B системы вторичного воздуха — цепь, обрыв

d.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit Open: the circuit is open. Likely a broken wire, disconnected connector, or failed component.

P0417.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve B Circuit Shorted
P0417.ru: Переключающий клапан B системы вторичного воздуха — замыкание цепи

d.en: AIR switching valve B drive circuit shorted to ground or B+.

P0418.en: Secondary Air Injection System Relay "A" Circuit Malfunction
P0418.ru: Реле "A" системы вторичного воздуха — неисправность цепи

d.en: General electrical fault in the secondary air injection pump relay A circuit. Without the relay, the air pump cannot be commanded and the system cannot complete its cold-start function.

P0419.en: Secondary Air Injection System Control B Circuit
P0419.ru: Система вторичного воздуха, управление B — цепь

d.en: A general electrical fault on AIR system control circuit B (typically the AIR pump driver line on the second pump or relay).
A general electrical fault on EGR temperature sensor B — open, shorted, or out of plausibility. The sensor monitors recirculated exhaust gas temperature for EGR cooler protection and dosing.

P041B.en: EGR Temperature Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P041B.ru: Датчик температуры EGR B, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: EGR temperature sensor B reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P041C.en: EGR Temperature Sensor B Circuit Low
