P041E.en: EGR Temperature Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P041E.ru: Датчик температуры EGR B, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: EGR temperature sensor B signal jumps or drops out intermittently. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P041F.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit Low
P041F.ru: Переключающий клапан A системы вторичного воздуха — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: AIR switching valve A drive line stuck low — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The oxygen storage capacity of the main catalytic converter on bank 1 has degraded below the OBD threshold. The downstream oxygen sensor signal increasingly mirrors the upstream sensor, indicating reduced conversion efficiency.

P0421.en: Warm Up Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
P0421.ru: Прогревочный катализатор — эффективность ниже порога, банк 1

d.en: The pre-cat (warm-up) catalyst on bank 1 has lost too much oxygen storage capacity. Its primary purpose — quickly reaching light-off after a cold start — is no longer met within the OBD limits.
Generic main catalyst efficiency code on bank 1 — used by some manufacturers in addition to or instead of P0420. Indicates the same root cause — degraded oxygen storage in the main catalyst.

P0423.ru: Катализатор с подогревом, банк 1 — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: Heated (electrically warmed) catalyst on bank 1 fails efficiency monitoring. In addition to standard catalyst aging, faults in the catalyst heater control or supply can cause this code.

P0424.ru: Катализатор с подогревом, банк 1 — температура ниже порога

d.en: The heated catalyst on bank 1 does not reach its target temperature within the expected time. Common causes are a defective heater element, supply fault, or a damaged temperature sensor.
General electrical fault detected in the catalyst temperature sensor on bank 1 sensor position 1. The ECU uses this signal to manage heater control and protect the catalyst from overtemperature.

P0426.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
P0426.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — вне диапазона / характеристика (банк 1, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 1 reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P0427.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
P0427.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — низкий сигнал (банк 1, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 1 below lower plausibility — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0428.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
P0428.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — высокий сигнал (банк 1, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 1 above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+.
The drive circuit for the heated catalyst on bank 1 is open. Heated catalysts use an electrical heating element to reach light-off temperature within seconds of cold start.
A general electrical fault on the catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 2.

P042B.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P042B.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — вне диапазона / характеристика (банк 1, датчик 2)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 2 reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P042C.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 1 Sensor 2)

P042D.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P042D.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — высокий сигнал (банк 1, датчик 2)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 1 sensor 2 above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+.
EGR A Control Stuck Open: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.
EGR A Control Stuck Closed: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.
Same condition as P0420 but on bank 2. On engines with one shared catalyst per bank, P0420 and P0430 appearing together usually point to age rather than damage.

P0431.en: Warm Up Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
P0431.ru: Прогревочный катализатор — эффективность ниже порога, банк 2

d.en: The pre-cat (warm-up) catalyst on bank 2 has lost too much oxygen storage capacity. Its primary purpose — quickly reaching light-off after a cold start — is no longer met within the OBD limits.
Generic main catalyst efficiency code on bank 2 — used by some manufacturers in addition to or instead of P0420. Indicates the same root cause — degraded oxygen storage in the main catalyst.

P0433.ru: Катализатор с подогревом, банк 2 — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: Heated (electrically warmed) catalyst on bank 2 fails efficiency monitoring. In addition to standard catalyst aging, faults in the catalyst heater control or supply can cause this code.

P0434.ru: Катализатор с подогревом, банк 2 — температура ниже порога

d.en: The heated catalyst on bank 2 has not reached its calibrated light-off temperature within the expected time after engine start. Heater element weak or insufficient supply.
A general electrical fault on the catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 1.

P0436.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
P0436.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — вне диапазона / характеристика (банк 2, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 1 reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P0437.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
P0437.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — низкий сигнал (банк 2, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 1 below lower plausibility — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0438.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
P0438.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — высокий сигнал (банк 2, датчик 1)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 1 above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+.
The drive circuit for the heated catalyst on bank 2 is open. Heated catalysts use an electrical heating element to reach light-off temperature within seconds of cold start.
A general electrical fault on the catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 2.

P043B.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
P043B.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — вне диапазона / характеристика (банк 2, датчик 2)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 2 reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading.

P043C.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
P043C.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — низкий сигнал (банк 2, датчик 2)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 2 below lower plausibility — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P043D.en: Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
P043D.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора — высокий сигнал (банк 2, датчик 2)

d.en: Catalyst temperature sensor at bank 2 sensor 2 above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+.

P043E.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Reference Orifice Low Flow
P043E.ru: Система EVAP, эталонное отверстие диагностики утечек — пониженный поток

d.en: During the EVAP leak-detection self-test, the calibration airflow through the reference orifice is below the expected rate. The orifice may be partially blocked.

P043F.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Reference Orifice High Flow
P043F.ru: Система EVAP, эталонное отверстие диагностики утечек — повышенный поток

d.en: During the leak-detection self-test, airflow through the reference orifice is above the expected rate — typically a leak around the orifice or a damaged seal.

A general fault in the evaporative emission (EVAP) system has been detected. The system seals the fuel tank and captures fuel vapour in a charcoal canister; this code indicates a failed leak test or sensor without identifying the specific failure.

P0441.en: Evaporative Emission System Incorrect Purge Flow
P0441.ru: Система улавливания паров — неверный поток продувки

d.en: The actual purge flow does not match the commanded value. Usually a purge valve stuck closed (no flow) or stuck open (too much flow at idle). Distinct from a leak code.

P0442.en: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (Small Leak)

d.en: A small leak (typically equivalent to a 0.040 inch / 1.0 mm orifice) has been detected in the EVAP system. By far the most common cause is a fuel cap that is loose, missing, or has a worn seal.

P0443.en: Evaporative Emission System Purge Control Valve Circuit
P0443.ru: Клапан управления продувкой системы улавливания паров — цепь

d.en: Electrical fault in the EVAP purge solenoid circuit. The ECU detects an open, shorted, or out-of-range condition on the purge valve driver.

P0444.en: Evaporative Emission Purge Control Valve Circuit Open
P0444.ru: Клапан управления продувкой системы улавливания паров, цепь — обрыв

d.en: The ECU has detected an open circuit in the purge solenoid control line — usually a broken wire, unplugged connector, or open coil winding.

P0445.en: Evaporative Emission System Purge Control Valve Circuit Shorted
P0445.ru: Клапан управления продувкой системы улавливания паров, цепь — замыкание

d.en: The ECU detected a short in the EVAP purge solenoid control circuit. With the valve permanently energized or shorted, the system can either over-purge causing rich running, or stay closed.

P0446.en: Evaporative Emission Vent Control Circuit Malfunction
P0446.ru: Управление вентиляцией системы улавливания паров, цепь — неисправность

d.en: A fault in the EVAP vent valve circuit. The vent valve seals the canister against atmosphere during the leak test; without it, the test cannot pull a vacuum and may set false leak codes alongside.

P0447.en: Evaporative Emission System Vent Control Circuit Open
P0447.ru: Управление вентиляцией системы улавливания паров, цепь — обрыв

d.en: The ECU detected an open circuit on the EVAP vent valve control. The vent valve is needed to seal the system for leak diagnostics; with the circuit open the leak test cannot complete.

P0448.en: EVAP System Vent Control Circuit Shorted
P0448.ru: Система EVAP, цепь управления вентиляцией — замыкание

d.en: EVAP vent valve drive circuit shorted to ground or B+. The vent valve seals the canister during pressure-test diagnostics.

P0449.en: Evaporative Emission System Vent Valve/Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
P0449.ru: Клапан/соленоид вентиляции системы улавливания паров, цепь — неисправность

d.en: A general electrical fault was detected in the EVAP vent valve/solenoid control circuit. Without a working vent valve the EVAP leak test cannot complete and the system may remain not-ready.
EGR Sensor C Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P044B.ru: Датчик EGR C, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: EGR Sensor C Circuit Range/Performance: the signal is implausible or outside the valid range. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P044C.ru: Датчик EGR C, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: EGR sensor C below lower plausibility — short to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P044D.ru: Датчик EGR C, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: EGR sensor C above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P044E.ru: Датчик EGR C, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: EGR sensor C signal jumps or drops out intermittently. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P044F.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve A Circuit High
P044F.ru: Переключающий клапан A системы вторичного воздуха — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: AIR switching valve A drive line stuck high — short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0450.en: EVAP System Pressure Sensor/Switch A Circuit
P0450.ru: Датчик давления/выключатель A системы EVAP — цепь

d.en: A general electrical fault on EVAP pressure sensor/switch A — used to monitor canister pressure during leak-detection diagnostics.

P0451.en: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
P0451.ru: Датчик давления системы улавливания паров — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The fuel tank pressure sensor reading is implausible — for example, fluctuating signal, noise, or values that do not respond to known pressure events such as a key-on tank refill.

P0452.en: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor Low Input
P0452.ru: Датчик давления системы улавливания паров — низкий сигнал

d.en: The fuel tank pressure sensor signal is below the expected minimum voltage. Often caused by a failed sensor or a short to ground in the signal line.

P0453.en: Evaporative Emission System Pressure Sensor High Input
P0453.ru: Датчик давления системы улавливания паров — высокий сигнал

d.en: The fuel tank pressure sensor signal is above the expected maximum voltage, typical of a short to supply or a sensor that has failed high.

P0454.en: EVAP System Pressure Sensor/Switch A Circuit Intermittent
P0454.ru: Датчик давления/выключатель A системы EVAP, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: EVAP pressure sensor A signal jumps or drops out intermittently. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P0455.en: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected (Large Leak)

d.en: The refueling vapor control valve is stuck open. Vapor pathways meant to be closed except during refueling stay permanently open, distorting EVAP leak diagnostics and allowing vapor flow even with the fuel cap closed.

P04B4.en: Refueling Vapor Control Valve Stuck Closed

d.en: Same as P04B3 with the valve stuck closed - vapor cannot reach the canister during refueling, vapor escape from the filler is possible.

On vehicles with a motorised fuel fill door (no manual lever) the actuator and position switch report that the door is mechanically stuck open. The motor cannot retract it, typically due to a frozen or dirty hinge, broken cable, or jammed actuator.
Same as P04B5 with the door stuck closed - the user cannot refuel until the fault is cleared.

P04B7.en: Fuel Fill Door Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04B7.ru: Датчик положения лючка топливного бака, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The position sensor or switch on the fuel fill door reports an intermittent signal - opens and closes randomly without matching the actual door position. Typically a connector or chafed harness fault.

P04B8.en: Fuel Fill Door Position Sensor Circuit
P04B8.ru: Датчик положения лючка топливного бака — цепь

d.en: A general circuit fault is detected on the fuel fill door position sensor or switch - the ECU cannot determine whether the door is open or closed. Usually an open in supply, signal or ground.

P04B9.en: Fuel Fill Door Position Sensor Circuit Low
P04B9.ru: Датчик положения лючка топливного бака, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04B8 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04BA.en: Fuel Fill Door Position Sensor Circuit High
P04BA.ru: Датчик положения лючка топливного бака, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04B8 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04BB.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Circuit Open
P04BB.ru: Замок лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Circuit Open: the control circuit is open. Likely a broken wire, disconnected connector, or failed actuator.

P04BC.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Range or Performance
P04BC.ru: Замок лючка топливного бака, управление — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Range or Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command.

P04BD.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Circuit Low
P04BD.ru: Замок лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04BB with the control line shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04BE.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Control Circuit High
P04BE.ru: Замок лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04BB with the control line shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04BF.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Circuit Open
P04BF.ru: Разблокировка лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Circuit Open: the control circuit is open. Likely a broken wire, disconnected connector, or failed actuator.

P04C0.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Range or Performance
P04C0.ru: Разблокировка лючка топливного бака, управление — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Range or Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command.

P04C1.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Circuit Low
P04C1.ru: Разблокировка лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04BD on the unlock side. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04C2.en: Fuel Fill Door Unlock Control Circuit High
P04C2.ru: Разблокировка лючка топливного бака, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04BE on the unlock side. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04C3.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Position Sensor Circuit
P04C3.ru: Датчик положения замка лючка топливного бака — цепь

d.en: A general circuit fault is detected on the fuel fill door lock position sensor or switch. Without it the ECU cannot determine whether the lock has actually engaged or released.

P04C4.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Position Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P04C4.ru: Датчик положения замка лючка топливного бака, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P04C3 with feedback in plausible range yet not matching the commanded lock state.

P04C5.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Position Sensor Circuit Low
P04C5.ru: Датчик положения замка лючка топливного бака, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C3 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04C6.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Position Sensor Circuit High
P04C6.ru: Датчик положения замка лючка топливного бака, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C3 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04C7.en: Fuel Fill Door Lock Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04C7.ru: Датчик положения замка лючка топливного бака, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C3 with intermittent feedback. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04C8.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Sensor or Switch Circuit
P04C8.ru: Датчик или выключатель запроса открытия лючка топливного бака — цепь

d.en: A general circuit fault is detected on the open-request input - the button or switch the driver presses to release the fuel fill door. The ECU loses the request signal, so motorised release becomes unavailable.

P04C9.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Performance Stuck Off
P04C9.ru: Запрос открытия лючка топливного бака — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: The open-request switch never registers an active state - either the contact stays open mechanically or the wiring is permanently broken. The driver cannot trigger door release.

P04CA.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Sensor or Switch Circuit Low
P04CA.ru: Датчик или выключатель запроса открытия лючка топливного бака, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C8 with the signal voltage shorted to ground or constantly low. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04CB.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Sensor or Switch Circuit High
P04CB.ru: Датчик или выключатель запроса открытия лючка топливного бака, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C8 with the signal voltage shorted to supply or constantly high. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04CC.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Sensor or Switch Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04CC.ru: Датчик или выключатель запроса открытия лючка топливного бака, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04C8 with intermittent or erratic signal - typically a connector or harness fault. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04CD.en: Fuel Fill Door Open Request Sensor or Switch Stuck On
P04CD.ru: Датчик или выключатель запроса открытия лючка топливного бака — заклинил включённым

d.en: The open-request switch is stuck in the active state - the ECU continuously reads a request to open the fuel fill door. Either the switch is mechanically held closed or the line is shorted to its active level.
EGR Temperature Sensor C Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P04CF.en: EGR Temperature Sensor C Circuit Range or Performance
P04CF.ru: Датчик температуры EGR C, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P04CE with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model - typically sensor drift or a slow response after engine warm-up.

P04D0.en: EGR Temperature Sensor C Circuit Low
P04D0.ru: Датчик температуры EGR C, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04CE with the signal voltage below the plausible range. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04D1.en: EGR Temperature Sensor C Circuit High
P04D1.ru: Датчик температуры EGR C, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04CE with the signal voltage above the plausible range. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04D2.en: EGR Temperature Sensor C Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04D2.ru: Датчик температуры EGR C, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04CE with intermittent or erratic signal. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

The exhaust brake activation input - typically from a stalk lever, brake pedal switch, or vehicle bus message - shows a circuit fault. The ECU cannot accept a request to engage the exhaust brake, which limits engine braking on heavy vehicles.

P04D4.en: Exhaust Brake Input Circuit Range or Performance
P04D4.ru: Выхлопной тормоз, вход — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P04D3 with the signal in plausible range yet not matching expected behaviour - e.g. activation request without driver input or no response after a request.

Same as P04D3 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

Same as P04D3 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

P04D7.en: Exhaust Brake Input Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04D7.ru: Выхлопной тормоз, вход — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04D3 with intermittent or erratic signal. The exhaust control valve modulates exhaust backpressure or routing (EGR feed, sound, regen support); a malfunction shifts torque mapping and may trigger limp mode.

P04D8.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop EGR Control
P04D8.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления EGR

d.en: After cold start the ECU operates EGR open-loop until preconditions (cooler temperature, sensor warm-up, engine load) are met, then transitions into closed-loop control. The transition is taking too long - typically due to a slow EGR temperature sensor, a stuck EGR valve still warming up, or a long-trip drive cycle that does not meet load conditions.

P04D9.en: Closed Loop EGR Control At Limit Flow Too Low
P04D9.ru: Регулирование EGR в замкнутом контуре на пределе — слишком малый поток

d.en: With EGR running in closed loop the controller has driven the actuator to its maximum opening but cannot reach the required EGR flow. The valve, cooler, or pipework is restricted enough that even full open does not deliver the modelled rate.

P04DA.en: Closed Loop EGR Control At Limit Flow Too High
P04DA.ru: Регулирование EGR в замкнутом контуре на пределе — слишком большой поток

d.en: Same as P04D9 with the controller fully closing the actuator yet still measuring more EGR flow than required. The valve does not seat fully, or position feedback under-reads.

A pressure or flow sensor in the crankcase ventilation (PCV) circuit reports atmospheric conditions where it should see crankcase or intake vacuum - the hose between crankcase and intake is disconnected, cracked, or open. PCV no longer routes blow-by gases into the intake, increasing oil mist emissions and risking oil leaks.

P04DC.en: Fuel Fill Door Position Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P04DC.ru: Датчик положения лючка топливного бака, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P04B8 with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the actuator command - door reports closed when motor commanded open, or vice versa.

P04DD.en: Cold Start EGR A Flow Insufficient Detected
P04DD.ru: Холодный пуск: обнаружен недостаточный поток EGR A

d.en: During the cold-start strategy the ECU briefly opens EGR A to slow combustion temperatures and reduce engine-out NOx during catalyst light-off. The measured EGR flow stays below the calibrated target despite the requested opening - typically a stuck-closed valve, restricted cold-start path, or sensor offset that under-reports flow.

P04DE.en: Cold Start EGR A Flow Excessive Detected
P04DE.ru: Холодный пуск: обнаружен чрезмерный поток EGR A

d.en: Same as P04DD with EGR flow above the cold-start target - typically valve sticking open during the cold phase or position sensor offset low.

P04DF.en: EVAP System Purge Control Valve A Performance Stuck Open
P04DF.ru: Клапан A управления продувкой системы EVAP — характеристика / заклинил открытым

d.en: EVAP System Purge Control Valve A Performance Stuck Open: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command.

P04E0.en: EVAP System Purge Control Valve A Stuck Closed
P04E0.ru: Клапан A управления продувкой системы EVAP — заклинил закрытым

d.en: Same as P04AF on EVAP purge valve A. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P04E1.en: Crankcase Ventilation Hose Connection Sensor Circuit
P04E1.ru: Датчик подключения шланга вентиляции картера — цепь

d.en: A dedicated sensor monitors whether the PCV hose is fitted to its connector at the engine. The ECU detects a circuit fault on this sensor - cannot determine whether the hose is connected. Required by some emissions regulations to flag a disconnected PCV hose immediately.

P04E2.en: Crankcase Ventilation Hose Connection Sensor Circuit Low
P04E2.ru: Датчик подключения шланга вентиляции картера — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04E1 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04E3.en: Crankcase Ventilation Hose Connection Sensor Circuit High
P04E3.ru: Датчик подключения шланга вентиляции картера — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04E1 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04E4.en: Crankcase Ventilation Hose Connection Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04E4.ru: Датчик подключения шланга вентиляции картера — прерывистый сигнал / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04E1 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
EGR Temperature Sensor D Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. Without valid EGR feedback the ECU disables exhaust gas recirculation and may set further EGR codes.

P04E6.en: EGR Temperature Sensor D Circuit Range or Performance
P04E6.ru: Датчик температуры EGR D, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P04CF on EGR temperature sensor D. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04E7.en: EGR Temperature Sensor D Circuit Low
P04E7.ru: Датчик температуры EGR D, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04D0 on EGR temperature sensor D. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04E8.en: EGR Temperature Sensor D Circuit High
P04E8.ru: Датчик температуры EGR D, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P04D1 on EGR temperature sensor D. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04E9.en: EGR Temperature Sensor D Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P04E9.ru: Датчик температуры EGR D, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P04D2 on EGR temperature sensor D. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P04EA.en: EVAP System Small Leak Detected Fuel Tank Side
P04EA.ru: Система EVAP — малая утечка на стороне топливного бака

d.en: The EVAP leak diagnostic has detected a small leak on the fuel tank side of the system - typically a hose, gasket, fuel cap, or fuel sender flange that does not seal completely. Vapor escapes during pressure or vacuum tests.

P04EB.en: EVAP System Small Leak Detected Fresh Air Side
P04EB.ru: Система EVAP — малая утечка на стороне свежего воздуха

d.en: Same as P04EA but on the fresh-air side - the path between vent valve and atmosphere is not sealing completely during the active test phase.

P04EC.en: EVAP System Large Leak Detected Fuel Tank Side
P04EC.ru: Система EVAP — большая утечка на стороне топливного бака

d.en: Same as P04EA but the leak is large enough that the system cannot build the test pressure or vacuum at all - typically a missing fuel cap, an unseated hose or a torn vapor line on the tank side.

P04ED.en: EVAP System Large Leak Detected Fresh Air Side
P04ED.ru: Система EVAP — большая утечка на стороне свежего воздуха

d.en: Same as P04EB on the fresh-air side, but with a leak large enough to prevent test build-up. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P04EE.en: EVAP System Very Small Leak Detected Fuel Tank Side
P04EE.ru: Система EVAP — очень малая утечка на стороне топливного бака

d.en: Same as P04EA but at the most sensitive leak threshold - typically the OBD-II 0.020-inch (~0.5 mm) test. The system holds pressure for some time but loses it slower than the diagnostic limit allows; usually fuel cap O-ring fatigue or microcracks in a hose.

P04EF.en: EVAP System Very Small Leak Detected Fresh Air Side
P04EF.ru: Система EVAP — очень малая утечка на стороне свежего воздуха

d.en: Same as P04EE on the fresh-air side - microcrack in a hose or imperfect vent valve seal at the most sensitive test threshold.

P04F0.en: EVAP System High Load Purge Line A Performance
P04F0.ru: Система EVAP, линия продувки A при высокой нагрузке — характеристика

d.en: On engines that have a separate high-load purge line - to use boost pressure to pull vapor on turbo applications - the ECU monitors flow when this path is commanded. The flow is below the expected level - the venturi, line, or check valve is restricted, or the line is incorrectly routed.

A general performance fault on the EVAP purge line - flow does not match the requested rate, without specifying which segment. Usually a partially blocked line, a stuck purge valve, or a leak that decouples flow from valve commands.

The electric catalyst heater on bank 1 - used on hybrids and modern petrol cars to bring the catalyst above light-off temperature within seconds of cold start - reports that its supply voltage is outside the expected window. The heater cannot deliver the rated power, so cold-start emissions rise until the catalyst reaches light-off conventionally.

The electric catalyst heater on bank 2 - used on hybrids and modern petrol cars to bring the catalyst above light-off temperature within seconds of cold start - reports that its supply voltage is outside the expected window. The heater cannot deliver the rated power, so cold-start emissions rise until the catalyst reaches light-off conventionally.
The control or supply line to the electric catalyst heater on bank 1 is shorted to ground or measures below the expected voltage when the heater is commanded on.
The control or supply line to the electric catalyst heater on bank 2 is shorted to ground or measures below the expected voltage when the heater is commanded on.
Same as P04F4 with the line shorted to supply or open - the ECU measures higher voltage than the commanded duty cycle allows.

Same as P04F6 on bank 2. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
Same as P04F4 with intermittent or erratic signal - typically a connector or harness fault on the heater feed.

Same as P04F8 on bank 2. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P04FA.en: EGR A Control Temperature Too High
P04FA.ru: Клапан EGR A — слишком высокая температура

d.en: The ECU monitors the operating temperature of the EGR A actuator (or its control electronics). The reading has exceeded the safe upper threshold and the control unit derates or disables EGR A to protect the actuator from thermal damage.

P04FB.en: Crankcase Ventilation Hose Connection Sensor Range or Performance
P04FB.ru: Датчик подключения шланга вентиляции картера — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The sensor that monitors PCV hose connection reports a value within plausible range yet inconsistent with the engine model - signal does not switch when the hose is moved during diagnosis, or shows offset against actual hose state.

A general performance fault of the crankcase ventilation system - PCV pressure or flow does not match the engine model. Possible causes are a clogged PCV valve, blocked separator, oil-filler cap with a damaged seal, or excessive blow-by from worn rings.

P04FD.en: EGR Actuator A Control Processor Performance
P04FD.ru: Привод EGR A — характеристика процессора управления

d.en: Modern smart EGR actuators contain their own microcontroller that handles position control internally and reports back over LIN or PWM. The ECU detects implausible behaviour from the actuator processor - missed messages, incorrect responses, or watchdog resets.

The catalyst heater on bank 1 is electrically intact but does not deliver the expected thermal effect - measured catalyst light-off time is longer than calibrated. Heater element ageing, increased contact resistance, or a partial winding failure are typical causes.

The catalyst heater on bank 2 is electrically intact but does not deliver the expected thermal effect - measured catalyst light-off time is longer than calibrated. Heater element ageing, increased contact resistance, or a partial winding failure are typical causes.

The vehicle speed sensor (VSS) signal is missing or implausible. On automatic transmissions this often disables cruise control and shift adaptation; ABS-equipped cars typically derive speed from wheel speed sensors as a fallback.

The VSS signal is present but inconsistent — either values jump implausibly or the sensor reports a speed inconsistent with engine RPM in gear. Often a damaged reluctor ring or a sensor with degraded magnetic response.

P0502.en: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Circuit Low

d.en: The primary vehicle speed sensor (VSS A) reports a signal voltage below the plausible lower limit. With no usable speed signal the ECU loses cruise control, gear-shift logic and certain anti-stall functions.

P0503.en: Vehicle Speed Sensor A Circuit Intermittent Erratic or High
P0503.ru: Датчик скорости A — прерывистый, нестабильный или высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P0502 with the signal noisy, erratic or above the plausible upper limit - typical for a chafed harness, missing reluctor tooth or a sensor with a weakened magnet.

Modern vehicles use two redundant brake switch signals (often one normally-open and one normally-closed). When the two signals disagree, this code is set; common causes include a misadjusted switch, internal switch failure, or wiring fault.

A general fault has been detected in the idle air control (IAC) system. On older vehicles with a separate IAC valve, this means the valve cannot maintain commanded idle RPM; on drive-by-wire systems, the equivalent fault is in the throttle body's idle adaptation.

P0506.en: Idle Air Control System RPM Lower Than Expected
P0506.ru: Система регулятора холостого хода — обороты ниже ожидаемых

d.en: The engine idles below the target RPM despite the IAC opening fully. Indicates restricted air path past the IAC — typically a heavily fouled throttle body or stuck IAC valve.

P0507.en: Idle Air Control System RPM Higher Than Expected
P0507.ru: Система регулятора холостого хода — обороты выше ожидаемых

d.en: Idle RPM exceeds the target despite the IAC commanded fully closed. Almost always caused by a vacuum leak that lets air bypass the IAC — torn intake hose, leaking PCV, brake booster, or intake manifold gasket.

P0508.en: Idle Air Control System Circuit Low
P0508.ru: Система регулятора холостого хода — низкий сигнал

d.en: The control line to the idle air control valve - which opens a small bypass around the throttle to set idle airflow - is shorted to ground or measures a voltage below the plausible level.

P0509.en: Idle Air Control System Circuit High
P0509.ru: Система регулятора холостого хода — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P0508 with the line shorted to supply or open. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P050A.en: Cold Start Idle Control System Performance
P050A.ru: Холодный пуск: система управления холостым ходом — характеристика

d.en: During the cold-start phase the ECU runs an elevated idle speed and a richer mixture to bring the catalyst above light-off temperature quickly. The cold-start idle does not behave as commanded - speed sags, hunts, or fails to come up. Possible causes are intake leaks active when cold, an IAC valve sticking, or implausible coolant temperature.

P050B.ru: Холодный пуск: угол опережения зажигания — характеристика

d.en: During cold-start the ECU retards ignition timing to raise exhaust temperature for catalyst light-off. The strategy does not deliver the expected timing - feedback from knock sensor or combustion model shows ignition too far advanced or retarded for the demanded calibration.

P050C.en: Cold Start Engine Coolant Temperature Performance

d.en: During cold-start the ECU expects coolant temperature to rise within a calibrated time window. Either the engine warms up too slowly (stuck-open thermostat, weak combustion) or the temperature signal does not reflect the actual warm-up.

The ECU detects rough idle behaviour during the cold-start phase only. Once the engine has warmed up the issue disappears. Typically caused by injector deposits, low compression on one cylinder when cold, or sticky valve guides.

P050E.en: Cold Start Engine Exhaust Temperature Too Low
P050E.ru: Холодный пуск: температура выхлопа двигателя слишком низкая

d.en: During the cold-start strategy the ECU monitors exhaust temperature to ensure catalyst light-off. The measured EGT remains below the target threshold within the allowed time - heat-up strategy is not effective. Causes include excessive heat loss, very rich mixture cooling the exhaust, or a faulty EGT sensor.

The ECU monitors the vacuum supplied to the brake booster (either via a dedicated sensor or via intake manifold pressure). The level has dropped below the calibrated threshold; brake-pedal feel will be hard, and an electric vacuum pump may be commanded to restore vacuum.

The dedicated closed-throttle switch (or closed-throttle bit on the TPS) does not behave as expected - either it never activates, never deactivates, or shows incoherent state against TPS voltage and engine load. Used by older systems for fuel-cutoff and idle recognition.
A general circuit fault is detected on the idle air control valve - open or short on supply, signal or ground. The ECU loses control of idle bypass airflow.

The starter request input - the signal that tells the ECU the driver wants to crank the engine - shows a circuit fault. Without it the engine cannot be started under software-managed start strategies (stop-start, push-button, immobiliser-coordinated start).

The immobiliser system has detected a key that is not authorised for this vehicle. Engine start is blocked. Possible causes are an unprogrammed replacement key, a transponder fault, or a deliberate attempt to start with the wrong key.

P0514.en: Battery Temperature Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P0514.ru: Датчик температуры аккумулятора — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The battery temperature sensor reports a value within plausible range yet inconsistent with engine bay or coolant temperature. Modern alternator regulation uses battery temperature to adjust charging voltage, so an offset here causes over- or undercharging.
A general circuit fault is detected on the battery temperature sensor - open or short on supply, signal or ground.

Same as P0515 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

Same as P0515 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

Same as P0511 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The idle air control system is electrically intact, but the actual idle airflow does not match the commanded value - typical for a sticky valve, intake leak, or carbon build-up around the throttle bore.

P051D.ru: Датчик давления в картере A — высокий сигнал

P051E.en: Crankcase Pressure Sensor A Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P051E.ru: Датчик давления в картере A — прерывистый сигнал / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P051A with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The pressure or flow sensor in the PCV path detects increased restriction across the oil-mist filter element. Once saturated with oil mist, the filter no longer passes blow-by gas, raising crankcase pressure and pushing oil past seals.

P0520.en: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor or Switch A Circuit
P0520.ru: Датчик или выключатель давления масла двигателя A — цепь

d.en: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor or Switch A Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P0521.ru: Датчик/выключатель давления масла двигателя — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The engine oil pressure sensor or switch reports values that are not plausible for current RPM, oil temperature, and engine load. Could indicate a sensor fault or genuinely abnormal pressure.

P0522.en: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor/Switch Low Voltage
P0522.ru: Датчик/выключатель давления масла двигателя — низкое напряжение

d.en: The oil pressure sensor signal is below the expected minimum. Often points to an electrical fault — short to ground or failed sensor — but can also indicate genuinely low oil pressure.

P0523.en: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor or Switch A High
P0523.ru: Датчик или выключатель давления масла двигателя A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P0520 with the signal voltage above the plausible range - usually a short to supply or sensor failure that pegs the output high.

The ECU has determined that engine oil pressure is below the safe operating threshold. Caused by low oil level, worn oil pump, severe engine wear, or a stuck pressure relief valve. Continued operation can rapidly destroy the engine.

P0525.en: Cruise Control Servo Control Circuit Range or Performance
P0525.ru: Сервопривод круиз-контроля, цепь управления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The control circuit to the cruise control servo (vacuum or electric actuator that holds throttle position) shows feedback in plausible range yet inconsistent with the commanded action - servo slow, sticking, or supply weak.
A general circuit fault on the cooling fan tachometer feedback - the ECU loses fan speed information needed to verify cooling capacity and detect a stalled or runaway fan.

P0527.en: Fan Speed Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P0527.ru: Датчик оборотов вентилятора, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

P052A.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала A слишком опережена, банк 1

P052B.en: Cold Start A Camshaft Position Timing Over-Retarded Bank 1
P052B.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала A слишком отстаёт, банк 1

P052C.en: Cold Start A Camshaft Position Timing Over-Advanced Bank 2
P052C.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала A слишком опережена, банк 2

P052D.en: Cold Start A Camshaft Position Timing Over-Retarded Bank 2
P052D.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала A слишком отстаёт, банк 2

d.en: Same as P052B on bank 2. The camshaft position sensor identifies which cylinder is on the compression stroke — without it the ECM cannot run sequential injection or coil-on-plug ignition correctly.

The crankcase ventilation regulator valve - which throttles blow-by gas flow toward the intake based on engine load - is electrically intact but does not deliver the modelled pressure regulation. Either the valve diaphragm is fatigued or the spring is weak.

P052F.en: Glow Plug Control Module 1 System Voltage
P052F.ru: Блок управления свечами накаливания 1 — напряжение системы

d.en: Glow Plug Control Module 1 System Voltage: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects diesel cold-start preheating.
General electrical fault on the A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. The ECU uses this signal to enable the compressor and cooling fan; without it the A/C is typically disabled.

P0531.ru: Датчик давления хладагента — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The A/C refrigerant pressure sensor signal is implausible against operating conditions. Reading does not change as expected when the compressor cycles or ambient conditions change.

P0532.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor "A" Circuit Low

d.en: A/C pressure sensor signal voltage below the lower threshold — open, short to ground, sensor fault, or a refrigerant charge so low that the pressure is genuinely low.

P0533.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor "A" Circuit High

d.en: A/C pressure sensor signal voltage above the upper threshold — short to supply, defective sensor, or a system overcharge/blocked condenser causing genuine high pressure.
The system detects an abnormally low refrigerant charge. Compressor operation is typically inhibited to prevent damage.
The evaporator temperature sensor signal is missing or out of range. Used to prevent icing of the evaporator core.

P0536.en: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P0536.ru: Датчик температуры испарителя A/C — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The evaporator temperature sensor used to prevent evaporator icing reports a value within plausible range yet not matching the engine model or cabin conditions.

P0537.en: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Low
P0537.ru: Датчик температуры испарителя A/C — низкий сигнал

d.en: The evaporator temperature sensor signal voltage is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Indicates a short to ground or sensor fault.

P0538.en: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit High
P0538.ru: Датчик температуры испарителя A/C — высокий сигнал

d.en: The evaporator temperature sensor signal voltage is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Typically open circuit or short to power.

P0539.en: A/C Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
P0539.ru: Датчик температуры испарителя A/C — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Same as P0536 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P053A.en: PCV Heater A Control Circuit Open
P053A.ru: Подогрев PCV A — цепь управления, обрыв

d.en: The heater on PCV path A - used to prevent ice plugs in the crankcase ventilation hose during cold weather - has an open control circuit. Without it, condensation can freeze and block PCV flow, raising crankcase pressure dangerously.

P053B.en: PCV Heater A Control Circuit Low
P053B.ru: Подогрев PCV A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P053A with the control line shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P053C.en: PCV Heater A Control Circuit High
P053C.ru: Подогрев PCV A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

The PCV heater on path A is electrically intact but does not deliver the expected thermal effect - hose temperature does not rise as commanded. Heater element aged or contact resistance increased.

The crankcase pressure sensor reports a value above the safe upper threshold. Excessive crankcase pressure pushes oil past seals and contaminates the PCV path with mist - causes are clogged PCV system, frozen breather hose, or excessive blow-by from worn rings.

P053F.ru: Холодный пуск: давление топлива — характеристика, банк 1

The pressure target on bank 1 is not reached within the calibrated time window - typical for a high-pressure pump that loses output when cold or a pressure regulator with cold-stickiness.
Intake Air Heater A Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. Used on diesel and some petrol engines for cold-start emissions and starting reliability.

P0541.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Low
P0541.ru: Нагреватель впускного воздуха A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Used on diesel and some petrol engines for cold-start emissions and starting reliability.

P0542.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit High
P0542.ru: Нагреватель впускного воздуха A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit High: the signal voltage is above the expected range. Used on diesel and some petrol engines for cold-start emissions and starting reliability.

P0543.en: Intake Air Heater A Circuit Open

d.en: The intake air heater (grid heater) on path A - used on cold-start of diesel engines to warm intake air for reliable combustion - has an open control circuit. Without it, cold-start emissions and idle quality on cold days suffer.

P0544.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 1

P0545.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, банк 1, датчик 1 — низкий сигнал

P0546.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, банк 1, датчик 1 — высокий сигнал

P0547.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Bank 2 Sensor 1
P0547.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 1

P0548.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Bank 2 Sensor 1
P0548.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 1 — низкий сигнал

P0549.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit High Bank 2 Sensor 1
P0549.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 1 — высокий сигнал

d.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit High Bank 2 Sensor 1: the signal voltage is above the expected range. The ECU uses this temperature to protect the catalyst and diesel particulate filter.

P054A.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала B слишком опережена, банк 1

P054B.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала B слишком отстаёт, банк 1

P054C.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала B слишком опережена, банк 2

P0551.ru: Датчик давления усилителя руля — вне диапазона / характеристика

P0552.ru: Датчик давления усилителя руля — цепь, низкий сигнал

P0553.ru: Датчик давления усилителя руля — цепь, высокий сигнал

P0554.ru: Датчик давления усилителя руля — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The power steering pressure sensor signal is intermittent. The ECM cannot consistently raise idle to compensate for steering load.

P0556.en: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit Range or Performance
P0556.ru: Датчик давления усилителя тормозов — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P0555 with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model - drift, partial blockage of the reference port.

P055E.ru: Блок управления датчиками O2 — напряжение системы

d.en: The dedicated O2 sensor control module - found on systems with a wide-band sensor needing its own pumping current driver - reports its supply voltage outside the calibrated window.

P055F.en: Engine Oil Pressure Out of Range

d.en: The measured oil pressure is far outside the expected range for current engine speed and oil temperature - either too low (oil pump weak, oil level low, bearing wear) or anomalously high (relief valve stuck closed, blocked oil cooler).

A general fault in the system voltage seen by the ECU — value implausible, missing, or unstable but without crossing the specific thresholds of P0562 (low) or P0563 (high). Often appears intermittently with a marginal alternator or weak battery.

The ECU monitors battery voltage and detects unstable behaviour - rapid fluctuations beyond what current load changes explain. Typical causes are a failing alternator, loose battery terminals, weak battery, or a heavy load (radiator fan, glow plugs, heated screen) drawing voltage down briefly.

Battery / charging system voltage seen by the ECU has dropped below the lower threshold (typically around 10.5 V). Modern ECUs are sensitive to under-voltage and may set this code briefly during cranking on a weak battery.

Battery / charging system voltage seen by the ECU exceeds the upper threshold (typically around 16 V). Caused by a failing voltage regulator inside the alternator. Sustained over-voltage can damage other electronics.

P0564.en: Cruise Control Multi-Function Input A Circuit

d.en: Cruise Control Multi-Function Input A Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects cruise-control operation.

Cruise Control Cancel Input Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects cruise-control operation.
Cruise Control Resume Input Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects cruise-control operation.
Cruise Control Set Input Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects cruise-control operation.

Cruise Control Increase Distance Signal: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects cruise-control operation.
Cruise Control Decrease Distance Signal: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects cruise-control operation.
The cancel signal (driver-initiated cruise off) reports an implausible state - stuck, missing, or shorted.

P05C9.ru: Выключатель экономичного режима, цепь — низкий сигнал

P05CC.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала A — характеристика, банк 1

P05CF.ru: Холодный пуск: фаза распредвала B — характеристика, банк 2

P05D6.en: Driver Mode Select Switch B Circuit High
P05D6.ru: Переключатель режимов водителя B — высокий сигнал

P05D8.ru: Регулирующий клапан PCV — цепь управления, обрыв

d.en: The control circuit of the electrically actuated PCV regulator valve has an open circuit. The ECU cannot adjust crankcase ventilation flow against engine load - typically affects emissions and oil consumption under high load.

P05D9.en: PCV Regulator Valve Control Circuit Low
P05D9.ru: Регулирующий клапан PCV — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

P05DA.en: PCV Regulator Valve Control Circuit High
P05DA.ru: Регулирующий клапан PCV — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05D8 with the control line shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05DB.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit Open
P05DB.ru: Датчик положения педали тормоза B — обрыв цепи

d.en: The brake pedal position sensor B has an open control circuit. The ECU loses analogue feedback about pedal travel - used by stop-start, regenerative braking and adaptive cruise to coordinate engine, motor and friction brakes.

P05DC.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit Range or Performance
P05DC.ru: Датчик положения педали тормоза B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P057B on sensor B.

P05DD.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit Low
P05DD.ru: Датчик положения педали тормоза B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P057C on sensor B. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05DE.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit High
P05DE.ru: Датчик положения педали тормоза B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P057D on sensor B. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05DF.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor B Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P05DF.ru: Датчик положения педали тормоза B — прерывистый сигнал / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P057E on sensor B. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05E0.en: Brake Pedal Position Sensor A and B Correlation
P05E0.ru: Датчики положения педали тормоза A и B — рассогласование

d.en: Brake-by-wire and electronic brake systems use two redundant pedal position sensors. Their readings disagree by more than the diagnostic tolerance - one or both has drifted, or wiring picks up noise on one channel.

P05E1.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor A Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P05E1.ru: Датчик давления хладагента A — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The high-side refrigerant pressure sensor A reports intermittent or erratic signal - typically a connector or harness fault on the sensor that lives close to the compressor.

P05E2.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P05E2.ru: Датчик давления хладагента B — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The high-side refrigerant pressure sensor B reports intermittent or erratic signal - typically a connector or harness fault on the sensor that lives close to the compressor.

P05E3.en: Park Brake Sensor or Switch Circuit
P05E3.ru: Датчик или выключатель стояночного тормоза — цепь

d.en: The park brake apply switch or position sensor reports a circuit fault. The ECU loses the indication whether the parking brake is engaged - relevant for stop-start, hill-hold, and certain shift-interlock strategies.

P05E4.en: Park Brake Sensor or Switch Circuit Low
P05E4.ru: Датчик или выключатель стояночного тормоза — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05E3 with the signal shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05E5.en: Park Brake Sensor or Switch Circuit High
P05E5.ru: Датчик или выключатель стояночного тормоза — цепь, высокий сигнал

P05E6.ru: Датчик или выключатель стояночного тормоза — цепь, вне диапазона / характеристика
