P05E7.en: Park Brake Sensor or Switch Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P05E7.ru: Датчик или выключатель стояночного тормоза — цепь, нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P05E3 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05E8.en: Engine Oil Bypass Valve Control Circuit Open
P05E8.ru: Перепускной масляный клапан двигателя, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The oil bypass valve - which routes oil around the cooler to speed up warm-up - has an open control circuit. Without it, oil temperature rise during cold-start is slower than calibrated.

P05E9.en: Engine Oil Bypass Valve Control Circuit Low
P05E9.ru: Перепускной масляный клапан двигателя, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05E8 with the control line shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05EA.en: Engine Oil Bypass Valve Control Circuit High
P05EA.ru: Перепускной масляный клапан двигателя, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05E8 with the control line shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05EB.en: Cold Start SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too Low
P05EB.ru: Холодный пуск: температура на входе катализатора SCR NOx слишком низкая

d.en: Same as P22FF but specifically during the cold-start window - the SCR catalyst inlet temperature does not reach the threshold needed for NOx reduction in the cold-start phase, so reductant injection cannot be enabled.

During cold-start the ECU adjusts injection timing (post-injection on diesels, intake-stroke timing on direct-injection petrols) to support catalyst light-off. The strategy does not deliver the expected timing - injector response slow or sensor offset.

P05ED.en: Reductant Heater Control Module Supply Voltage
P05ED.ru: Блок управления подогревом реагента — напряжение питания

d.en: The reductant (AdBlue) heater control module - which warms tank, lines and injector to keep AdBlue from freezing - reports its supply voltage outside the calibrated window.

P05EE.en: Reductant Pump Supply Voltage Circuit Open

d.en: The supply line that powers the AdBlue dosing pump is open. Without supply the pump cannot deliver reductant pressure - dosing is suspended and NOx emissions can drift out of compliance.

P05EF.en: Reductant Pump Supply Voltage Circuit Low
P05EF.ru: Питание насоса реагента — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05EE with the supply voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05F0.en: Reductant Pump Supply Voltage Circuit High
P05F0.ru: Питание насоса реагента — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05EE with the supply voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05F1.en: Reductant Pump Supply Voltage Circuit Stuck On
P05F1.ru: Питание насоса реагента — цепь, заклинил включённым

d.en: The supply relay or driver for the reductant pump is welded or stuck active - the pump runs continuously, even with the engine off, draining the battery and over-pressurising the dosing circuit.

P05F2.en: Reductant Pump Supply Voltage Circuit Stuck Off
P05F2.ru: Питание насоса реагента — цепь, заклинил выключенным

d.en: Same as P05EE with the supply stuck off - relay does not energise on command.

P05F3.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Power Relay Control Circuit Open
P05F3.ru: Реле питания системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The power relay that supplies the entire exhaust aftertreatment system (DOC, DPF, SCR sensors and heaters) reports an open control circuit. Aftertreatment effectively goes offline.

P05F4.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Power Relay Control Circuit Low
P05F4.ru: Реле питания системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05F3 with the control line shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05F5.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Power Relay Control Circuit High
P05F5.ru: Реле питания системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P05F3 with the control line shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05F6.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Power Relay Control Circuit Stuck On
P05F6.ru: Реле питания системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — заклинило включённым

d.en: The aftertreatment power relay is stuck on - aftertreatment electronics stay powered after key-off, draining the battery.

P05F7.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Power Relay Control Circuit Stuck Off
P05F7.ru: Реле питания системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — заклинило выключенным

d.en: Same as P05F3 with the relay not engaging on command.
The reductant heater module is electrically intact but does not deliver the expected thermal effect - heater elements aged, supply line resistance, or thermostat sensor offset.
A general circuit fault on the stop-start status signal - the bus or hardwire that tells other modules whether the engine is auto-stopped or running.

Same as P05F9 with the signal shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

Same as P05F9 with the signal shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P05FC.en: Cold Start Fuel Pressure Performance Bank 2
P05FC.ru: Холодный пуск: давление топлива — характеристика, банк 2

d.en: During cold-start the ECU runs an elevated rail pressure on direct-injection systems for better cold spray atomisation. The pressure target on bank 2 is not reached within the calibrated time window - typical for a high-pressure pump that loses output when cold or a pressure regulator with cold-stickiness.

P05FD.en: Turbocharger Boost Control A Temperature Too High
P05FD.ru: Управление наддувом турбины A — слишком высокая температура

d.en: The boost control actuator A reports excessive operating temperature - typically heat soak from the turbo housing, prolonged high-load operation, or insufficient cooling. Boost is derated to protect the actuator electronics.

P05FE.en: Active Grille Air Shutter C Performance Stuck Off
P05FE.ru: Заслонка C активной решётки — характеристика / заклинила выключенной

d.en: Active Grille Air Shutter C Performance Stuck Off: the actuator is stuck in the off position. Active grille shutters manage airflow for engine cooling and aerodynamics.

P05FF.en: Brake Pressure Sensor and Brake Pedal Position Sensor Correlation
P05FF.ru: Датчик давления в тормозной системе и датчик положения педали тормоза — рассогласование

d.en: The brake pressure sensor and pedal position sensor disagree by more than the diagnostic tolerance - one indicates pedal action without the other showing pressure, or vice versa.

A general fault on a serial communication link - typically used by older single-wire diagnostic protocols (KWP2000, ISO 9141) before CAN became universal. ECU has lost or corrupted communication with another module.

P0601.en: Internal Control Module Memory Check Sum Error
P0601.ru: Внутри блока управления: ошибка контрольной суммы памяти

d.en: The ECU's internal memory checksum does not match the expected value at startup — the firmware/calibration in flash has become corrupt. Often appears after a failed flash, low battery during programming, or genuine module hardware failure.

The ECU is reporting that it is missing required calibration data — typically appears after a virgin module is installed but never coded/programmed for the vehicle, or after a flash that did not write all blocks.

P0603.en: Internal Control Module Keep Alive Memory (KAM) Error
P0603.ru: Внутри блока управления: ошибка энергонезависимой памяти (KAM)

d.en: The ECU detected a fault in its KAM (battery-backed memory used to store adaptations and DTCs). Often appears after battery disconnect or low battery; persistent codes indicate an internal ECU fault.

P0604.en: Internal Control Module Random Access Memory (RAM) Error
P0604.ru: Внутри блока управления: ошибка оперативной памяти (RAM)

d.en: ECU self-test detected a RAM fault during runtime checks. This is an internal ECU defect; replacement or reflash with manufacturer support is generally required.

P0605.en: Internal Control Module Read Only Memory (ROM) Error
P0605.ru: Внутри блока управления: ошибка постоянной памяти (ROM)

d.en: ECU self-test detected a ROM/checksum failure on the program memory. The control software cannot be trusted; vehicle typically defaults to limp-home with reduced function.
The ECU's internal processor self-test has failed. This is a hard module fault — the ECU usually triggers limp-home mode and may not respond to scan tools fully until replaced or repaired.
The ECM performs an internal self-test and detects a processor or memory performance fault that does not fit the more specific P0601 to P0606 codes.
The vehicle speed signal output from the control module to other systems is faulty. Other modules expect a speed signal that the ECM no longer provides correctly.

A fault is detected on the secondary vehicle speed signal output (VSS B) that the ECU sends to other modules (instrument cluster, ABS, transmission). Output level inconsistent with the internal speed value.

P060A.en: Internal Control Module Monitoring Processor Performance
P060A.ru: Внутри блока управления: процессор мониторинга, характеристика

d.en: Modern ECUs have a separate watchdog or monitoring processor that supervises the main processor. This processor reports a self-diagnosis fault - typically a watchdog event, ROM/RAM mismatch, or check-sum error in its monitor section. The ECU runs in a safety-fallback mode until repair.

P060B.en: Internal Control Module A and D Processing Performance
P060B.ru: Внутри блока управления: обработка A и D, характеристика

d.en: The ECU's analog-to-digital converter does not deliver consistent results - typically reference voltage drift, multiplexer fault, or noise on the analog ground.

P060C.en: Internal Control Module Main Processor Performance
P060C.ru: Внутри блока управления: главный процессор, характеристика

d.en: The ECU main processor self-diagnosis flagged a performance fault - watchdog, ROM check, or instruction-set self-test failed. Engine runs on safety strategy.

P060D.en: Internal Control Module Accelerator Pedal Position Performance
P060D.ru: Внутри блока управления: положение педали газа, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "accelerator pedal position" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P060E.en: Internal Control Module Throttle Position Performance
P060E.ru: Внутри блока управления: положение дросселя, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "throttle position" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P060F.en: Internal Control Module Coolant Temperature Performance
P060F.ru: Внутри блока управления: температура ОЖ, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "engine coolant temperature" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.
The ECU's stored vehicle option configuration is invalid or does not match the connected hardware. Common after replacing or swapping a control module without proper coding/configuration.

Modern direct-injection systems use a dedicated injector driver module that generates the high-voltage charge pulses needed to open piezo or solenoid injectors. The module reports an internal performance fault.

P0612.en: Fuel Injector Control Module Relay Control

d.en: A circuit fault on the relay that powers the injector driver module - either control line or contact integrity issue.
The transmission control module performs an internal self-test and detects a processor performance fault.

The ECM and TCM exchange identification or calibration data over the powertrain bus and detect that they are not a valid pair - typically appears after replacing one of the modules with a unit from a different vehicle variant.
General electrical fault on the starter relay control circuit driven by the ECU/PCM. Typical symptom is a no-crank or intermittent crank condition.
The control line for starter relay A is shorted to ground - the ECU drives the relay and measures voltage too low.
The starter relay control circuit voltage is above the upper threshold — short to supply or stuck driver.

P0618.en: Alternative Fuel Control Module KAM Error
P0618.ru: Блок управления альтернативным топливом — ошибка KAM

d.en: The control module for alternative fuel (CNG, LPG, hydrogen) reports a Keep-Alive-Memory error - persistent calibration values are corrupt or unreadable. Adaptive learning is reset.

P0619.en: Alternative Fuel Control Module RAM and ROM Error
P0619.ru: Блок управления альтернативным топливом — ошибка RAM и ROM

d.en: The alternative fuel control module reports an internal RAM or ROM check failure - module no longer trustworthy.

P061A.ru: Внутри блока управления: крутящий момент, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "engine torque" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P061B.en: Internal Control Module Torque Calculation Performance
P061B.ru: Внутри блока управления: расчёт момента, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "torque calculation" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P061C.en: Internal Control Module Engine RPM Performance
P061C.ru: Внутри блока управления: обороты двигателя, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "engine speed (RPM)" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P061D.en: Internal Control Module Engine Air Mass Performance
P061D.ru: Внутри блока управления: масса воздуха, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "intake air mass" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P061E.en: Internal Control Module Brake Signal Performance
P061E.ru: Внутри блока управления: сигнал тормоза, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "brake signal" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P061F.en: Internal Control Module Throttle Actuator Controller Performance
P061F.ru: Внутри блока управления: контроллер привода дросселя, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "throttle actuator control" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

General electrical fault detected in the alternator/generator control circuit. The ECU regulates field excitation on most modern alternators; a fault here causes charging issues and may set additional battery voltage codes.
The control circuit for the generator warning lamp output (L terminal) reports a fault.

P0622.ru: Обмотка возбуждения генератора F — управление, цепь

d.en: The control circuit for the generator field terminal (F) reports a fault. The ECM cannot regulate field current as expected.
Generic generator warning lamp control circuit fault, often used where the lamp terminal designation is not L or where multiple lamps share a single output.
The control circuit for the fuel cap warning lamp reports a fault. The ECM cannot drive the indicator that warns of an open or loose fuel cap.

P0625.ru: Клемма обмотки возбуждения генератора — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the alternator F terminal (field excitation) is below threshold — open or short to ground in the excitation path.

P0626.ru: Клемма F/обмотка возбуждения генератора — цепь, характеристика

d.en: The generator field circuit response does not match command. Field current ramps slowly, drifts or fails to reach commanded values during regulation.
The ECU detected an open circuit in the fuel pump A control output. With no pump operation the engine cannot run; this code is often paired with no-start and no fuel pressure.

P0628.en: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit Low
P0628.ru: Топливный насос A, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit Low: the control-circuit voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.

P0629.en: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit High
P0629.ru: Топливный насос A, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit High: the control-circuit voltage is above the expected range. Often an open circuit or a short to supply voltage.

P062A.en: Fuel Pump A Control Circuit Range or Performance
P062A.ru: Топливный насос A, цепь управления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The control output to the primary fuel pump A is electrically intact yet response and fuel pressure response do not match - typically a worn pump, a clogged strainer, or a partially shorted PWM driver.

P062B.en: Internal Control Module Fuel Injector Control Performance
P062B.ru: Внутри блока управления: управление форсунками, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "fuel injector control" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P062D.en: Fuel Injector Driver Circuit Performance Bank 1

d.en: The injector driver stage on bank 1 - the high-side or low-side switching transistor that fires the injectors - reports a performance fault. Typical for a partial driver short, drift in the boost capacitor, or supply ripple under load.

P062E.en: Fuel Injector Driver Circuit Performance Bank 2

d.en: The injector driver stage on bank 2 - the high-side or low-side switching transistor that fires the injectors - reports a performance fault. Typical for a partial driver short, drift in the boost capacitor, or supply ripple under load.
The ECU's EEPROM (persistent calibration storage) reports a check-sum or write error. Calibration values may be corrupted - the ECU runs on safe defaults until repair.

P0630.en: VIN Not Programmed or Incompatible ECM or PCM
P0630.ru: VIN не запрограммирован или несовместим — ECM или PCM

d.en: VIN Not Programmed or Incompatible ECM or PCM: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P0631.en: VIN Not Programmed or Incompatible TCM
P0631.ru: VIN не запрограммирован или несовместим — TCM

d.en: VIN Not Programmed or Incompatible TCM: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P0632.en: Odometer Not Programmed ECM or PCM
P0632.ru: Одометр не запрограммирован в ECM или PCM

d.en: The odometer value stored in the ECM/PCM is missing or implausible - typical after a module replacement without odometer programming, or after persistent storage corruption.
The immobiliser system rejects the current key because it is not programmed to this vehicle. Engine start is inhibited.

P0634.en: Control Module Internal Temperature A Too High
P0634.ru: Внутренняя температура блока управления A слишком высокая

d.en: Control Module Internal Temperature A Too High: the control module has detected this fault condition.
A general circuit fault is detected on the power steering control output - typically the line that the ECU uses to request raised idle when steering load is high, or to enable an electric pump.

P0636.ru: Управление усилителем руля — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P0635 with the control line shorted to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0637.ru: Управление усилителем руля — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P0635 with the control line shorted to supply. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P0638.en: Throttle Actuator Control Range or Performance Bank 1
P0638.ru: Управление приводом дросселя, банк 1 — вне диапазона или характеристика

d.en: The drive-by-wire throttle actuator on bank 1 does not respond as commanded - actuator slow, gearing slipping, or position feedback offset against actual blade angle.

P0639.en: Throttle Actuator Control Range or Performance Bank 2
P0639.ru: Управление приводом дросселя, банк 2 — вне диапазона или характеристика

P063B.en: Generator Voltage Sense Circuit A Range or Performance
P063B.ru: Измерение напряжения генератора A — вне диапазона / характеристика

P063C.en: Generator Voltage Sense Circuit A Low
P063C.ru: Измерение напряжения генератора A — низкий сигнал

P063D.en: Generator Voltage Sense Circuit A High
P063D.ru: Измерение напряжения генератора A — высокий сигнал

P063E.en: Auto Configuration Throttle Input Not Present Bank 1
P063E.ru: Автоконфигурация — нет входного сигнала дросселя, банк 1

d.en: Auto Configuration Throttle Input Not Present Bank 1: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P063F.en: Auto Configuration Engine Coolant Temperature Input Not Present
P063F.ru: Автоконфигурация — нет входного сигнала температуры ОЖ

d.en: Auto Configuration Engine Coolant Temperature Input Not Present: the control module has detected this fault condition.
A general circuit fault on the intake air heater control - the ECU cannot drive the grid heater at cold-start.

The 5 V reference voltage that the ECU supplies to multiple sensors (TPS, MAP, accelerator pedal, etc.) has dropped out or is open-circuit. Symptoms cascade — many sensor codes appear at once, all related to the same reference rail.

P0642.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков "A" — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: The 5 V reference voltage on the A circuit (used by multiple sensors) is below threshold — short to ground or excessive current draw by a single sensor pulling the rail down.

P0643.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков "A" — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: 5 V reference rail A above threshold — short to a higher voltage source. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
The serial communication line to the driver display (instrument cluster, MIL/check-engine warning) shows a circuit fault. Driver may not see warning lights as expected.

P0645.en: A and C Clutch Relay Control Circuit

d.en: A general circuit fault on the A/C clutch relay control - the line over which the ECU engages the magnetic clutch to drive the A/C compressor.

P0646.en: A and C Clutch Relay Control Circuit Low
P0646.ru: Реле муфты кондиционера (A/C) — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

P0647.ru: Реле муфты кондиционера (A/C) — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

Immobilizer Lamp Control Circuit: the control circuit has an electrical fault.
Speed Control Lamp Control Circuit: the control circuit has an electrical fault.

A general fault is detected on the dedicated fuel pump control module A. Used on PWM-controlled returnless fuel systems to vary pump speed against demand. The module reports an internal performance issue.

A general fault on the power take-off (PTO) control module - reports internal performance issue or communication trouble. Affects vehicles with auxiliary mechanical drives (cranes, snow ploughs, hydraulic pumps).
A general fault is detected on the first glow plug control module - typically a self-diagnosis flag for an internal driver, supply, or watchdog issue.

P064D.en: Internal Control Module O2 Sensor Processor Performance Bank 1
P064D.ru: Внутри блока управления: процессор датчика O2, банк 1, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "oxygen sensor processing, bank 1" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. P064E.en: Internal Control Module O2 Sensor Processor Performance Bank 2
P064E.ru: Внутри блока управления: процессор датчика O2, банк 2, характеристика

The ECU's secure boot or signature check has detected calibration data that is not signed by the manufacturer - typically appears after chip-tuning or unauthorised flash programming. The ECU may run on safe defaults or refuse to start.

P0650.en: Malfunction Indicator Lamp Control Circuit Malfunction

d.en: A fault in the wiring or control circuit between the ECU and the malfunction indicator lamp (MIL). The MIL may stay on permanently, fail to light at key-on, or flicker — the OBD-II self-check on the bulb itself failed.

P0651.en: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit Open
P0651.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков B — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The 5-volt sensor reference rail B is open — the module supplies no voltage on this circuit. Every sensor powered from reference B loses its supply and reads invalid, so the ECU substitutes default values and may limit engine operation. Causes: a broken reference wire, a disconnected connector, or an internal open in the module's voltage regulator for rail B.

P0652.en: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit Low
P0652.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков B — цепь, низкий сигнал

P0653.en: Sensor Reference Voltage B Circuit High
P0653.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков B — цепь, высокий сигнал

The engine RPM signal output that the ECU sends to other modules (tachometer, transmission, ABS) has an open circuit.

P0655.en: Engine Hot Lamp Output Control Circuit

P0657.ru: Напряжение питания привода A — цепь, обрыв

P065B.en: Generator A Control Circuit Range or Performance
P065B.ru: Генератор A — управление, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The PWM control line to the alternator A regulator does not deliver the expected charging response - high contact resistance, regulator drift, or wrong calibration.
The alternator A reports a mechanical performance issue - typically a slipping belt, worn pulley clutch, or seizing rotor that causes the output to lag behind speed.

P065D.en: Reductant System Malfunction Lamp Control Circuit
P065D.ru: Лампа неисправности системы реагента — цепь управления

The control circuit between the engine controller and the glow plug control module reports a fault. The ECU can no longer reliably command the module that drives the glow plugs, so cold-start pre-heating may not run. On a diesel this causes hard starting, white smoke, and rough running until warm. Causes: open or shorted wiring between ECU and glow plug module, a failed module, or a power/ground fault at the module.

An electrical fault is present in the glow plug circuit for cylinder 1. The glow plug control module cannot drive this plug correctly — open circuit, short, or out-of-range resistance — so cylinder 1 is not pre-heated. On a cold start this causes hard starting, white smoke, and a misfire-like rough run until the engine warms. Causes: a failed glow plug, a broken supply lead to that plug, corrosion at the plug connector, or a faulty module output for cylinder 1.

P06B6.en: Internal Control Module Knock Combustion Vibration Sensor Processor 1 Performance
P06B6.ru: Внутри блока управления: процессор 1 датчика детонации, характеристика

d.en: An internal self-test in the control module reports a fault in its processing of the "knock sensor processing, channel 1" value. The module computes and cross-checks this value redundantly inside its own processor; when the results disagree, the code sets. It points to a hardware or software fault inside the module itself, not to a defect of the external sensor. Causes are an internal processor or memory fault, corrupted control-module software, or low or disturbed module supply voltage.

P0739.ru: Выход оборотов двигателя TCM — высокий сигнал

The transmission is mechanically stuck in gear 5 and will not shift out of it. A shift solenoid or hydraulic valve on the gear-5 circuit has jammed, or a clutch/band has failed to release. Symptoms are no up- or downshifts, harsh behaviour, and often limp mode. Causes: a stuck or failed shift solenoid, a valve-body fault, a hydraulic pressure problem, or internal mechanical damage.

The transmission is mechanically stuck in gear 6 and will not shift out of it. A shift solenoid or hydraulic valve on the gear-6 circuit has jammed, or a clutch/band has failed to release. Symptoms are no up- or downshifts, harsh behaviour, and often limp mode. Causes: a stuck or failed shift solenoid, a valve-body fault, a hydraulic pressure problem, or internal mechanical damage.

The transmission is mechanically stuck in gear 7 and will not shift out of it. A shift solenoid or hydraulic valve on the gear-7 circuit has jammed, or a clutch/band has failed to release. Symptoms are no up- or downshifts, harsh behaviour, and often limp mode. Causes: a stuck or failed shift solenoid, a valve-body fault, a hydraulic pressure problem, or internal mechanical damage.
The TCM cannot disengage all gears to neutral - typically a stuck clutch pack or hydraulic pressure issue keeping a gear engaged.
Reverse cannot be engaged when commanded - reverse-band, clutch pack or hydraulic pressure on the reverse circuit has failed.

The transmission cannot engage gear 1 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 1 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-1 circuit.

A general fault has been detected in the torque converter clutch (TCC) lockup circuit. The TCC mechanically links the engine to the transmission input shaft above a certain speed to eliminate slip and improve fuel economy.

P0741.en: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Performance/Stuck Off

d.en: When the TCM commands torque converter lockup, the actual slip stays above threshold — the clutch is not engaging. Often signals worn TCC friction material; transmission fluid analysis usually shows debris.

P0742.en: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Stuck On

d.en: The torque converter clutch (TCC) cannot disengage. Symptom is engine stalling when coming to a stop, because the engine is mechanically locked to the transmission output.
An electrical fault in the torque converter clutch solenoid circuit — open, shorted, or out-of-range driver current. The transmission usually inhibits TCC apply when this code is active.
The TCC circuit drops in and out — intermittent open or short. Symptoms include erratic shudder at lock-up speeds and intermittent engine stalls when stopping.
A general fault on transmission pressure control solenoid A - the solenoid that meters main line pressure for the entire valve body.

Pressure Control Solenoid A Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. It regulates transmission line pressure; faults cause slipping, harsh, or delayed shifts.

P0747.en: Pressure Control Solenoid A Stuck On
P0747.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления A — заклинил включённым

d.en: Pressure control solenoid A appears electrically commanded off but pressure feedback indicates it is stuck on. Line pressure stays high.

P0748.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления A — электрическая неисправность

d.en: An electrical fault on the pressure control solenoid A circuit - typically open or short to ground or supply.

P0749.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления A — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Same as P0748 with intermittent or erratic signal.

The transmission cannot engage gear 2 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 2 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-2 circuit.

The transmission cannot engage gear 3 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 3 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-3 circuit.

The transmission cannot engage gear 4 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 4 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-4 circuit.

The transmission cannot engage gear 5 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 5 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-5 circuit.

The transmission cannot engage gear 6 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 6 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-6 circuit.

The transmission cannot engage gear 7 when it is commanded. The element that should apply for gear 7 — shift solenoid, clutch pack, or band — does not build or hold pressure, so the gear never locks in. Symptoms are slipping, no power transfer in that gear, or a forced limp mode. Causes: a failed shift solenoid, a worn clutch pack, or a valve-body or hydraulic-supply fault on the gear-7 circuit.
Shift Solenoid "A" Malfunction: the component is malfunctioning. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.

Shift Solenoid A Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift Solenoid A Stuck On: the actuator is stuck in the on position. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
An electrical fault on shift solenoid A - open or short on the control circuit.
Same as P0753 with intermittent signal.
Shift Solenoid "B" Malfunction: the component is malfunctioning. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.

Shift Solenoid B Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift Solenoid B Stuck On: the actuator is stuck in the on position. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift Solenoid "B" Electrical: an electrical fault is present. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Same as P0754 on shift solenoid B.
A general fault on shift solenoid G - typically the seventh shift solenoid in transmissions with 7 or more gears.

P075B.ru: Соленоид переключения G — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: Shift solenoid G is electrically intact, but its hydraulic effect is missing — when commanded on, the gear it should engage does not lock up. Either the solenoid is mechanically stuck closed, the valve body bore is worn, or hydraulic pressure does not reach the clutch pack.

Shift solenoid G remains hydraulically active even when the TCM commands it off. The corresponding clutch or band stays applied, blocking shifts that need it released — typical symptoms are harsh engagement, stuck in a single gear, or refusal to shift cleanly.

General electrical fault on the shift solenoid G control circuit — open coil, short to ground, short to battery voltage, or driver feedback outside the expected range. The TCM disables this solenoid and falls back to limp-home gear logic to protect the transmission.

Shift solenoid G shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts — vibration on the harness, loose connector, contaminated ATF that occasionally jams the spool, or thermal sensitivity. Difficult to catch with a static check; usually documented by snapshot/freeze-frame data when the fault occurs.

The transmission fluid level monitor reports overfill above the safe maximum. Causes range from incorrect refill at service to coolant intrusion via a failed transmission cooler. Overfilling can cause foaming, accelerated wear and seal damage from raised internal pressure.
Shift Solenoid "C" Malfunction: the component is malfunctioning. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.

Shift Solenoid C Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.

Shift solenoid C remains hydraulically active when commanded off — the corresponding clutch or band cannot release, locking out shifts that depend on it. The TCM detects the missing release via gear-ratio error or output-shaft slip.
Shift Solenoid "C" Electrical: an electrical fault is present. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift solenoid C shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts — vibration, loose connector, ATF contamination or thermal sensitivity. Hard to reproduce on a static bench check.
Shift Solenoid "D" Malfunction: the component is malfunctioning. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.

Shift Solenoid D Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift solenoid D remains hydraulically active when commanded off — corresponding clutch or band cannot release. The TCM detects the missing release via gear-ratio error.
Shift Solenoid "D" Electrical: an electrical fault is present. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift solenoid D shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts.

General fault on shift solenoid H — used in 8/9/10-speed transmissions where multiple shift solenoids manage the larger gear matrix. The TCM detects an electrical or hydraulic anomaly without yet being able to attribute it to a specific failure mode.

P076B.ru: Соленоид переключения H — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: Shift solenoid H is electrically intact but does not engage hydraulically when commanded — corresponding clutch or band does not lock up.
Shift solenoid H remains hydraulically active when commanded off — corresponding clutch or band cannot release, blocking dependent shifts.
General electrical fault on the shift solenoid H control circuit — open coil, short to ground or battery, driver feedback outside range.
Shift solenoid H shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts.

While in 7th gear, the ratio measured between input shaft speed and output shaft speed does not match the calibrated value for that gear. Either a clutch or band is slipping, the wrong gear actually engaged, or speed sensor data is wrong.
General fault on shift solenoid E. The TCM detects an electrical or hydraulic anomaly that has not yet been pinned to a specific failure mode.

P0771.ru: Соленоид переключения E — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: Shift solenoid E is electrically intact but does not engage hydraulically — associated clutch or band does not lock up.
Shift solenoid E remains hydraulically active when commanded off — associated clutch or band cannot release, blocking dependent shifts.
Shift Solenoid "E" Electrical: an electrical fault is present. Shift solenoids route transmission hydraulic pressure to engage the gears; faults cause harsh, delayed, or missed shifts.
Shift solenoid E shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts — vibration, loose connector or ATF contamination.
Generic fault on pressure control solenoid B circuit. Either electrical or response fault depending on manufacturer.

Pressure Control Solenoid B Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. It regulates transmission line pressure; faults cause slipping, harsh, or delayed shifts.

P0777.en: Pressure Control Solenoid B Stuck On
P0777.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления B — заклинил включённым

d.en: Pressure control solenoid B does not release line pressure when commanded — output pressure remains at maximum, leading to harsh shifts and elevated stress on the clutch packs and seals.

P0778.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления B — электрическая неисправность

d.en: General electrical fault on the pressure control solenoid B circuit — open coil, short to ground or battery, or driver feedback outside the expected range.

P0779.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления B — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Pressure control solenoid B shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts — vibration, loose connector, or contaminated ATF that occasionally restricts the regulator port.

P077A.en: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit - Loss of Direction Signal
P077A.ru: Датчик скорости выходного вала — нет сигнала направления

d.en: The output shaft speed sensor uses a quadrature output (two channels phase-shifted by 90°) so the TCM can determine direction of rotation. The direction channel is missing — TCM cannot tell whether the vehicle is rolling forward or backward, blocking neutral-idle and rollback-protection strategies.

P077B.en: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit - Direction Error
P077B.ru: Датчик скорости выходного вала — ошибка направления

d.en: The TCM reads a direction from the output shaft speed sensor that contradicts the commanded gear — for example reverse direction while drive is engaged, or forward direction while reverse is engaged. Either the sensor wiring is swapped, the sensor is wrong, or the gear actually engaged is not the one commanded.

P077C.en: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit Low
P077C.ru: Датчик скорости выходного вала — низкий сигнал

d.en: Output shaft speed sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground or open supply. TCM disables vehicle-speed dependent shift logic and may force limp-home.

P077D.en: Output Shaft Speed Sensor Circuit High
P077D.ru: Датчик скорости выходного вала — высокий сигнал

d.en: Output shaft speed sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P077E.en: Transmission Fluid Temperature Measurement System - Multiple Sensor Correlation
P077E.ru: Система измерения температуры масла КПП — рассогласование датчиков

d.en: Modern transmissions can have two or more ATF temperature sensors (sump, cooler return, valve body). After a long key-off soak they should all read approximately the same ambient. The TCM detects an implausible spread between sensors — one of them drifts or is wired wrong.

Some transmissions provide a second reverse ratio (typically a slower crawler reverse for trailer manoeuvring or hill descent). The TCM detects that the input/output ratio in this gear does not match its calibrated value — slipping clutch or wrong gear actually engaged.
The TCM detects that a commanded shift between gears did not occur within the expected time and quality window. Slip rates or speed ratios remain implausible during shift.
The TCM detects a fault during the 1-to-2 upshift. The actual gear ratio after the shift command does not match the expected ratio for second gear.
The TCM detects a fault during the 2-to-3 upshift. Gear ratio after shift command does not match third gear expected ratio.
The TCM detects a fault during the 3-to-4 upshift, where gear ratio after the shift does not match fourth gear expected value.
The TCM detects a fault during the 4-to-5 upshift on transmissions equipped with five or more forward gears.

General fault on shift timing solenoid A — controls the rate at which a shift event takes place (smooth ramp vs. quick snap). The TCM detects an electrical or hydraulic anomaly that has not yet been pinned to a specific failure mode.

P0786.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Shift timing solenoid A is electrically intact, but the actual shift time does not match the model — shifts too fast (harsh) or too slow (slipping under load). Often aged solenoid with weakened force or contaminated ATF restricting the regulating port.

P0787.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid A control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on.

P0788.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid A control circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return.

P0789.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения A — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid A signal jumps or drops out — vibration, loose connector or thermal sensitivity.
General fault on shift timing solenoid B — second timing solenoid for shift events that need a different ramp profile (typically downshifts vs. upshifts, or specific gear pairs).

P078B.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Shift timing solenoid B is electrically intact, but actual shift timing does not match the model — same failure modes as solenoid A (aged, dirty ATF), applied to the second timing channel.

P078C.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid B control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground.

P078D.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid B control circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil.

P078E.ru: Соленоид фаз переключения B — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Shift timing solenoid B signal jumps or drops out.

General electrical fault on the third transmission mode select switch input C — used for additional drive modes (Sport, Snow, Tow/Haul, Eco) on transmissions that offer more than two operator-selectable shift maps. Without a valid input the TCM falls back to the default mode.

General electrical fault on the Normal/Performance shift-pattern selector switch — lets the driver toggle between a comfort-oriented and a sport-oriented shift map. Without a valid input the TCM defaults to the Normal map.

P0791.en: Intermediate Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit
P0791.ru: Датчик скорости промежуточного вала A — цепь

d.en: The TCM detects an electrical fault on the intermediate shaft speed sensor A circuit. Used to compute shift slip and torque converter behavior.

P0792.en: Intermediate Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
P0792.ru: Датчик скорости промежуточного вала A — вне диапазона

d.en: The intermediate shaft speed sensor (between input and output, used in CVT and dual-clutch boxes for slip detection between gear elements) is electrically intact, but its readings drift away from the model. The TCM cannot reliably detect slip in this stage.

P0793.en: Intermediate Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit No Signal
P0793.ru: Датчик скорости промежуточного вала A — нет сигнала

d.en: Intermediate shaft speed sensor A is connected and powered, but no rotation pulses arrive while the transmission is in motion. Either the sensor reluctor wheel is damaged, the sensor air gap is wrong, or the element has failed open.

P0794.en: Intermediate Shaft Speed Sensor A Circuit Intermittent
P0794.ru: Датчик скорости промежуточного вала A — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Intermediate shaft speed sensor A signal jumps or drops out — vibration, loose connector or oil mist on the sensor tip.

General fault on pressure control solenoid C — third pressure regulator in transmissions with multiple independently regulated hydraulic circuits (line pressure, clutch C, torque converter clutch). The TCM detects an electrical or hydraulic anomaly that has not yet been pinned to a specific failure mode.

Pressure Control Solenoid C Performance: the component is electrically intact but its response does not match the command. It regulates transmission line pressure; faults cause slipping, harsh, or delayed shifts.

P0797.en: Pressure Control Solenoid C Stuck On
P0797.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления C — заклинил включённым

d.en: The TCM detects that pressure control solenoid C remains energized hydraulically despite commanded de-energization. Line pressure or shift quality deviates from target.

P0798.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления C — электрическая неисправность

d.en: The TCM detects an electrical fault in the pressure control solenoid C circuit, such as open winding, short to ground or short to power.

P0799.ru: Соленоид регулировки давления C — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Pressure control solenoid C shows intermittent electrical or hydraulic dropouts.

P079A.en: Transmission Friction Element A Slip Detected

d.en: Friction element A (the first clutch or band in the gear matrix) shows measurable slip while it should be fully engaged. Detected by comparing input/output speed sensors against the commanded gear ratio. Slip means the element cannot transmit full torque — risk of glazing the friction surfaces.

P079B.en: Transmission Friction Element B Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element B (the second clutch or band).

P079C.en: Transmission Friction Element C Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element C (third clutch or band).

P079D.en: Transmission Friction Element D Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element D (fourth clutch or band).

P079E.en: Transmission Friction Element E Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element E (fifth clutch or band, used in 8/9/10-speed transmissions).

P079F.en: Transmission Friction Element F Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element F (sixth clutch or band, used in 8/9/10-speed transmissions).

P07A0.en: Transmission Friction Element G Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element G (seventh clutch or band, used in 9/10-speed transmissions).

P07A1.en: Transmission Friction Element H Slip Detected

d.en: Same condition as element A slip, applied to friction element H (eighth clutch or band, in 10-speed transmissions).

P07A2.en: Transmission Friction Element A Performance/Stuck Off
P07A2.ru: Фрикционный элемент КПП A — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: Friction element A does not lock up when commanded — its hydraulic circuit cannot bring the clutch pack into full engagement. Either the apply piston is stuck, the seal is leaking past the piston, or the supplying pressure regulator is failing.

P07A3.en: Transmission Friction Element A Stuck On
P07A3.ru: Фрикционный элемент КПП A — заклинил включённым

d.en: Friction element A does not release when commanded — the apply piston cannot retract, leaving the clutch or band engaged. The transmission cannot complete shifts that need element A released, leading to harsh engagement or stall when stopping.

P07A4.en: Transmission Friction Element B Performance/Stuck Off
P07A4.ru: Фрикционный элемент КПП B — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

P07B2.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения P КПП A — цепь/обрыв

d.en: Park position sensor/switch A — confirms that the gear selector lever is in Park, used by shift-by-wire systems and key-interlock logic — is open. The TCM cannot confirm Park engagement, blocking key removal and engine restart logic.

P07B3.en: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Low
P07B3.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения P КПП A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Park position sensor/switch A reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P07B4.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения P КПП A — высокий сигнал

P07B5.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения P КПП A — характеристика/низкий сигнал

P07B6.en: Transmission Park Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Performance High
P07B6.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения P КПП A — характеристика/высокий сигнал

The transmission has entered 8th gear but cannot leave it on command — typically a stuck shift solenoid or a stuck-on friction element holding the 8th-gear pattern locked. The TCM forces limp-home mode if upshift/downshift attempts fail repeatedly.

The TCM commands a shift to 8th gear but the gear-ratio measurement does not confirm engagement — friction element does not lock up, slipping clutch, or shift solenoid does not respond. Falls back to the previously engaged gear.
While in 8th gear, the measured input/output ratio does not match the calibrated value — slipping clutch, wrong gear actually engaged, or speed sensor data wrong.

General fault detected during the 6-to-7 upshift event — slipping during the shift, gear-ratio overshoot, or shift completion timeout. Often a worn friction element on the 7th-gear side or a slow shift solenoid.
General fault detected during the 7-to-8 upshift event.

Starting from 1st gear, the TCM commanded a specific upshift but the resulting gear ratio matches a different gear. Wrong shift solenoid pattern actually engaged, or a stuck solenoid blocked the intended pattern.
Same condition as incorrect shift from gear 1, applied to shifts originating in 2nd gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 3rd gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 4th gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 5th gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 6th gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 7th gear.
Same condition, applied to shifts originating in 8th gear.

The TCM commands the park pawl to engage but the position sensors do not confirm engagement — typical for shift-by-wire systems where the park actuator (motor or solenoid driving the pawl) is faulty, the cable is broken, or the pawl is jammed against a tooth and cannot drop in.

TCM commands engagement of Drive but the input/output speed relationship does not match — friction element does not lock up, or the shift solenoid pattern for Drive cannot be commanded. Vehicle remains stuck in Park or Neutral.
The vehicle cannot leave Park even though the operator has commanded a different range. Park pawl jammed, park actuator failed, or shift-by-wire input not received by TCM.
The vehicle cannot leave Drive — typically a stuck shift mechanism, a stuck-on friction element, or a TCM that cannot command the shift to Park or Neutral.

The transmission range control A circuit (used in shift-by-wire to drive the shift actuator that physically positions the manual valve in the valve body) is open. The TCM cannot move the manual valve into the commanded range, blocking shifts between P/R/N/D.

P07E9.en: Transmission Range Control A Circuit Performance

d.en: Range control A circuit is electrically intact, but the actuator response does not match the model — for example position feedback that does not move when commanded, or moves slower than expected. Often a sticking actuator or aged motor.

P07EA.en: Transmission Range Control A Circuit Low
P07EA.ru: Управление диапазоном КПП A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Range control A circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P07EB.ru: Управление диапазоном КПП A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Range control A circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

General electrical fault on the multi-function transmission range select circuit — used on shift-by-wire systems with rotary or push-button selectors that encode P/R/N/D as a multi-bit pattern. With the input invalid the TCM cannot decode the operator request.

P07ED.en: Transmission Range Multi-Function Select Circuit Stuck

d.en: The multi-function select circuit reports a value that does not change despite operator activity — the rotary encoder is stuck or a push-button is mechanically locked. The TCM ignores further requests until the input becomes plausible.

d.en: The multi-function select circuit produces values that do not match any valid bit pattern — multiple positions asserted simultaneously, or values outside the calibrated range.

P07F1.en: Input/Turbine Shaft Speed Sensor C Circuit
P07F1.ru: Датчик скорости входного вала/турбины C — цепь

P07F2.en: Transmission Range Control Module Communication Circuit
P07F2.ru: Блок управления диапазоном КПП, связь — цепь

d.en: General fault on the communication line between the TCM and a separate transmission range control module (used on systems where the rotary/push-button selector lives in its own intelligent module that talks to the TCM via CAN or LIN).

P07F3.en: Transmission Range Control Module Communication Circuit Low
P07F3.ru: Блок управления диапазоном КПП, связь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Range control module communication line reads stuck low — bus shorted to ground or one node held the line low continuously.

P07F4.ru: Блок управления диапазоном КПП, связь — высокий сигнал

P07F5.ru: Блок управления диапазоном КПП — низкое напряжение системы

d.en: The range control module reports its supply voltage below the operating threshold — vehicle battery low, charging system underperforming, or supply line resistance excessive. The module may stop responding until voltage recovers.
While in 9th gear, the measured input/output ratio does not match the calibrated value — slipping clutch, wrong gear actually engaged, or speed sensor data wrong.
While in 10th gear, the measured input/output ratio does not match the calibrated value.
Same condition as stuck in 8th gear, applied to 9th.
Same condition as unable to engage 8th gear, applied to 9th.
Same condition as incorrect shift from 8th, applied to 9th.
Same condition as stuck in 8th, applied to 10th.
Same condition as unable to engage 8th, applied to 10th.
Same condition as incorrect shift from 8th, applied to 10th.

The TCM detects that the transmission is stuck in some gear but cannot identify which one — typically because multiple input/output ratio cross-checks fail simultaneously, or an early-detection diagnostic fires before the specific-gear detection runs.

During the cold-start phase the transmission does not behave to specification — typically very slow shifts, missed shifts or harsh engagement at low ATF temperature. Common causes are degraded ATF (lost cold-flow viscosity), a stuck thermostat or aged solenoid drivers.

The transfer case control module has requested the ECM/PCM to illuminate the MIL because of a fault on its side that is emissions- or driveline-relevant. The original fault is in the transfer case module itself.
The TCM detects an electrical fault in the reverse inhibit solenoid circuit, which prevents engagement of reverse at high vehicle speeds.

P0802.en: Transmission Control System MIL Request Circuit/Open
P0802.ru: Запрос лампы MIL от системы управления КПП — цепь/обрыв

d.en: The dedicated MIL request line from the TCM to the ECM (used in older systems where modules used a hard wire to ask for the MIL instead of CAN messaging) is open. The ECM cannot honour TCM-side MIL requests.

General electrical fault on the upshift/skip-shift solenoid control circuit — used on manual-transmission performance vehicles to force a skip from 1st straight to 4th under low-load cruise (CAFE fuel-economy feature). With the input invalid the lockout cannot be applied.

General electrical fault on the upshift/skip-shift indicator lamp control circuit — the dashboard light that prompts the driver to skip from 1st straight to 4th. With the input invalid the lamp cannot be illuminated.

General electrical fault on the clutch position sensor A circuit — used in dual-clutch and automated-manual transmissions to monitor clutch fork or release-bearing position. Without a valid signal the TCM cannot close the loop on clutch engagement.

P0806.ru: Датчик положения сцепления A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Clutch position sensor A is electrically intact, but its readings drift away from the model — for example the position does not move when the actuator is commanded, or the offset shifts after a thermal cycle. Often a misadjusted sensor mount.

P0807.ru: Датчик положения сцепления A — низкий сигнал

P0808.ru: Датчик положения сцепления A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Clutch position sensor A signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P0809.ru: Датчик положения сцепления A — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Clutch position sensor A signal jumps or drops out — vibration, loose connector or oil/heat exposure near the bell housing.

After a clutch replacement or sensor replacement the TCM has not run a successful clutch-position learn cycle. Without learned end-stops the TCM cannot accurately command engagement points, leading to slipping or harsh take-up. A scan-tool guided learn procedure must be performed.

d.en: Skip-shift solenoid is electrically intact, but the lockout effect does not match commands — solenoid sticks or coil aged, gearbox interlock cannot be applied or released within the expected time.

On automated manual or dual-clutch transmissions, the actual clutch actuator position deviates from commanded position beyond tolerance. Position sensor and actuator do not agree on closed-loop test.

The TCM detects more slip across clutch A (the first clutch in dual-clutch boxes, or the launch clutch in automated-manual systems) than the calibration allows. Heat builds up rapidly — risk of glazing the friction discs or warping the pressure plate.

General electrical fault on the reverse-engagement input — the signal that tells the TCM (and other modules — backup lights, parking sensors) that the gear lever is in Reverse. With the input invalid backup lights and rear sensors do not activate.
General electrical fault on the reverse-output circuit — the line that drives backup lights, reverse alarm or transfer-case reverse signal. With the output broken these consumers cannot be activated.
General electrical fault on the transmission range display circuit — drives the PRNDL indicator on the dashboard. With the input invalid the indicator may show the wrong gear range or stay blank.
The TCM detects an electrical fault on the manual upshift request switch (paddle or +/- lever) circuit.
The TCM detects an electrical fault on the manual downshift request switch circuit.

The starter-disable circuit (used by transmission, immobiliser or anti-theft to block cranking unless safety conditions are met — e.g. clutch pedal pressed on manual, brake pedal on auto) is open. The starter cannot be disabled, weakening the safety chain.

General electrical fault on the driveline disconnect switch input — used on AWD/4WD vehicles to electrically disengage the rear or front axle for fuel economy. With the input invalid the disconnect cannot be commanded.

P0819.en: Up and Down Shift Switch to Transmission Range Correlation
P0819.ru: Переключатель повышения/понижения передач — рассогласование с диапазоном КПП

d.en: The up-shift/down-shift paddle or button input is used in manumatic mode to step through gears, but the inputs only make sense when the gear lever is in Drive or the Manual position. The TCM detects an inconsistency — paddle commands while gear lever is in Park or Neutral.
Starter disable circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The starter is permanently disabled, blocking engine cranking.
Starter disable circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The disable cannot be asserted, weakening the safety chain.

General electrical fault on the Park input circuit — used by ECM/PCM to know that the gear lever is in Park (allows engine start, raises idle for accessory loads). With the input invalid Park-conditional logic falls back to a safe default.
General electrical fault on the Neutral input circuit — used by ECM/PCM to detect Neutral and adjust idle speed and start enable.
Same condition as excessive clutch A slippage, applied to clutch B (second clutch in dual-clutch boxes — the odd-gear clutch typically).

P081F.ru: Блокировка переключения КПП педалью тормоза (BTSI) — рассогласование сигнала

d.en: The Brake Transmission Shift Interlock prevents shifting out of Park unless the brake pedal is pressed. The TCM compares the brake-pedal input to the BTSI solenoid command and detects an inconsistency — for example shift permitted while brake not pressed, or interlock active while brake is pressed.

Manufacturer-specific reserved code in the SAE generic range used as catch-all for hybrid system faults that do not map to a more specific defined code. Should be diagnosed using the freeze frame data and any additional manufacturer codes.

The lean NOx trap (LNT) on bank 1 is no longer storing or releasing NOx within the required efficiency window. Detected by the downstream NOx sensor or model-based monitor — typically caused by sulphur poisoning, thermal aging, or a failed regeneration strategy.

The lean NOx trap (LNT) on bank 2 is no longer storing or releasing NOx within the required efficiency window. Detected by the downstream NOx sensor or model-based monitor — typically caused by sulphur poisoning, thermal aging, or a failed regeneration strategy.

P2004.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Open (Bank 1)
P2004.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — заклинил открытым

d.en: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 1 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.

P2005.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Open (Bank 2)
P2005.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 2 — заклинил открытым

d.en: The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) flap on bank 2 is stuck in the open position. The IMRC swirls or tumbles intake charge at low rpm by closing one runner per cylinder; when stuck open, low-end torque drops and the engine may misfire on cold starts.

P2006.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Closed (Bank 1)
P2006.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The IMRC flap on bank 1 is stuck in the closed position and cannot open at higher rpm. Top-end power suffers because the runner is restricted, and the engine may breathe poorly above mid-range.

P2007.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Closed (Bank 2)
P2007.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 2 — заклинил закрытым

d.en: Bank 2 counterpart to P2006. The IMRC flap on bank 2 cannot return to the open position and chokes intake flow at higher rpm.

P2008.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Solenoid Circuit Open (Bank 1)
P2008.ru: Соленоид управления заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — обрыв

d.en: The ECU detects an open circuit on the IMRC solenoid for bank 1. No control current flows when the runner is commanded to switch, leaving the flap in its default position.

P2009.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Solenoid Circuit Low (Bank 1)
P2009.ru: Соленоид управления заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — низкий сигнал

d.en: The IMRC solenoid drive line for bank 1 reads below the lower threshold — short to ground or a failed driver stage. The runner cannot be switched on demand.

The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) on bank 1 reports that flap movement does not match the commanded position within the allowed time window — either too slow, too short a stroke, or position feedback off-target.

The intake manifold runner control (IMRC) on bank 2 reports that flap movement does not match the commanded position within the allowed time window — either too slow, too short a stroke, or position feedback off-target.
A temperature sensor at the diesel particulate filter (DPF) on bank 1 has exceeded the safe limit — typically during a runaway regeneration. Continued operation can melt or crack the substrate.
A temperature sensor at the diesel particulate filter (DPF) on bank 2 has exceeded the safe limit — typically during a runaway regeneration. Continued operation can melt or crack the substrate.

A temperature sensor in the exhaust catalyst on bank 1 reports a value above the safe operating limit. Sustained over-temperature can sinter the precious-metal washcoat and destroy conversion efficiency.

A temperature sensor in the exhaust catalyst on bank 2 reports a value above the safe operating limit. Sustained over-temperature can sinter the precious-metal washcoat and destroy conversion efficiency.

P2010.ru: Соленоид управления заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — высокий сигнал

d.en: Drive voltage at the IMRC solenoid on bank 1 is above the upper limit — short to supply or an open ground side. The solenoid is energised constantly or the driver protection trips.

d.en: The IMRC actuator drive circuit on bank 2 is open or has lost continuity — control module no longer detects a closing path through the actuator winding.

d.en: The IMRC actuator drive line on bank 2 reads above the expected voltage threshold — typically a short to battery voltage or an open ground side.
