d.en: The DEF system air-assist pressure exceeds the upper threshold — pressure-control valve stuck closed or air pump runaway.
Pressure in the AdBlue/DEF supply line is below the target. Usually a failing reductant pump, a clogged filter, frozen lines, or a leak in the pressurised circuit.

Manufacturer-specific variant of the reductant over-pressure condition. The pressure exceeds the upper threshold during a defined operating window; on some platforms used in addition to P20E2 to flag a different test path.
The control circuit to the reductant (DEF) dosing pump is open — no current flow detected. Without pump pressure no AdBlue reaches the SCR catalyst and NOx reduction stops.
A general electrical fault on the reductant tank heater "A" control circuit. AdBlue freezes at -11 C, so the tank heater must work for cold-start dosing.
The reductant tank heater "A" does not heat when commanded on. Either a failed element or a stuck-off driver in the dosing module.
The reductant tank heater "A" stays energised even when not commanded — usually a shorted driver stage. Continuous heating wastes current and can overheat the heater element.

The SCR catalyst on bank 1 is no longer reducing NOx to the level the ECU expects, even with proper reductant dosing and quality. Often the result of catalyst poisoning by sulphur or hydrocarbons, thermal aging, or a leak between the upstream and downstream NOx sensors.
The SCR reductant injection valve does not deliver the commanded amount of reagent. Causes include clogging by urea crystals, electrical faults or incorrect spray pattern.
SCR NOx Catalyst Over Temperature (Bank 2): the component is overheating, typically from extended load or slip.
SCR NOx Pre-Catalyst Over Temperature (Bank 2): the component is overheating, typically from extended load or slip.

P20F2.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
P20F2.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — эффективность ниже порога (банк 2)

d.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2): the control module has detected this fault condition.

P20F3.en: SCR NOx Pre-Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2)
P20F3.ru: Предкатализатор SCR NOx — эффективность ниже порога (банк 2)

d.en: SCR NOx Pre-Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2): the control module has detected this fault condition.

The DEF consumption observed over the dosing window is below the model expectation — typically a clogged dosing nozzle, weak pump, or leak between pump and injector that recirculates DEF back to the tank.

The DEF consumption observed over the dosing window is above the model expectation — typically a leaking injector seat, leaking line fitting, or a pressure-control valve that vents constantly to the tank.

P20F6.en: Reductant Injection Valve Stuck Open (Bank 1 Unit 1)
P20F6.ru: Клапан впрыска реагента — заклинил открытым, банк 1, узел 1

d.en: The DEF injection valve at bank 1 unit 1 does not close when commanded — DEF flows continuously into the SCR. Risk of crystallisation in the catalyst and over-dosing.

P20F7.en: Reductant Injection Valve Stuck Open (Bank 2 Unit 1)
P20F7.ru: Клапан впрыска реагента — заклинил открытым, банк 2, узел 1

d.en: The DEF injection valve at bank 2 unit 1 does not close when commanded — DEF flows continuously into the SCR. Risk of crystallisation in the catalyst and over-dosing.

P20F8.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Circuit Performance (Bank 1)
P20F8.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 1 — характеристика

d.en: The IMRC actuator drive circuit on bank 1 is electrically OK but its current draw or duty-cycle response is outside the calibrated profile — typically a high-resistance solenoid winding or a partially shorted driver.

P20F9.en: Intake Manifold Runner Control Circuit Performance (Bank 2)
P20F9.ru: Управление заслонками впускного коллектора, банк 2 — характеристика

d.en: The IMRC actuator drive circuit on bank 2 is electrically OK but its current draw or duty-cycle response is outside the calibrated profile — typically a high-resistance solenoid winding or a partially shorted driver.

P20FA.ru: Насос реагента B — цепь управления, обрыв

d.en: The control line driving DEF pump B is open. On large engines or dual-tank systems a second pump (B) supplements pump A; with B offline the system loses redundancy.

P20FB.en: Reductant Pump B Control Performance/Stuck Off
P20FB.ru: Насос реагента B — управление, характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: DEF pump B receives a run command but does not start, or shuts off prematurely.

P20FC.en: Reductant Pump B Control Circuit Low
P20FC.ru: Насос реагента B — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: DEF pump B control line stuck low — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P20FD.en: Reductant Pump B Control Circuit High
P20FD.ru: Насос реагента B — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: DEF pump B control line stuck high — short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
The first DEF metering unit (the integrated module that combines pump, filter, level sensor, and dosing valve) is electrically OK but does not deliver the expected pressure or flow during operation.
The dedicated SCR/reductant control module reports an internal performance fault — failed self-tests, watchdog resets, or calibration mismatch. Frequently a forerunner of total module failure.

P2100.en: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Circuit Open

d.en: The drive-by-wire throttle motor circuit is open — no current flow detected. The ECU loses authority over the throttle plate and forces a limp-home with reduced power.

P2101.en: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Circuit Range/Performance
P2101.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The throttle motor responds, but its actual position does not track the commanded position within tolerance. Often a dirty throttle bore where the plate sticks, or a worn motor.

P2102.en: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Circuit Low

d.en: Drive voltage to the throttle motor is below the lower limit. Typically a short to ground or a failed driver stage in the ECU.

P2103.en: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Circuit High

d.en: Drive voltage to the throttle motor is above the upper limit. Usually a short to supply or an open ground.

P2104.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Forced Idle
P2104.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительный холостой ход

d.en: The ECU has detected a fault severe enough that it forces the throttle actuator to the idle stop. The driver loses pedal authority — only idle is available until the underlying TAC fault clears.

P2105.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Forced Engine Shutdown
P2105.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительная остановка двигателя

d.en: The TAC monitor commanded an engine shutdown because throttle authority can no longer be guaranteed safely. The most aggressive TAC limp mode — used when both throttle position sensors disagree or the motor is uncontrollable.

P2106.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Forced Limited Power
P2106.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительно ограничена мощность

d.en: The TAC monitor restricts maximum throttle opening as a safety response to a TAC fault. The vehicle can still be driven, but accelerator pedal travel is capped.

P2107.en: Throttle Actuator Control Module Internal Processor
P2107.ru: Блок управления приводом дросселя — внутренний процессор

d.en: The internal processor or watchdog of the throttle actuator control module reports an internal fault. Communication between the TAC monitor core and the main ECU core has failed plausibility — typical for a defective ECU.
Self-tests within the TAC module fail their performance criteria — for example RAM/ROM checks or analog reference voltages drift. Indicates an aging ECU rather than a wiring fault.

P2109.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor A Minimum Stop Performance
P2109.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали A — характеристика при минимальном упоре

d.en: The ECU detects that the throttle position sensor A signal at the closed-throttle stop does not match the learned minimum value. The mechanical or electrical zero reference of the throttle has drifted out of the expected range, often after cleaning, replacement or wear.

P210A.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Motor Circuit/Open

d.en: The drive circuit of throttle actuator motor B is open. Throttle B is the secondary throttle on engines with two throttle bodies — typically used for tumble flap or charge-motion control.

P210B.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Motor Circuit Range/Performance
P210B.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Throttle actuator B motor responds electrically but does not move the throttle plate as commanded — typically high-resistance brushes, partial winding fault, or a sticky throttle bore.

P210C.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Motor Circuit Low
P210C.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Throttle actuator B motor drive line stuck low — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P210D.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Motor Circuit High
P210D.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Throttle actuator B motor drive line stuck high — short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P210E.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch C/F Voltage Correlation
P210E.ru: Датчики/выключатели положения дросселя/педали C/F — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: The redundant throttle or accelerator pedal position channels C and F disagree by more than the allowed tolerance. Drive-by-wire systems compare two or three independent channels to detect a faulty potentiometer track.

P210F.en: Throttle Actuator B Control System - Forced Limited RPM
P210F.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя B — принудительно ограничены обороты

d.en: Throttle B control has detected an unsafe condition and forced an RPM limit. Common protective response when motor current, throttle position feedback, or supply voltage on the B path is out of spec.

P2110.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Forced Limited RPM
P2110.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительно ограничены обороты

d.en: The TAC monitor caps engine speed at a fixed limp-home rpm because it can no longer trust the throttle response. Driver may notice a hard rev limit well below redline.

P2111.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Stuck Open
P2111.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — заклинил открытым

d.en: The throttle plate cannot be commanded back to the closed/idle position. Idle speed runs high or the engine cannot decelerate properly — safety-critical fault that usually triggers immediate limp mode.

P2112.en: Throttle Actuator Control System — Stuck Closed
P2112.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The throttle plate cannot be commanded open. The engine stays at idle or stalls under load. Often caused by a seized motor, broken gear, or heavy carbon coking inside the throttle bore.

P2113.en: Throttle Actuator Control System Forced Limited RPM
P2113.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительно ограничены обороты

d.en: The throttle actuator control has detected a fault and limits engine speed to a defined emergency value. The vehicle stays drivable but with severely reduced power until the underlying fault is cleared.

P2114.en: Throttle Actuator Control System Forced Below Limit RPM
P2114.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — принудительно ниже предельных оборотов

d.en: The throttle actuator system has dropped engine speed below the normal limp limit because of a more serious fault. The engine may run only at idle or stall.

P2115.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor A Minimum Stop Performance
P2115.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали A — характеристика при минимальном упоре

d.en: The minimum stop calibration of throttle position sensor A is outside the expected range during the ECU self-check. The signal at fully closed throttle does not match the stored reference, indicating a mechanical or sensor issue.

P2116.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor B Minimum Stop Performance
P2116.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали B — характеристика при минимальном упоре

d.en: The minimum stop calibration of throttle position sensor B does not match the learned reference during ECU self-test. Sensor B is the redundant channel used to cross-check sensor A.

P2117.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor C Minimum Stop Performance
P2117.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали C — характеристика при минимальном упоре

d.en: The minimum stop signal from throttle/pedal position sensor C is out of specification during initialization. Used on systems with three redundant sensor channels for safety-critical drive-by-wire control.

P2118.en: Throttle Actuator Control Motor Current Range/Performance
P2118.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя — ток вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The current draw of the throttle motor lies outside the expected range — either much higher (binding plate) or much lower (worn brushes, open winding) than calibrated.
When commanded to idle, the throttle plate does not reach the calibrated closed position. Often a coked throttle bore preventing the plate from seating fully.

P211A.en: Throttle Actuator B Control System - Stuck Open
P211A.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя B — заклинил открытым

d.en: Throttle B is mechanically stuck open — typically carbon buildup or a broken return spring on the secondary throttle plate.

P211B.en: Throttle Actuator B Control System - Stuck Closed
P211B.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя B — заклинил закрытым

d.en: Throttle B is mechanically stuck closed — carbon buildup or a seized bearing on the secondary throttle.

P211C.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Motor Current Range/Performance
P211C.ru: Двигатель привода дросселя B — ток вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Throttle B motor current draw does not match the calibrated map for the commanded position — high friction, partial short, or stiction.

P211D.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Throttle Body Range/Performance
P211D.ru: Управление приводом дросселя B — дроссельный узел вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The throttle B body itself does not respond as commanded — position feedback is plausible but does not track the setpoint within the calibrated time window.

P211E.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Module Processor
P211E.ru: Блок управления приводом дросселя B — процессор

d.en: The processor monitoring throttle B inside the throttle/PCM has reported a self-test failure — RAM check, ROM check, or watchdog timeout.

P211F.en: Throttle Actuator B Control Module Performance
P211F.ru: Блок управления приводом дросселя B — характеристика

d.en: The throttle control module on the B path reports general performance issues — internal fault, communication mismatch, or calibration drift.
A general electrical fault on the "C" channel of the throttle or pedal position sensor. Drive-by-wire pedals carry two or three redundant tracks; "C" is the third channel.

P2121.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали «C» — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The "C" channel of the throttle or pedal sensor produces an electrically valid signal that does not match the other channels or the operating point.
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor "D" Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor "D" Circuit High: the signal voltage is above the expected range. Often an open circuit or a short to supply voltage.
The "C" channel signal is below the lower threshold — usually a short to ground or an open signal wire.
The "C" channel signal is above the upper threshold — typically a short to positive or an open ground.
The "C" channel produces an intermittent signal — usually a marginal connector or a worn track inside the pedal sensor.
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor "E" Circuit Low: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.
Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor "E" Circuit High: the signal voltage is above the expected range. Often an open circuit or a short to supply voltage.
The "D" channel of the throttle or pedal sensor produces an intermittent signal — typically marginal connector contacts.
A general electrical fault is reported on throttle position sensor G — open, shorted, or out of plausibility. Sensor G is part of a multi-channel redundancy on dual-throttle systems.

P212B.en: Throttle Position Sensor/Switch G Circuit Range/Performance
P212B.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя G — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: TPS G reads in range but plausibility check fails — value sticks, lags, or does not match the commanded throttle position.

P212C.en: Throttle Position Sensor/Switch G Circuit Low
P212C.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя G — низкий сигнал

d.en: TPS G below lower plausibility — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P212D.en: Throttle Position Sensor/Switch G Circuit High
P212D.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя G — высокий сигнал

d.en: TPS G above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P212E.en: Throttle Position Sensor/Switch G Circuit Intermittent
P212E.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя G — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: TPS G signal jumps or drops out intermittently — connector or harness issue. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P212F.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch F/G Voltage Correlation
P212F.ru: Датчики/выключатели положения дросселя/педали F/G — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: Channels F and G of the throttle/pedal position sensor disagree by more than the allowed tolerance. Drive-by-wire system has lost redundancy and may force limp mode.
A general electrical fault is reported on throttle/pedal position sensor F — open, shorted, or out of plausibility.

P2131.ru: Датчик положения дросселя/педали «E» — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The "E" channel of the pedal/throttle sensor produces electrically valid values that do not match other channels or the operating window.
The "E" channel signal is below the lower threshold — typically a short to ground or an open signal wire.
The "E" channel signal is above the upper threshold — usually a short to positive or an open ground.

P2134.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch F Circuit Intermittent
P2134.ru: Датчик/выключатель положения дросселя/педали F — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: TPS/APP sensor F signal jumps or drops out intermittently. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The two redundant throttle position sensors on the throttle body disagree by more than allowed. Distinct from P2138 which monitors the pedal pair — P2135 monitors the throttle-body pair on drive-by-wire systems.

P2136.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor A/C Voltage Correlation
P2136.ru: Датчики положения дросселя/педали A/C — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: The "A" and "C" channels of the throttle or pedal sensor disagree by more than the allowed tolerance. The ECU cannot trust either reading and forces limp-home with reduced torque.

P2137.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor B/C Voltage Correlation
P2137.ru: Датчики положения дросселя/педали B/C — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: The "B" and "C" channels of the throttle or pedal sensor disagree beyond tolerance — the ECU cannot trust either signal and reverts to limp-home.

The two redundant accelerator pedal position sensors disagree by more than the allowed tolerance. The ECU cannot trust either signal and switches to limp-home with very limited torque. Often appears intermittently with a worn pedal sensor before failing outright.

P2139.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch D/F Voltage Correlation
P2139.ru: Датчики/выключатели положения дросселя/педали D/F — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: Channels D and F of the throttle/pedal position sensor disagree by more than the allowed tolerance.

P213A.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления B — обрыв

d.en: The drive circuit of EGR throttle B is open. EGR throttles partially close intake to increase exhaust gas recirculation flow at low loads.

P213B.en: EGR Throttle Control Circuit B Range/Performance
P213B.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: EGR throttle B is electrically OK but does not move as commanded — typically carbon buildup or a sticking actuator.

P213C.en: EGR Throttle Control Circuit B Low
P213C.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления B — низкий сигнал

d.en: EGR throttle B drive line stuck low — short to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P213D.en: EGR Throttle Control Circuit B High
P213D.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления B — высокий сигнал

d.en: EGR throttle B drive line stuck high — short to B+. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P213E.en: Fuel Injection System Fault - Forced Engine Shutdown
P213E.ru: Неисправность системы впрыска — принудительная остановка двигателя

d.en: A safety-critical fuel-injection fault has been detected and the PCM has shut down the engine to prevent damage. Examples are common-rail pressure runaway, multiple stuck-open injectors, or HPFP failure.

P213F.en: Fuel Pump System Fault - Forced Engine Shutdown
P213F.ru: Неисправность системы топливного насоса — принудительная остановка двигателя

d.en: A safety-critical fuel-pump fault has been detected and the engine has been shut down. Typical for HPFP runaway or low-pressure pump that loses control authority.

P2140.en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch E/F Voltage Correlation
P2140.ru: Датчики/выключатели положения дросселя/педали E/F — рассогласование напряжений

d.en: Channels E and F of the throttle/pedal position sensor disagree by more than the allowed tolerance.

P2141.en: EGR Throttle Control Circuit A Low
P2141.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления A — низкий сигнал

d.en: EGR throttle A drive line stuck low — short to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P2142.en: EGR Throttle Control Circuit A High
P2142.ru: Дроссель EGR, цепь управления A — высокий сигнал

d.en: EGR throttle A drive line stuck high — short to B+. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.
The drive circuit of the EGR vent solenoid is open — the solenoid releases vacuum from the EGR actuator. Open circuit means the EGR cannot reset its position.

P2144.ru: Вентиляция EGR, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: EGR vent solenoid drive line stuck low — short to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P2145.ru: Вентиляция EGR, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: EGR vent solenoid drive line stuck high — short to B+. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P2146.en: Fuel Injector Group A Supply Voltage Circuit/Open
P2146.ru: Группа форсунок A, цепь напряжения питания — обрыв

d.en: The ECU detects an open or missing supply voltage on injector group A. The injectors of this bank cannot be energized; the affected cylinders may not fire and the engine runs rough or stalls.

P2147.en: Fuel Injector Group A Supply Voltage Circuit Low
P2147.ru: Группа форсунок A, цепь напряжения питания — низкий сигнал

d.en: The supply voltage measured at injector group A is below the calibrated threshold. Either the supply is shorted to ground or the source voltage has collapsed during cranking or load.

P2148.en: Fuel Injector Group A Supply Voltage Circuit High
P2148.ru: Группа форсунок A, цепь напряжения питания — высокий сигнал

d.en: The injector group A supply voltage exceeds the calibrated upper limit. Often a sign of a short to battery voltage on the supply line, an over-charging alternator or an internal driver failure.

P2149.en: Fuel Injector Group B Supply Voltage Circuit/Open
P2149.ru: Группа форсунок B, цепь напряжения питания — обрыв

d.en: The ECU detects an open or missing supply voltage on injector group B. The injectors on this bank cannot be energized, leading to misfire on the affected cylinders.

P214A.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too High
P214A.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — слишком высокая температура на входе

d.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too High: the component is overheating, typically from extended load or slip.

P214B.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too High During Particulate Filter Regeneration
P214B.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — слишком высокая температура на входе при регенерации сажевого фильтра

d.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too High During Particulate Filter Regeneration: the component is overheating, typically from extended load or slip.

P214C.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Outlet Temperature Too High
P214C.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — слишком высокая температура на выходе

d.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Outlet Temperature Too High: the component is overheating, typically from extended load or slip.

P214D.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Outlet Temperature Too High During Particulate Filter Regeneration
P214D.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — слишком высокая температура на выходе при регенерации сажевого фильтра

P2184.ru: Датчик температуры ОЖ двигателя 2, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: ECT sensor 2 reads below lower plausibility — short to ground. The engine coolant temperature sensor feeds warm-up enrichment, fan control and closed-loop entry — a stuck-cold reading keeps the engine in open loop and rich forever.

Fuel trim on bank 1 hits the lean limit only at idle, while trim returns to normal at higher load. This pattern strongly indicates a vacuum leak — leaks become a larger fraction of total airflow at idle and so dominate the trim, but disappear into background noise above idle.

Fuel trim on bank 1 hits the rich limit only at idle. Often a leaking injector dribbling fuel at low load, a sticky purge valve dumping fuel vapour, or fuel pressure regulator that fails to relieve pressure when intake vacuum is high.

Fuel trim on bank 2 hits the lean limit only at idle, while trim returns to normal at higher load. This pattern strongly indicates a vacuum leak — leaks become a larger fraction of total airflow at idle and so dominate the trim, but disappear into background noise above idle.

d.en: The secondary fuel control loop B reports a rich condition at higher load on bank 2. Rich at high load typically points to a stuck-closed return on the fuel pressure regulator or over-delivering injectors.

The NOx sensor on bank 1 — typically upstream of the SCR catalyst — does not communicate or sends an invalid signal. NOx sensors are smart sensors with their own controller on the CAN bus; faults often involve heater failure or bus dropout.

P2201.ru: Датчик NOx, банк 1 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The bank 1 NOx sensor reports values outside the plausibility window against modeled NOx and the downstream sensor. Often slow response from contamination by oil ash or coolant.
The NOx sensor signal on bank 1 is below the lower limit. Either short to ground on the analog return, sensor failed at low end, or pump cell stuck.
The NOx sensor signal on bank 1 is above the upper limit — short to supply, open ground, or a sensor that failed high. SCR control runs in default mode.
The bank 1 NOx sensor signal drops out intermittently. Typical cause is a marginal connector, harness chafing near hot exhaust components, or thermal-cycling solder joints inside the smart sensor.

P2205.ru: Датчик NOx, банк 1 — цепь управления подогревом

d.en: The heater inside the bank 1 NOx sensor cannot be controlled — open, short, or failed driver. Without proper heater operation the sensor never reaches its operating temperature and reports invalid data.
A general electrical fault on the bank 2 NOx sensor circuit. NOx sensors are smart sensors with a CAN/LIN interface; this code typically indicates that the sensor module no longer responds.

P2207.ru: Датчик NOx, банк 2 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The bank 2 NOx sensor returns values outside the expected range for the operating point — for example a non-zero reading at engine off or unchanged values during load changes.
A general electrical fault on the heater of the bank 2 NOx sensor. NOx sensors must reach roughly 800 C to measure correctly; without heater current the sensor never enters its operating range.

P2209.en: NOx Sensor Heater Sense Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 2)
P2209.ru: Датчик NOx, банк 2 — цепь контроля подогрева, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The heater feedback (sense) line on the bank 2 NOx sensor reports values outside the expected window — heating is happening but the temperature does not match the model.

d.en: The supply voltage rail to the NOx sensor on bank 1 sensor 1 is faulty — typically a fuse, harness break, or short. NOx sensors need a clean stable supply for the heater and the wide-band measurement cell.

P220B.en: NOx Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit (Bank 1 Sensor 2)

P220E.en: NOx Sensor Heater Control Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 Sensor 1)

P220F.en: NOx Sensor Heater Control Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1 Sensor 2)

NOx Sensor Circuit (Bank 2): an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P2214.ru: Датчик NOx, банк 2 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: NOx sensor on bank 2 reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response, drift, or value does not match the model expectation.
NOx Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 2): the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.
NOx Sensor Circuit High (Bank 2): the signal voltage is above the expected range. Often an open circuit or a short to supply voltage.
NOx Sensor Circuit Intermittent (Bank 2): the signal is intermittent or erratic. Often a loose connector or chafed wiring; a wiggle test often locates it.

d.en: O2 sensor at bank 2 sensor 3 reports a rich reading suspiciously stable for too long. Sensor 3 is typically downstream of the second catalyst on systems with three-stage aftertreatment; sensor coated with carbon or fuel residue is the typical cause.

P2278.en: O2 Sensor Signals Swapped Bank 1 Sensor 3 / Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2278.ru: Датчики O2 Б1Д3 и Б2Д3 — сигналы перепутаны

d.en: The PCM detects that the O2 sensor signals from bank 1 sensor 3 and bank 2 sensor 3 are swapped — typically a wiring crossover after sensor replacement.

The ECU has detected a discrepancy between commanded throttle/intake conditions and the resulting MAP/MAF that points to unmetered air entering after the throttle body. On turbocharged engines this often means a cracked or disconnected boost pipe between turbo and intake; on naturally aspirated engines, a hole in the intake manifold or hose.

A general electrical fault on barometric pressure sensor C — open, shorted, or out of plausibility. The sensor measures atmospheric pressure for altitude compensation; sensor C is a redundant or secondary unit.

P227B.en: Barometric Pressure Sensor C Circuit Range/Performance
P227B.ru: Датчик барометрического давления C — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Barometric sensor C reads in range but plausibility check fails — slow response or stuck reading. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P227C.en: Barometric Pressure Sensor C Circuit Low
P227C.ru: Датчик барометрического давления C — низкий сигнал

d.en: Barometric sensor C below lower plausibility — short to ground. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P227D.en: Barometric Pressure Sensor C Circuit High
P227D.ru: Датчик барометрического давления C — высокий сигнал

d.en: Barometric sensor C above upper plausibility — open signal or short to B+. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P227E.en: Barometric Pressure Sensor C Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P227E.ru: Датчик барометрического давления C — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Barometric sensor C signal jumps or drops out intermittently. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P227F.en: Air Flow Restriction/Air Leak Between Air Filter and MAF (Bank 2)
P227F.ru: Ограничение потока/подсос воздуха между воздушным фильтром и MAF, банк 2

d.en: Restriction or leak detected in the intake plumbing between the air filter and the mass-air-flow sensor on bank 2 — typically a cracked intake boot or torn filter element.

P2280.en: Air Flow Restriction / Air Filter Restriction
P2280.ru: Ограничение потока воздуха / засорён воздушный фильтр

d.en: The ECU detects an excessive intake restriction. Either the air filter is heavily clogged or an obstruction in the intake duct is reducing airflow below the expected level.

P2281.en: Air Leak Between MAF and Throttle Body
P2281.ru: Подсос воздуха между MAF и дроссельной заслонкой

d.en: The ECU detects unmetered air entering between the mass airflow sensor and the throttle body. The actual airflow into the engine is greater than what the MAF measures, leading to lean conditions.

P2282.en: Air Leak Between Throttle Body and Intake Valves
P2282.ru: Подсос воздуха между дроссельной заслонкой и впускными клапанами

d.en: The ECU detects unmetered air entering downstream of the throttle body. Typical sources are leaking intake-manifold gaskets, vacuum hoses or PCV components.

A general electrical fault on the injector control pressure (ICP) sensor — used on HEUI (Hydraulically actuated Electronically controlled Unit Injector) systems on heavy-duty diesel engines such as the Ford Powerstroke 6.0/7.3 and Caterpillar engines. ICP measures the high-pressure oil that actuates the injectors.

P2284.en: Injector Control Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2284.ru: Датчик давления управления форсунками — вне диапазона

d.en: The injector control pressure (ICP) sensor on HEUI diesel systems reports a value that does not match expected operating range or commanded pressure. Affects fuel injection timing and quantity.

P2285.en: Injector Control Pressure Sensor Circuit Low
P2285.ru: Датчик давления управления форсунками — низкий сигнал

d.en: The voltage of the injector control pressure sensor is below the calibrated minimum. The signal indicates either a short to ground or a sensor that has lost its supply.

P2286.en: Injector Control Pressure Sensor Circuit High
P2286.ru: Датчик давления управления форсунками — высокий сигнал

d.en: The voltage of the injector control pressure sensor is above the calibrated maximum. Likely a short to supply voltage or an open ground in the sensor circuit.

P2287.ru: Датчик давления управления форсунками — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The injector control pressure sensor signal is intermittently lost or out of range. Often caused by intermittent wiring faults or a failing sensor that drops out under vibration or temperature.
ICP is above the upper threshold during operation. Typically the injection pressure regulator (IPR) is stuck closed or the high-pressure oil pump runs above target.

P2289.en: Injector Control Pressure Too High - Engine Off
P2289.ru: Давление управления форсунками слишком высокое при заглушенном моторе

d.en: ICP remains above threshold after engine shutdown — pressure does not bleed off as expected, indicating a stuck check valve or sensor offset error.

P228A.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A - Forced Engine Shutdown
P228A.ru: Регулятор давления топлива A — принудительная остановка двигателя

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A - Forced Engine Shutdown: the control module has detected this fault condition. This controls fuel-rail pressure.

P228B.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator B - Forced Engine Shutdown
P228B.ru: Регулятор давления топлива B — принудительная остановка двигателя

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator B - Forced Engine Shutdown: the control module has detected this fault condition. This controls fuel-rail pressure.

P228C.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Control Limits - Pressure Too Low
P228C.ru: Регулятор давления топлива A — превышены пределы управления, давление слишком низкое

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Control Limits - Pressure Too Low: the control module has detected this fault condition. This controls fuel-rail pressure.

P228D.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Control Limits - Pressure Too High
P228D.ru: Регулятор давления топлива A — превышены пределы управления, давление слишком высокое

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Control Limits - Pressure Too High: the control module has detected this fault condition. This controls fuel-rail pressure.

P228E.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Learning Limits - Too Low
P228E.ru: Регулятор давления топлива A — превышены пределы обучения, слишком низкое

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Learning Limits - Too Low: the adaptive learning value has reached its lower limit, so the ECU can no longer compensate. This controls fuel-rail pressure.

P228F.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Learning Limits - Too High
P228F.ru: Регулятор давления топлива A — превышены пределы обучения, слишком высокое

d.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator A Exceeded Learning Limits - Too High: the adaptive learning value has reached its upper limit, so the ECU can no longer compensate. This controls fuel-rail pressure.
ICP is below the lower threshold — typically IPR stuck open, leaking high-pressure oil rail, or weak HP oil pump.

P2291.en: Injector Control Pressure Too Low - Engine Cranking
P2291.ru: Давление управления форсунками слишком низкое при прокрутке

d.en: During cranking, ICP does not build up enough to fire injectors. Typical no-start condition on HEUI engines from a stuck-open IPR or weak HP oil pump.

ICP signal is unstable or jumps — connector or sensor issue, or air in the high-pressure oil rail. A flow-deviating injector throws off cylinder balance — adjacent cylinders run leaner/richer to compensate, often masking the root cause until the trim limit is hit.

The high-pressure fuel pressure regulator (volume control or pressure control valve on a direct-injection rail) is not maintaining commanded pressure. Often the rail-pressure sensor reading drifts away from the setpoint under load.

Electrical fault on the control line to the high-pressure fuel pressure regulator solenoid. Without a working drive signal the rail cannot maintain pressure and the engine may not start or runs in limp-home.

P2295.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator 2 Control Circuit Low
P2295.ru: Регулятор давления топлива 2, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Drive voltage to the second fuel pressure regulator solenoid is below the lower limit. On common-rail diesels and direct-injection petrol engines this affects high-pressure fuel control directly.

P2296.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator 2 Control Circuit High
P2296.ru: Регулятор давления топлива 2, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Drive voltage to the second fuel pressure regulator solenoid is above the upper limit — short to supply or open ground side. The driver protection trips, regulator falls back to default.

P2297.en: O2 Sensor Out of Range During Deceleration (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
P2297.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — вне диапазона при замедлении

d.en: During engine deceleration with closed throttle (DFCO), the O2 sensor on bank 1 sensor 1 should swing fully lean as the manifold fills with fresh air. Code is set when the swing does not happen — usually a slow or coated sensor.

P2298.en: O2 Sensor Out of Range During Deceleration (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
P2298.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — вне диапазона при замедлении

d.en: During engine deceleration with closed throttle (DFCO), the O2 sensor on bank 2 sensor 1 should swing fully lean as the manifold fills with fresh air. Code is set when the swing does not happen — usually a slow or coated sensor.

P2299.en: Brake Pedal Position / Accelerator Pedal Position Correlation
P2299.ru: Положение педали тормоза / положение педали газа — рассогласование

d.en: The ECU detects simultaneous brake and accelerator activation beyond a permitted threshold. Modern brake-throttle override safety logic forces idle in this state — usually triggered by a stuck brake light switch or a faulty pedal sensor.

P229A.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator B Exceeded Control Limits - Pressure Too Low
P229A.ru: Регулятор давления топлива B — превышены пределы управления, давление слишком низкое

P229D.en: Fuel Pressure Regulator B Exceeded Learning Limits - Too High
P229D.ru: Регулятор давления топлива B — превышены пределы обучения, слишком высокое

d.en: The adaptive learning offset for fuel pressure regulator B has reached the upper limit. Long-term drift upward indicates progressive wear of the regulator or a return path that is becoming restricted.
NOx Sensor Circuit (Bank 1 Sensor 2): an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P229F.en: NOx Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1 Sensor 2
P229F.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д2 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The downstream NOx sensor on bank 1 (after the SCR catalyst) returns implausible NOx readings during operation. Either the sensor is degraded or upstream chemistry is abnormal.
NOx Sensor Circuit Low (Bank 1 Sensor 2): the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.
NOx Sensor Circuit High (Bank 1 Sensor 2): the signal voltage is above the expected range. Often an open circuit or a short to supply voltage.
NOx Sensor Circuit Intermittent (Bank 1 Sensor 2): the signal is intermittent or erratic. Often a loose connector or chafed wiring; a wiggle test often locates it.

P22A3.en: NOx Sensor Heater Control Circuit/Open (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P22A3.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д2 — цепь управления подогревом, обрыв

d.en: NOx Sensor Heater Control Circuit/Open (Bank 1 Sensor 2): the control circuit is open. The NOx sensor heater brings the sensor to operating temperature; a fault delays accurate NOx readings used for SCR control.

P22AB.en: O2 Sensor Positive Current Control Circuit/Open (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P22AB.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — цепь положительного тока, обрыв

P22F9.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д1 — характеристика, медленный отклик, с низкого на высокий

d.en: NOx sensor on bank 1 sensor 1 responds too slowly when NOx concentration rises (typically observed when SCR dosing is reduced or stopped). The sensor has aged or its protection cap is clogged.

P22FA.en: NOx Sensor Performance - Slow Response High to Low (Bank 1 Sensor 1)

P22FB.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д1 — характеристика, чувствительный элемент

d.en: The wide-band sensing element of the NOx sensor on bank 1 sensor 1 reports an internal performance fault — typically poisoning, condensate damage, or end of service life.

P22FC.en: NOx Sensor Performance - Slow Response Low to High (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
P22FC.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д2 — характеристика, медленный отклик, с низкого на высокий

d.en: NOx sensor on bank 1 sensor 2 responds too slowly when NOx concentration rises (typically observed when SCR dosing is reduced or stopped). The sensor has aged or its protection cap is clogged.

P22FD.en: NOx Sensor Performance Slow Response High to Low Bank 1 Sensor 2
P22FD.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д2 — характеристика, медленный отклик, с высокого на низкий

d.en: The downstream NOx sensor on bank 1 (post-SCR) responds too slowly when NOx levels fall after a reductant injection event. The control unit measures the time between commanded reductant dose and the resulting NOx drop and finds it exceeds the diagnostic threshold, indicating an aged sensor element.

P22FE.en: NOx Sensor Sensing Element Bank 1 Sensor 2

d.en: NOx Sensor Sensing Element Bank 1 Sensor 2: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P22FF.en: SCR NOx Catalyst Inlet Temperature Too Low
P22FF.ru: Катализатор SCR NOx — слишком низкая температура на входе

d.en: The temperature sensor at the SCR catalyst inlet reports a value below the threshold needed for efficient ammonia conversion. Below roughly 180-200 °C the SCR cannot reduce NOx and reductant injection is suspended; if this is detected continuously the ECU sets the fault.

P2300.en: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit Low
P2300.ru: Катушка зажигания A, первичная цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The primary control circuit of ignition coil A reads a voltage below the expected level — usually a short to ground on the primary driver wire or a low-resistance fault in the coil primary winding. Coil A cannot build a normal charge, so the cylinder it fires misfires, especially under load. Causes: short to ground in the primary wiring, an internal coil primary fault, or a faulty ECU/igniter driver.

P2301.en: Ignition Coil A Primary Control Circuit High
P2301.ru: Катушка зажигания A, первичная цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: The primary control circuit of ignition coil A reads a voltage above the expected level — typically an open primary circuit or a short to battery voltage on the primary control wire. The ECU sees no normal current flow, coil A does not fire, and the cylinder misfires. Causes: an open or disconnected primary wire, an internal open in the coil, or a faulty ECU driver.

A fault is detected on the secondary (high-voltage) side of ignition coil A. The spark delivered to the plug is missing or too weak, causing a misfire on the cylinder served by coil A. Causes: a worn spark plug or wide gap, a cracked coil or boot, carbon tracking, or an open or leaking secondary winding.

P2303.en: Ignition Coil B Primary Control Circuit Low
P2303.ru: Катушка зажигания B, первичная цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The ECU reads a low primary control voltage on ignition coil B. Misfire is typically observed on the cylinder this coil serves.

P2304.en: Ignition Coil B Primary Control Circuit High
P2304.ru: Катушка зажигания B, первичная цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the primary control of ignition coil B exceeds the calibrated upper limit, indicating an electrical fault that prevents proper coil charging.
The secondary side of ignition coil B is faulty. Spark energy at the corresponding spark plug is insufficient, producing misfires.

P2306.en: Ignition Coil C Primary Control Circuit Low
P2306.ru: Катушка зажигания C, первичная цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The primary control of ignition coil C reads below the calibrated minimum. The cylinder served by this coil will misfire.

P2307.en: Ignition Coil C Primary Control Circuit High
P2307.ru: Катушка зажигания C, первичная цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: The primary control voltage at ignition coil C exceeds the upper limit, suggesting a short to battery or an open primary winding.
The secondary side of ignition coil C does not produce sufficient spark energy. Misfire is observed on the corresponding cylinder.

P2309.en: Ignition Coil D Primary Control Circuit Low
P2309.ru: Катушка зажигания D, первичная цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Low primary control voltage on ignition coil D. The cylinder served by this coil will misfire if not corrected quickly.

Cylinder 12 measured peak combustion pressure is above the calibrated maximum — typically pre-ignition, knock, over-fuelling, or runaway combustion.

Cylinder-to-cylinder pressure variation on cylinder 12 is below the calibrated minimum — pressure stays unusually constant cycle-to-cycle, often a sign that the closed-loop combustion controller has lost authority or the sensor signal is filtered.
Cylinder-to-cylinder pressure variation on cylinder 12 is above the calibrated maximum — combustion is unstable cycle-to-cycle, typical of partial misfire or injector seat erosion.

The closed-loop combustion controller reports that combustion performance on cylinder 12 is below the calibrated quality metric. Computed from the cylinder pressure trace — IMEP (indicated mean effective pressure), CA50 (50% mass burnt angle) or peak pressure deviates from the model.

P23E1.ru: Клапан EGR C — обрыв цепи управления

d.en: A general open-circuit fault on the third EGR valve C control - typically a third EGR loop in heavy-duty engines or specific Euro-7 systems.

P23E2.ru: Клапан EGR C — цепь управления, характеристика

d.en: Same as P23E1 with the actuator electrically intact but not delivering the commanded position. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P23E3.ru: Клапан EGR C — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P23E1 with the control line shorted to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

d.en: Same as P23E1 with the control line shorted to supply. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.
EGR valve C is stuck in the open position - exhaust gas continuously dilutes intake air, reducing power and risking misfires at idle.

Same as P23E5 with valve C stuck closed - no EGR through this stage; NOx emissions rise. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

d.en: The secondary fuel system B on bank 1 (e.g. port-injection rail in a dual-injection engine, or LPG/CNG rail in a bi-fuel system) does not maintain calibrated mixture - lambda response on bank 1 is biased by an offset on the B system.

P2400.en: EVAP Leak Detection Pump Control Circuit Open
P2400.ru: Насос диагностики утечек EVAP, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The control circuit to the EVAP leak-detection pump is open. Without that pump the ECU cannot pressurise the fuel-vapour system to test for leaks.

P2401.en: EVAP Leak Detection Pump Control Circuit Low
P2401.ru: Насос диагностики утечек EVAP, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Drive voltage on the leak-detection pump line is below the lower limit. Often a short to ground in the harness.

P2402.en: EVAP Leak Detection Pump Control Circuit High
P2402.ru: Насос диагностики утечек EVAP, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Drive voltage on the leak-detection pump line is above the upper limit. Usually a short to supply or open ground.

P2403.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Pump Sense Circuit Open
P2403.ru: Система EVAP, насос диагностики утечек, цепь датчика — обрыв

d.en: The leak detection pump (LDP) - which actively pressurises the EVAP system to find leaks - has an open sense circuit. The ECU cannot read the pump status during the diagnostic cycle.

P2404.en: EVAP Leak Detection Pump Sense Circuit Range/Performance
P2404.ru: Насос диагностики утечек EVAP, цепь датчика — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The sense (reed-switch or current-feedback) signal from the leak-detection pump is electrically valid but does not match expectations during a leak test. Often a worn pump diaphragm or a sticking reed contact.

P2405.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Pump Sense Circuit Low
P2405.ru: Система EVAP, насос диагностики утечек, цепь датчика — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P2403 with the sense voltage below the plausible range. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P2406.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Pump Sense Circuit High
P2406.ru: Система EVAP, насос диагностики утечек, цепь датчика — высокий сигнал

P2407.en: EVAP Leak Detection Pump Sense Circuit Range/Performance
P2407.ru: Насос диагностики утечек EVAP, цепь датчика — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The leak detection pump returns a sense signal that is electrically valid but does not match the expected response during the pump's self-test or pressure cycle.

P2408.ru: Датчик/выключатель крышки бака, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: On vehicles with a sensed fuel cap, the cap-status signal is electrically valid but does not change as expected when the cap is opened or closed.

P2409.en: Fuel Cap Sensor or Switch Circuit Range or Performance
P2409.ru: Датчик или выключатель крышки бака, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The sensor or switch that detects whether the fuel cap is properly closed reports a value within plausible range yet not matching driver action.

P240A.ru: Система EVAP, подогрев насоса диагностики утечек, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The leak detection pump heater - keeps the pump diaphragm warm in cold weather - has an open control circuit.

P240B.en: EVAP System Leak Detection Pump Heater Control Circuit Low
P240B.ru: Система EVAP, подогрев насоса диагностики утечек, цепь управления — низкий сигнал
