d.en: Same as P240A with the control line shorted to supply. The sensor heater warms the element to operating temperature (~600 °C); without it the lambda sensor stays inactive in closed loop and the ECM cannot trim mixture.

P240D.en: Alternative Fuel Low Pressure System Leak
P240D.ru: Утечка в системе низкого давления альтернативного топлива

d.en: Alternative Fuel Low Pressure System Leak: a leak has been detected in this brake-hydraulic circuit, which reduces braking pressure. Safety-critical.

P240E.en: Alternative Fuel High Pressure System Leak
P240E.ru: Утечка в системе высокого давления альтернативного топлива

d.en: Alternative Fuel High Pressure System Leak: a leak has been detected in this brake-hydraulic circuit, which reduces braking pressure. Safety-critical.
The EGR system reacts to commanded changes more slowly than calibrated - typically a partly clogged EGR cooler, sticky valve, or worn actuator.
The fuel cap status switch is stuck in one position — the ECU never sees the expected transition between open and closed.
A general electrical fault on the fuel cap sensor/switch circuit — open or short.

P2412.en: Fuel Cap Sensor or Switch Circuit Intermittent or Erratic
P2412.ru: Датчик или выключатель крышки бака, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P2409 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
The ECU monitors EGR flow indirectly through MAF, MAP or differential-pressure feedback and finds that actual EGR flow does not match the commanded value over a sustained period.

P2414.en: O2 Sensor Exhaust Sample Error Bank 1 Sensor 1
P2414.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — ошибка пробы отработавших газов

d.en: Same as P237A but on the upstream sensor B1S1 (pre-catalyst). A drifted or sluggish lambda sensor lets the mixture run lean or rich without correction — fuel economy and emissions suffer immediately.
The ECU detects an open circuit on the EVAP switching valve drive line. The valve cannot be commanded between its purge and isolation positions.
The EVAP switching valve responds electrically but does not produce the expected pressure change. Often a stuck valve seat or a torn diaphragm.
The EVAP switching valve cannot reach the open position. Purge flow is blocked and the EVAP system cannot vent the canister.

P2418.en: EVAP Switching Valve Control Circuit Performance
P2418.ru: Переключающий клапан EVAP, цепь управления — характеристика

d.en: The evaporative switching valve — used on multi-path EVAP systems to route purge or pressure-test flow — does not respond as expected. Self-test fails because tank pressure does not change in the calibrated direction.
The EVAP switching valve cannot close. Tank pressure cannot be isolated for the leak detection test, and purge routing may bypass the canister.

P241A.en: O2 Sensor Signals Swapped Bank 1 Sensor 1 and Sensor 2
P241A.ru: Датчики O2 Б1Д1 и Б1Д2 — сигналы перепутаны

d.en: The pre- and post-catalyst lambda signals on bank 1 are swapped - the upstream sensor responds like a downstream sensor and vice versa. Typically the harness was reversed during a sensor change.

P241B.en: O2 Sensor Signals Swapped Bank 2 Sensor 1 and Sensor 2
P241B.ru: Датчики O2 Б2Д1 и Б2Д2 — сигналы перепутаны

d.en: The pre- and post-catalyst lambda signals on bank 2 are swapped - the upstream sensor responds like a downstream sensor and vice versa. Typically the harness was reversed during a sensor change.

P241C.en: Throttle Actuator Control System Ice Blockage Bank 2
P241C.ru: Система управления приводом дросселя — обледенение, банк 2

d.en: The throttle actuator on bank 2 cannot move because of ice formation - typical for very cold ambient temperature with humid intake. Engine de-ices on warm-up.

P241D.ru: Принудительная остановка двигателя по требованию SCR

d.en: The SCR inducement strategy (mandatory regulatory measure to enforce AdBlue refilling and emissions compliance) has reached the final stage and shut down the engine. Refill AdBlue and clear inducement fault to restart.

P241E.en: Reductant Heater Coolant Control Valve Stuck Closed
P241E.ru: Клапан охлаждающей жидкости подогрева реагента — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The valve that routes engine coolant to heat the AdBlue lines is stuck closed - AdBlue lines do not warm up and may freeze in cold weather, blocking dosing.

P241F.en: EGR Cooler B Efficiency Below Threshold
P241F.ru: Охладитель EGR B — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: The temperature drop across EGR cooler B is below the calibrated threshold - cooler is fouled with soot, has internal scaling, or coolant flow is restricted. Recirculated gas reaches the intake hotter than designed, increasing NOx and combustion temperatures.
The EVAP switching valve cannot open when commanded. Purge or test flow cannot reach the appropriate path and the leak monitor aborts.
The evaporative emission system vent valve does not close on command. The ECU detects that the evap system cannot hold pressure or vacuum because the canister is permanently vented to atmosphere.

P2422.en: EVAP Canister Vent Valve Stuck Closed
P2422.ru: Клапан вентиляции адсорбера EVAP — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The vent valve at the canister end of the EVAP system cannot open. Without ambient air entering the canister, fresh fuel cannot purge the stored vapors and refueling may trigger ORVR issues. Common with rusted or rodent-damaged vent valves.

P2423.en: HC Adsorption Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold Bank 1
P2423.ru: Катализатор-адсорбер HC, банк 1 — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: The ECU determines that the hydrocarbon adsorption catalyst on bank 1 no longer holds enough HC during cold start to meet emission targets. Often due to ageing or thermal damage.

P2424.en: HC Adsorption Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold Bank 2
P2424.ru: Катализатор-адсорбер HC, банк 2 — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: The hydrocarbon adsorption catalyst on bank 2 - which traps HC during cold-start until the main catalyst lights off - is degraded; HC slip during cold start is above the calibrated threshold.

P2425.en: EGR Cooling Valve Control Circuit Open
P2425.ru: Клапан охлаждения EGR — обрыв цепи управления

d.en: The valve that admits coolant flow to the EGR cooler has an open control circuit - cooling cannot be enabled and EGR temperatures stay too high.

P2426.en: EGR Cooling Valve Control Circuit Low
P2426.ru: Клапан охлаждения EGR — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P2425 with the control line shorted to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P2427.en: EGR Cooling Valve Control Circuit High
P2427.ru: Клапан охлаждения EGR — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P2425 with the control line shorted to supply. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P2428.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Too High Bank 1
P2428.ru: Слишком высокая температура выхлопных газов, банк 1

d.en: An EGT sensor on bank 1 reports a temperature above the safety threshold for prolonged operation - typical for blocked DPF, restricted exhaust, or excessive fuelling. Risk of catalyst, DPF or turbo damage.

P2429.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Too High Bank 2
P2429.ru: Слишком высокая температура выхлопных газов, банк 2

d.en: An EGT sensor on bank 2 reports a temperature above the safety threshold for prolonged operation - typical for blocked DPF, restricted exhaust, or excessive fuelling. Risk of catalyst, DPF or turbo damage.

P242A.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Bank 1 Sensor 3
P242A.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 3

d.en: A general circuit fault is detected on the EGT sensor at bank 1 sensor 3 (typically just downstream of the turbo or before the catalyst). The ECU loses thermal protection feedback for the catalyst and DPF.

P242B.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Range or Performance Bank 1 Sensor 3
P242B.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 3 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P242A with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model.

P242C.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Bank 1 Sensor 3
P242C.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 3 — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P242A with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P242D.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit High Bank 1 Sensor 3
P242D.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 3 — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P242A with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P242E.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic Bank 1 Sensor 3
P242E.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 1, датчик 3 — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P242A with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P242F.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Ash Accumulation Bank 1

d.en: The diesel particulate filter on bank 1 reports backpressure attributable to ash (non-combustible residue from oil and fuel additives, not removable by regeneration). The filter has reached the end of its service life and needs cleaning or replacement.

P2430.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Bank 1
P2430.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — цепь, банк 1

d.en: A general circuit fault on the secondary air injection (AIR) system flow or pressure sensor on bank 1 - the sensor that verifies air pump flow during cold-start enrichment compensation.

P2431.en: Secondary Air Injection System Air Flow/Pressure Sensor Circuit

d.en: The ECU detects a general fault in the secondary air injection system air flow or pressure sensor circuit. The diagnostic cannot verify proper SAI operation.

P2432.en: Secondary Air Injection System Air Flow/Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2432.ru: Датчик расхода/давления вторичного воздуха — цепь, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The signal of the SAI air flow or pressure sensor is implausible during operation. The reading does not change as expected when the air pump is commanded.

P2433.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit High Bank 1
P2433.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Same as P2430 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2434.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic Bank 1
P2434.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Same as P2430 with intermittent or erratic signal. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2435.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Bank 2
P2435.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — цепь, банк 2

d.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Bank 2: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

P2436.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Range or Performance Bank 2
P2436.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 2

d.en: Same as P2430 on bank 2 with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model.

P2437.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Low Bank 2
P2437.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Low Bank 2: the signal voltage is below the expected range. Often a short to ground or high resistance in the wiring.

P2438.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit High Bank 2
P2438.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Same as P2433 on bank 2. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2439.en: AIR System Air Flow or Pressure Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic Bank 2
P2439.ru: Датчик расхода или давления воздуха системы AIR — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Same as P2434 on bank 2. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P243A.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Ash Accumulation Bank 2

d.en: The diesel particulate filter on bank 2 reports backpressure attributable to ash (non-combustible residue from oil and fuel additives, not removable by regeneration). The filter has reached the end of its service life and needs cleaning or replacement.

P243B.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Forced Limited Power Bank 2
P243B.ru: Сажевый фильтр — засорение, принудительное ограничение мощности, банк 2

d.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Forced Limited Power Bank 2: the control module has detected this fault condition.
The DPF on bank 2 needs regeneration more often than calibrated. Possible causes are an oil-burning engine, fuel-injector leak, short-trip operation, or a sensor offset.
Regenerations on bank 2 take longer than calibrated to complete - typically a low EGT during the cycle (cold weather, short trips) or a partially aged catalyst before the DPF.

P243E.ru: Сажевый фильтр — регенерация не завершена, банк 2

d.en: Particulate Filter Regeneration Incomplete Bank 2: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P243F.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Soot Accumulation Too High Bank 2
P243F.ru: Сажевый фильтр — слишком высокое накопление сажи, банк 2

d.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Soot Accumulation Too High Bank 2: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P2440.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve Stuck Open (Bank 1)
P2440.ru: Переключающий клапан вторичного воздуха заклинил открытым (банк 1)

d.en: The switching/check valve in the secondary air injection plumbing on bank 1 is stuck in the open position. With the valve permanently open, exhaust gas can back-feed into the air pump and corrode it, while the downstream O2 sensor sees ambient air constantly.

P2441.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve Stuck Closed (Bank 1)
P2441.ru: Переключающий клапан вторичного воздуха заклинил закрытым (банк 1)

d.en: The switching valve on bank 1 will not open when commanded, so no secondary air reaches the exhaust during cold start. Catalyst light-off is delayed and emissions during the cold-start window rise.

P2442.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve Stuck Open (Bank 2)
P2442.ru: Переключающий клапан вторичного воздуха заклинил открытым (банк 2)

d.en: The switching/check valve in the secondary air injection plumbing on bank 2 is stuck in the open position. With the valve permanently open, exhaust gas can back-feed into the air pump and corrode it, while the downstream O2 sensor sees ambient air constantly.

P2443.en: Secondary Air Injection System Switching Valve Stuck Closed (Bank 2)
P2443.ru: Переключающий клапан вторичного воздуха заклинил закрытым (банк 2)

d.en: The switching valve on bank 2 will not open when commanded, so no secondary air reaches the exhaust during cold start. Catalyst light-off is delayed and emissions during the cold-start window rise.

P2444.en: Secondary Air Injection System Pump Stuck Off (Bank 1)
P2444.ru: Насос системы вторичного воздуха заклинил выключенным (банк 1)

d.en: The secondary-air pump does not run when commanded during cold start. Often a seized pump (after exhaust back-feed corroded the impeller), a blown fuse, or a failed relay.

P2445.en: Secondary Air Injection System Pump Stuck On (Bank 1)
P2445.ru: Насос системы вторичного воздуха заклинил включённым (банк 1)

d.en: The secondary-air pump continues to run after the cold-start window, when the ECU has commanded it off. Usually a stuck-closed relay welding the pump permanently to battery voltage.

P2446.en: Secondary Air Injection Pump Stuck Off (Bank 2)

d.en: Bank 2 secondary air pump does not deliver air when commanded. The catalyst light-off process is delayed and cold-start emissions rise.

P2447.en: Secondary Air Injection Pump Stuck On (Bank 2)

d.en: Bank 2 secondary air pump runs continuously. Either a stuck-on relay or a shorted control output keeps the pump powered when it should be off.

P2448.en: AIR System High Air Flow Bank 1
P2448.ru: Система AIR — высокий расход воздуха, банк 1

d.en: The secondary air injection system on bank 1 delivers more flow than calibrated when the pump is commanded on - typically a stuck-open switching valve allowing free flow.

P2449.en: AIR System High Air Flow Bank 2
P2449.ru: Система AIR — высокий расход воздуха, банк 2

d.en: The secondary air injection system on bank 2 delivers more flow than calibrated when the pump is commanded on - typically a stuck-open switching valve allowing free flow.

P244A.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Too Low
P244A.ru: Перепад давления на сажевом фильтре (DPF) слишком низкий

d.en: The differential pressure across the DPF is below the calibrated minimum even at higher loads. Often a sign of a damaged or missing filter substrate, or a leak in the sensing line.

P244B.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Sensor Offset
P244B.ru: Датчик перепада давления сажевого фильтра (DPF) — смещение нуля

d.en: At engine off, the DPF differential pressure sensor does not return to zero within the allowed offset window. The static offset is too large to be ignored.

P244C.en: Exhaust Temperature Too Low For Particulate Filter Regeneration Bank 1
P244C.ru: Слишком низкая температура выхлопа для регенерации сажевого фильтра, банк 1

d.en: During an attempted regeneration of the bank 1 DPF the EGT did not reach the temperature window needed for soot oxidation. Regeneration could not start or was held. Driving in higher load is needed.

P244D.en: Exhaust Temperature Too High For Particulate Filter Regeneration Bank 1
P244D.ru: Слишком высокая температура выхлопа для регенерации сажевого фильтра, банк 1

d.en: Same as P244C with the EGT too high - regeneration paused to protect filter substrate from melt damage.

P244E.en: Exhaust Temperature Too Low For Particulate Filter Regeneration Bank 2
P244E.ru: Слишком низкая температура выхлопа для регенерации сажевого фильтра, банк 2

d.en: During an attempted regeneration of the bank 2 DPF the EGT did not reach the temperature window needed for soot oxidation. Regeneration could not start or was held. Driving in higher load is needed.

P244F.en: Exhaust Temperature Too High For Particulate Filter Regeneration Bank 2
P244F.ru: Слишком высокая температура выхлопа для регенерации сажевого фильтра, банк 2

d.en: Same as P244D on bank 2.

P2450.ru: Система EVAP, переключающий клапан — характеристика / заклинил

d.en: The EVAP switching valve does not respond to commands as expected. The valve is mechanically stuck or unable to switch between purge and vent paths, blocking proper leak diagnosis.

P2451.en: EVAP System Switching Valve Stuck Closed
P2451.ru: Система EVAP, переключающий клапан — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The EVAP switching valve - which directs vapor flow between purge and leak-detection paths - is stuck in the closed position. The diagnostic cycle cannot complete.

P2452.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor Circuit

d.en: A general electrical fault on the DPF differential-pressure sensor circuit. Without a valid pressure reading the ECU cannot estimate soot load and may inhibit regeneration.

P2453.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2453.ru: Датчик давления сажевого фильтра (DPF) — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The DPF differential-pressure sensor produces a value that is electrically valid but does not match expectations — for example a non-zero reading with engine off or no change between idle and load.

P2454.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor Circuit Low
P2454.ru: Датчик давления сажевого фильтра (DPF) — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the DPF differential-pressure sensor signal line is below the lower threshold. Typically a short to ground or an open in the supply line.

P2455.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor Circuit High
P2455.ru: Датчик давления сажевого фильтра (DPF) — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the DPF pressure sensor line exceeds the upper threshold. Usually a short to supply or an open ground on the sensor.

P2456.en: DPF Differential Pressure Sensor Circuit Intermittent
P2456.ru: Датчик перепада давления DPF — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The DPF differential-pressure sensor delivers an intermittent signal — usually a marginal connector or a chafed wiring section that breaks contact during temperature or vibration.
The EGR cooler does not lower exhaust gas temperature as expected — typically internal coolant fouling, a partial blockage, or a cracked cooler that mixes coolant with exhaust gas.

The DPF regeneration cycle takes longer than the calibrated maximum. The ECU sets this code when the soot load is not being burned off within the expected window — common after many short trips or with degraded post-injection.

Active DPF regenerations are being requested more often than the calibration window allows. Indicates that soot accumulates faster than the filter can burn it off — typically due to short-trip use, leaking injectors, or excessive engine oil consumption.

P245A.en: EGR Cooler Bypass Control Circuit Open Bank 1
P245A.ru: Байпас охладителя EGR, банк 1 — обрыв цепи управления

d.en: The EGR cooler bypass valve on bank 1 - routes EGR around the cooler during cold-start to keep cabin and engine warm-up fast - has an open control circuit.

P245B.en: EGR Cooler Bypass Control Circuit Range or Performance Bank 1
P245B.ru: Байпас охладителя EGR, банк 1 — цепь управления, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P245A with the actuator electrically intact yet not delivering the commanded position. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P245C.en: EGR Cooler Bypass Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P245C.ru: Байпас охладителя EGR, банк 1 — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P245A with the control line shorted to ground. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P245D.en: EGR Cooler Bypass Control Circuit High Bank 1
P245D.ru: Байпас охладителя EGR, банк 1 — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P245A with the control line shorted to supply. EGR mixes inert exhaust into intake to lower combustion peak temperature — too little raises NOx, too much causes misfires and rough running.

P245E.en: Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor B Circuit
P245E.ru: Датчик давления сажевого фильтра B — цепь

d.en: A general circuit fault on the secondary differential pressure sensor B across the DPF - measures backpressure for the regeneration strategy.

P245F.en: Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor B Circuit Range or Performance
P245F.ru: Датчик давления сажевого фильтра B — цепь, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P245E with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model.
The DPF restriction has reached a level that forces the ECU to limit engine power. The driver must allow a forced regeneration or have the filter serviced before normal power is restored.
The DPF restriction has reached the limit defined for forced limited operation. Vehicle behaviour depends on the manufacturer — usually a hard torque cap with a service warning.

P2462.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Restriction - Soot Accumulation

d.en: The DPF differential pressure sensor reports a backpressure rise consistent with excessive soot accumulation. The filter cannot regenerate fast enough, eventually causing limp mode.

P2463.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Restriction — Soot Accumulation

d.en: The estimated soot mass in the DPF has crossed the upper limit and the ECU could not complete a regeneration to bring it back down. Very common on cars used on short trips. Continued driving in this state risks a runaway regeneration that destroys the filter.

P2464.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Too High
P2464.ru: Перепад давления на сажевом фильтре (DPF) слишком высокий

d.en: The differential pressure across the DPF exceeds the calibrated upper threshold during operation. Indicates severe blockage of the filter element.

P2465.en: Diesel Particulate Filter Differential Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
P2465.ru: Датчик перепада давления сажевого фильтра (DPF) — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The DPF differential pressure sensor signal is implausible compared to engine load and exhaust flow. Either the sensor or the pressure tubes leading to it are at fault.

P2466.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2466.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 3

d.en: A general circuit fault is detected on the EGT sensor at bank 2 sensor 3 (typically just downstream of the turbo or before the catalyst). The ECU loses thermal protection feedback for the catalyst and DPF.

P2467.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Range or Performance Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2467.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 3 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Same as P242B on bank 2 sensor 3.

P2468.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2468.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 3 — низкий сигнал

d.en: Same as P242C on bank 2 sensor 3. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2469.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit High Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2469.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 3 — высокий сигнал

d.en: Same as P242D on bank 2 sensor 3. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P246A.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent or Erratic Bank 2 Sensor 3
P246A.ru: Датчик температуры выхлопных газов, цепь, банк 2, датчик 3 — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Same as P242E on bank 2 sensor 3. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P246B.en: Vehicle Conditions Incorrect for Particulate Filter Regeneration
P246B.ru: Условия для регенерации сажевого фильтра (DPF) не выполнены

d.en: The driving pattern (short trips, low speed, frequent stops) does not provide the load and EGT needed for passive or active DPF regeneration. Filter loading rises until limit reached.

P246C.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Forced Limited Power Bank 1
P246C.ru: Сажевый фильтр — засорение, принудительное ограничение мощности, банк 1

d.en: Particulate Filter Restriction Forced Limited Power Bank 1: the control module has detected this fault condition.

P246D.en: Particulate Filter Pressure Sensor A and B Correlation
P246D.ru: Датчики давления сажевого фильтра A и B — рассогласование

d.en: The two DPF differential pressure sensors A and B disagree by more than the diagnostic tolerance - one of them has drifted.

P246E.en: Exhaust Gas Temperature Sensor Circuit Bank 1 Sensor 4

P24DA.ru: Датчик твёрдых частиц — ошибка пробы выхлопа, банк 1

P24DB.ru: Клапан продувки реагента B — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The secondary reductant purge valve B - which clears AdBlue from injector and lines at shutdown to prevent crystallisation - has an open control circuit.

P24DC.en: Reductant Purge Control Valve B Performance

d.en: Same as P24DB with the actuator electrically intact yet not delivering the commanded purge flow. The evaporative system captures fuel vapor from the tank and purges it into intake; leaks or stuck purge valves leak hydrocarbons and cause emissions failures.

P24DF.ru: Клапан продувки реагента B — заклинил открытым

P24E0.en: Reductant Purge Control Valve B Stuck Closed
P24E0.ru: Клапан продувки реагента B — заклинил закрытым

A general circuit fault on the NH3 (ammonia) sensor - measures ammonia slip downstream of the SCR catalyst to detect AdBlue overdose.

P24E2.en: NH3 Sensor Circuit Range or Performance

d.en: Same as P24E1 with the signal in plausible range yet not matching the engine model.

Same as P24E1 with the signal voltage below the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

Same as P24E1 with the signal voltage above the plausible range. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The ammonia (NH3) slip sensor downstream of the SCR catalyst delivers an intermittent or erratic signal. The ECM expects a smooth voltage proportional to ammonia concentration in the tailpipe — sudden jumps, dropouts or noise mean the wiring, connector or sensing element is failing. Used to close-loop the AdBlue/DEF dosing strategy.

The heater inside the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor warms the sensing cell to operating temperature so it can read tailpipe ammonia. The ECM detects an open in the heater control circuit — no current flows when the heater should be active, so the sensor never reaches its working point and SCR closed-loop control is suspended.

The heater control circuit of the ammonia (NH3) slip sensor reads below the expected voltage range. Either the wiring is shorted to ground or the heater driver in the SCR/dosing module is stuck low. The sensor element never warms up, NH3 readings stay invalid and the SCR strategy falls back to open-loop dosing.

The heater control circuit of the NH3 slip sensor reads above the expected voltage range. Typically a short to battery voltage or a heater driver stuck high — duty-cycle control is lost, the heater either runs continuously or not at all, and the sensor element risks overheating before the ECM disables it.

The heater of the NH3 slip sensor is electrically intact, but the warm-up profile or steady-state temperature feedback does not match the ECM model. The sensor takes too long to reach operating temperature or drifts away from setpoint, so SCR closed-loop control is delayed or held off.

The supply rail that powers the NH3 slip sensor electronics (typically 5 V or 12 V from the dosing/SCR module) is out of tolerance. Without a stable supply the sensor cannot deliver a valid ammonia reading, and the ECM disables the closed-loop SCR strategy.

P24EB.en: NH3 Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit Low
P24EB.ru: Датчик NH3 — цепь питания, низкое напряжение

d.en: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage drops below the lower limit. Usually a partial short to ground in the supply line, an undersized ground path with high resistance, or an internal supply collapse in the SCR/dosing module. Sensor output is held invalid until the supply recovers.

P24EC.en: NH3 Sensor Supply Voltage Circuit High
P24EC.ru: Датчик NH3 — цепь питания, высокое напряжение

d.en: The NH3 slip sensor supply voltage rises above the upper limit. Either the supply is shorted to battery voltage or an internal regulator in the dosing module has failed open. The sensor electronics may be damaged if the condition persists, so the ECM disables the input.

The NH3 slip sensor stores its individual calibration coefficients in non-volatile memory (EEPROM/flash). The ECM cannot read valid calibration values — either checksum fails, the memory is empty after replacement, or communication with the sensor electronics is broken. Without the trim values the raw ammonia reading is unreliable.

The microcontroller inside the smart NH3 slip sensor reports an internal performance fault — failed self-test, watchdog reset, or out-of-range plausibility checks. The sensor cannot guarantee its output value, the ECM marks the channel invalid and disables SCR closed-loop control on this branch.

P24EF.ru: Блок управления, цепь пробуждения — цепь / обрыв

d.en: The wake-up line that brings a sleeping ECU back from low-power mode is open. Many networks use a dedicated hardware wake-up wire (door-latch trigger, terminal 15, CAN wake-up) so modules can stay asleep with the ignition off. Without it, the module either fails to wake up at start-up or stays awake and drains the battery.

P24F0.ru: Блок управления, цепь пробуждения — низкий сигнал

d.en: The wake-up input on the control module reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted wake signal. The module either keeps waking up unnecessarily and drains the battery, or it cannot distinguish a real wake event from the stuck low level.

P24F1.ru: Блок управления, цепь пробуждения — высокий сигнал

d.en: The wake-up input reads above the expected range — typically a short to battery voltage. The module sees a permanent wake-up request, never enters sleep mode and drains the battery while parked.

P24F2.en: EGR Temperature/Charge Air Cooler Temperature Correlation
P24F2.ru: Температура EGR / температура охладителя наддувочного воздуха — рассогласование

d.en: After a long key-off soak both the EGR temperature sensor and the charge-air cooler outlet temperature sensor must read approximately the same ambient temperature. The ECM compares them and detects an implausible delta. One of the sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or is exposed to a heat source the model does not know about.

P24F3.ru: Температура бака реагента / температура топлива — рассогласование

d.en: After a long key-off soak the AdBlue/DEF tank temperature and the fuel tank temperature should read close to each other (both at ambient). The ECM detects an implausible spread, which usually means one of the two sensors drifts, is wired wrong, or has a heat source nearby that the plausibility model does not account for.

P24F4.en: NOx Sensor Delayed Response - High to Low Bank 1 Sensor 1
P24F4.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д1 — запаздывающий отклик, с высокого на низкий

d.en: The pre-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 1) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level — for example after a fuel cut or transition into low-load. Aged ceramic cells, soot deposits or condensation inside the sensor protective tube slow the diffusion of NOx to the measuring element.

P24F5.en: NOx Sensor Delayed Response - High to Low Bank 1 Sensor 2
P24F5.ru: Датчик NOx Б1Д2 — запаздывающий отклик, с высокого на низкий

d.en: The post-catalyst NOx sensor on bank 1 (sensor 2) reacts too slowly when NOx in the exhaust drops from a high to a low level. Same failure mechanism as the upstream sensor — aged element, soot or condensate — but post-catalyst the consequence is a degraded SCR conversion-efficiency monitor.

P24F6.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Stuck Open
P24F6.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ — заклинил открытым

d.en: On systems that inject HC dosing fuel or AIR-assisted reductant into the aftertreatment, a purge valve clears the line after each dosing event. The ECM detects the valve stuck open — pressure or flow does not build up against a closed valve, so the dosing line cannot be charged. Common on diesel HC-doser hardware (DPF regen support).

P24F7.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Stuck Closed
P24F7.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ — заклинил закрытым

d.en: The aftertreatment HC dosing or reductant purge valve is stuck closed. The ECM commands purge but the line is not cleared, leaving residual fluid that can foul nozzles or freeze in cold weather. Subsequent dosing events also fail because backpressure does not match the model.

P24F8.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit
P24F8.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления

d.en: General electrical fault in the control circuit of the aftertreatment fuel/air purge valve. The ECM cannot drive the valve coil according to plausibility checks — open, short or unexpected feedback voltage. Until cleared, dosing line purge is suspended.

P24F9.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit Range/Performance
P24F9.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The valve coil is electrically intact, but the response (current rise time, return-current decay, position feedback) does not match the ECM model. Typical for solenoids losing magnetic strength after long thermal cycling, or armatures with increased friction from coking.

P24FA.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit Low
P24FA.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a failed low-side driver. The valve is energised continuously when it should be off, or the diagnostic feedback voltage is pulled below threshold.

P24FB.en: Exhaust Aftertreatment Fuel Air Purge Valve Control Circuit High
P24FB.ru: Клапан продувки воздухом топлива системы нейтрализации ОГ, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: The control circuit of the aftertreatment purge valve reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage or an open ground/return path. The driver cannot pull the line low to actuate the valve.

P24FC.en: Particulate Matter Sensor Heater Control Circuit Driver Current/Temperature Too High
P24FC.ru: Подогрев датчика твёрдых частиц — цепь управления, слишком большой ток/температура драйвера

d.en: The PM (soot) sensor heater is driven by a current-limited stage so it can burn off accumulated soot before each measurement. The driver reports current or junction temperature above the safe limit and disables itself. Often a partial short across the heater or sensor element after coolant intrusion.

The ECM identifies the installed particulate filter A as the wrong part — backpressure signature, regeneration efficiency or coded part-number do not match the application. Common after a non-OEM aftermarket DPF or a wrong-application replacement.

The ECM identifies the installed SCR catalyst as the wrong part — NOx conversion efficiency, NH3 storage capacity or coded part-number do not match the expected application. Typical after fitting a non-OEM SCR brick or after a coding error following replacement.

The temperature of the AdBlue/DEF in the dosing system exceeds the safe limit — risk of thermal decomposition (NH3/biuret formation) and clogged dosing nozzles. Often caused by a stuck-on tank heater, a stalled coolant return or proximity to a hot exhaust component.

The L-terminal feedback line from the alternator (charging warning lamp circuit) reads below the lower limit. The lamp may stay on, and battery voltage may drift if regulation feedback is also affected.
The L-terminal feedback from the alternator reads above the upper limit — short to supply or open ground side. Charging diagnostics cannot run cleanly.
The ECU detects an out-of-range charging system voltage without specifying high or low. Indicates a generic charging fault that requires further sub-code investigation.
The ECU detects that battery voltage during operation stays below the regulated target. The alternator output is insufficient to maintain charge under load, eventually leading to battery depletion.
The ECU detects a battery voltage above the regulated upper limit. The voltage regulator is not limiting alternator output, risking damage to electronic modules and battery overcharge.

The ECM/PCM monitors the main switched battery feed (typically terminal 15 / ignition-switched supply via the main relay). A general fault is reported — either the input is missing entirely or it does not match the expected timing relative to ignition state. Engine may not start or stay running.

P2506.ru: ECM/PCM — сигнал входа питания, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The switched-battery input to the ECM/PCM is present, but the level or transient behaviour is out of plausibility — sagging during cranking, slow ramp-up after main-relay close, or noisy. Often caused by aged main relay contacts or a weak battery feed under load.

P2507.ru: ECM/PCM — сигнал входа питания, низкий сигнал

d.en: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads below threshold while the ignition is on. Either the main relay does not close, the supply wire is broken or shorted to ground, or the battery is too low. Engine usually fails to start until the input recovers.

P2508.ru: ECM/PCM — сигнал входа питания, высокий сигнал

d.en: The ECM/PCM switched-battery input reads above the upper threshold. Most often caused by a charging system overvoltage (failed alternator regulator) or wrong jump-start procedure. Sustained high voltage risks damaging ECU electronics.

P2509.ru: ECM/PCM — сигнал входа питания, прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The ECU detects sporadic interruptions of its supply voltage. The fault is set when supply drops below a threshold for short periods, often during cranking or due to a poor connection.

General electrical fault on the engine oil level sensor circuit. The ECM cannot read a plausible level signal (analog level, ultrasonic or capacitive sender). Without a valid level reading the ECM disables oil-low warnings and dynamic service-interval calculation.

P250B.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P250B.ru: Датчик уровня масла двигателя, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The oil level sensor is electrically intact, but the level reading is implausible — for example a constant value across drives, jumps that cannot match real oil consumption, or readings outside the design range. Often a contaminated or aged float/ultrasonic sender.

P250C.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Low
P250C.ru: Датчик уровня масла двигателя, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads below the lower limit, typically a short to ground or an open at the reference end of the sender. The ECM treats the input as invalid and ignores oil-low warnings until the circuit is repaired.

P250D.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit High
P250D.ru: Датчик уровня масла двигателя, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: The oil level sensor signal voltage reads above the upper limit, typically a short to reference voltage or an open signal return. Pegged at maximum, the ECM cannot distinguish full from invalid and disables the level monitor.

P250E.en: Engine Oil Level Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P250E.ru: Датчик уровня масла двигателя, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The oil level signal jumps or drops out intermittently — usually loose contacts, vibration cracks at the sender or oil sloshing on bumpy roads. The ECM filters short transients but flags the input when the noise pattern exceeds the diagnostic limits.

The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level below the safe minimum after sensor checks pass. Continued operation risks bearing damage and oil-pump cavitation, so the ECM sets a critical warning, may reduce torque and asks the driver to add oil immediately.

P2510.en: ECM/PCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Range/Performance
P2510.ru: Реле питания ECM/PCM — цепь контроля, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The voltage reported on the main power relay sense line for the engine controller does not match expectation. The ECU may shut down too early or stay awake too long, draining the battery.

P2511.en: ECM/PCM Power Relay Sense Circuit Intermittent
P2511.ru: Реле питания ECM/PCM — цепь контроля, прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The sense (feedback) line that lets the ECM verify the main power relay has actually closed shows intermittent dropouts. The ECM expects to see battery voltage on this line whenever the relay is energised — short losses suggest aged contacts, vibration or chafed wiring.

P2512.ru: Запрос регистратора данных о событиях, цепь — обрыв

d.en: The Event Data Recorder (EDR / black box) request line — used by the ECM or restraint module to trigger the EDR to capture pre-crash data — is open. The ECM cannot trigger an event capture, so any subsequent crash event would not be recorded reliably.

P2513.en: Event Data Recorder Request Circuit Low
P2513.ru: Запрос регистратора данных о событиях, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: The EDR request line reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees a constant request (which it cannot service) or cannot pulse the line high to fire a real event capture.

P2514.en: Event Data Recorder Request Circuit High
P2514.ru: Запрос регистратора данных о событиях, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: The EDR request line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line back low to release the request, so the EDR may either ignore further requests or sit in a permanent triggered state.

P2515.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit

d.en: General electrical fault in the second A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. Sensor B usually monitors the low-side or compressor-suction pressure (in addition to high-side sensor A). The ECM cannot read a plausible value and disables variable compressor control to avoid evaporator freeze-up or overpressure.

P2516.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P2516.ru: Датчик давления хладагента B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B is electrically intact, but its reading does not match the system model — for example pressures that do not fall when the compressor is off, do not change with ambient temperature, or contradict pressure sensor A. Often a refrigerant charge issue or a contaminated sensor.

P2517.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit Low
P2517.ru: Датчик давления хладагента B — низкий сигнал

d.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads below the lower limit. Either a short to ground in the signal wire, an open reference voltage at the sensor, or an internal short. The ECM ignores the reading and disables A/C closed-loop control until the circuit recovers.

P2518.en: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor B Circuit High
P2518.ru: Датчик давления хладагента B — высокий сигнал

d.en: A/C refrigerant pressure sensor B signal voltage reads above the upper limit. Typically a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or an overpressure event briefly pegging the sensor. ECM disables variable compressor control to protect the system.

General electrical fault on the A/C compressor request input A. This input tells the ECM that the HVAC controller wants the A/C compressor engaged. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot enable the compressor clutch — A/C does not cool, idle-up compensation is not applied.

The Power Take-Off (PTO) enable switch input to the ECM is open. PTO is used on trucks and work vehicles to drive auxiliary equipment from the engine — without a valid enable signal the ECM refuses to enter PTO operating mode, idle speed control changes do not apply.

P251B.ru: Выключатель включения PTO — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently closed switch. The ECM either sees PTO enabled when the operator has not requested it, or cannot release the PTO mode after work.

P251C.ru: Выключатель включения PTO — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: The PTO enable switch input reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the input low, so the switch state is unreadable and PTO mode is locked out for safety.

P251D.ru: Остановка двигателя от PTO — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line is open. This safety input lets a connected work attachment (or operator switch) request an immediate engine shutdown — for example when an interlock is opened on a stationary aerial work platform. With the line broken, the safety shutdown cannot be commanded.

P251E.ru: Остановка двигателя от PTO — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck low — usually a short to ground or a permanently asserted shutdown request. The ECM may treat this as an active shutdown command and refuse to start or keep the engine running while in PTO mode.

P251F.ru: Остановка двигателя от PTO — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: The PTO engine-shutdown command line reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pulse the line low to acknowledge a shutdown request, so the operator-side safety chain is effectively disabled.

The A/C compressor request input A reads stuck low — typically a short to ground or a permanently asserted request. The ECM either sees A/C demanded all the time (cannot release idle-up, raises fuel use) or cannot distinguish a real request from the stuck low level.

The A/C request input A reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot pull the line low to read switch state, so the A/C compressor request is treated as invalid and the clutch stays disengaged.

General electrical fault on the second A/C request input B. Many vehicles have two HVAC zones, a rear evaporator request, or a redundant request line — input B carries that signal. With the input invalid, the ECM cannot honour zone B compressor demand or rear-evap operation.
The A/C request input B reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently asserted request. Same effect as input A stuck low, applied to the second HVAC channel.
The A/C request input B reads stuck high — typically a short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the switch state, request B is treated as invalid.

P2525.ru: Датчик давления в вакуумном ресивере — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the vacuum reservoir pressure sensor circuit. The reservoir stores manifold or pump-generated vacuum for systems like brake booster, EGR actuators or HVAC dampers. Without a valid reading the ECM disables vacuum-pump duty cycle control.

P2526.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2526.ru: Датчик давления в вакуумном ресивере — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The vacuum reservoir pressure sensor is electrically intact, but the reading does not match the model — vacuum that does not build up after pump activation, does not bleed off when consumers draw, or stays at one value. Often a partly clogged hose, a leaking reservoir or an aged sensor.

P2527.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit Low
P2527.ru: Датчик давления в вакуумном ресивере — низкий сигнал

d.en: Sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — usually a short to ground or open reference. The ECM disables vacuum pump control until the input recovers.

P2528.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit High
P2528.ru: Датчик давления в вакуумном ресивере — высокий сигнал

d.en: Sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — usually a short to reference voltage or open signal return. ECM disables vacuum pump control to avoid overshooting.

P2529.en: Vacuum Reservoir Pressure Sensor Circuit Intermittent
P2529.ru: Датчик давления в вакуумном ресивере — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The sensor signal jumps or drops out intermittently — loose connector, vibration, or chafed harness. The ECM filters short transients but flags the input when noise exceeds limits.

General electrical fault on the engine oil quality sensor — typically a capacitive/dielectric sensor that estimates oil aging from permittivity, viscosity proxies and conductivity. With no valid reading the dynamic service-interval algorithm falls back to the fixed-interval default.

P252B.en: Engine Oil Quality Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P252B.ru: Датчик качества масла двигателя, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The oil quality sensor is electrically intact, but the readings do not match the model — for example permittivity that does not change after an oil change, or shifts inconsistent with km/h driven. Often a contaminated electrode or oil that does not fit the sensor calibration.

P252C.en: Engine Oil Quality Sensor Circuit Low
P252C.ru: Датчик качества масла двигателя, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — typically a short to ground in the signal line or an internal short across the sensor electrode.

P252D.en: Engine Oil Quality Sensor Circuit High
P252D.ru: Датчик качества масла двигателя, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — typically a short to reference voltage or an open signal return.

P252E.en: Engine Oil Quality Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P252E.ru: Датчик качества масла двигателя, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The oil quality sensor signal jumps or drops out — usually a loose connector at the oil pan, an oil-soaked harness or vibration cracks at the sensor housing.

The oil level monitor reports the engine oil level above the safe maximum after sensor checks pass. Overfilling raises foaming, blow-by and crankcase pressure — and on diesels with regen-by-injection, fuel dilution can drive the level up by itself. The ECM warns the driver and may flag for service.
The ECU detects an electrical fault on the ignition switch run position input. The signal indicating that the ignition is in the run position is missing or implausible.

P2531.en: Ignition Switch Run Position Circuit Low
P2531.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение RUN — низкий сигнал

d.en: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck low — short to ground or a permanently closed contact. The ECM cannot tell when the operator releases the switch from Run, so accessory and crank logic gets confused.

P2532.en: Ignition Switch Run Position Circuit High
P2532.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение RUN — высокий сигнал

d.en: The ignition switch Run-position input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open switch return. The ECM cannot detect when the operator turns the switch back to off/accessory, so module sleep and accessory power timeouts do not work correctly.

General electrical fault on the ignition switch On/Start (terminal 50 / crank) input. The ECM uses this signal to know when the starter is energised — without it the ECM cannot raise fuel and timing for cranking, the engine struggles to start or stalls right after.

P2534.en: Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit Low
P2534.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение ВКЛ/стартер — низкий сигнал

d.en: The On/Start input reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently closed contact. The ECM may see crank request when the key is at rest, blocking accessory functions or causing unexpected starter cut-off logic.

P2535.en: Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit High
P2535.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение ВКЛ/стартер — высокий сигнал

d.en: The On/Start input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot read the crank state, modules dependent on this signal are unable to time their wake-up correctly.

General electrical fault on the ignition switch accessory (terminal 75 / ACC) input. ACC tells the ECM that radio, fans, accessory loads should be powered without the engine running. With the input invalid, the body controller may misjudge accessory power timing.

P2537.en: Ignition Switch Accessory Position Circuit Low
P2537.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение ACC — низкий сигнал

d.en: The ACC input reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently closed contact. The ECM may see ACC active continuously and refuse to enter sleep, draining the battery.

P2538.en: Ignition Switch Accessory Position Circuit High
P2538.ru: Выключатель зажигания, положение ACC — высокий сигнал

d.en: The ACC input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. The ECM cannot detect when the operator releases the switch from ACC, accessory power timeouts do not work.

P2539.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit
P2539.ru: Датчик системы низкого давления топлива — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the low-pressure fuel system sensor — typically the lift-pump or pre-supply pressure sensor that monitors the rail feeding the high-pressure pump. With no valid reading, the ECM cannot verify that lift pressure is sufficient for HP-pump intake.

The PTO sense (engagement feedback) line is open. This input tells the ECM whether the PTO clutch or driveline is actually engaged after a request — it closes the loop on the PTO enable command. With it broken, the ECM cannot confirm engagement and refuses to ramp up to PTO speed setpoints.

P253B.ru: Датчик PTO — цепь, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The PTO sense circuit is electrically intact, but the engagement feedback does not match the command. The ECM requests engage and sees no engaged feedback (or vice versa) within the expected time window — drive-line slip, sticky clutch, or a mis-adjusted limit switch.
The PTO sense input reads stuck low — short to ground or limit switch stuck closed. The ECM may see PTO continuously engaged.
The PTO sense input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open switch return. The ECM cannot detect engagement.
The PTO sense signal jumps or drops out — usually loose connectors, a chattering limit switch, or vibration on the work attachment.

The oil quality monitor concludes that the engine oil has reached the end of its useful life — based on permittivity, soot content, fuel dilution and total operating hours. The ECM requests an oil change before the next regen cycle to prevent accelerated bearing wear.

P2540.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit
P2540.ru: Датчик системы низкого давления топлива — цепь

d.en: The ECU detects a general fault in the low-pressure fuel system pressure sensor circuit. Without a valid signal the ECU cannot verify lift-pump pressure or fuel rail pre-pressure.

P2541.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2541.ru: Датчик системы низкого давления топлива — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The signal of the low-pressure fuel sensor does not match the expected value during operation. Pressure does not rise as expected when the lift pump is commanded.

P2542.en: Low Pressure Fuel System Sensor Circuit High
P2542.ru: Датчик системы низкого давления топлива — высокий сигнал

d.en: The low-pressure fuel system sensor signal voltage is above the upper limit. Either a short to reference voltage in the signal line, an open signal return, or a sensor reading pegged high after an internal failure. The HP-pump pressure-control strategy falls back to default.
The ECU detects an electrical fault on the power demand input signal used to coordinate accessory loads (e.g. AC compressor, alternator load). The signal is missing or implausible.

P2544.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A
P2544.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом A

d.en: The ECU detects an invalid torque-management request signal A from another control unit (e.g. transmission, ESP, ABS) on the CAN bus. Cooperative torque control cannot be performed as expected.

P2545.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A Range/Performance
P2545.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The ECM receives torque-management requests from other modules (TCM during shifts, ABS/ESC during traction events, hybrid controller). Input A is electrically intact but its values do not match the system model — out-of-range steps, jumps, or persistent values that other modules cannot confirm.

P2546.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A Low
P2546.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом A — низкий

d.en: Torque management input A reads stuck low — analog short to ground or message stuck at minimum value. The ECM cannot trust the request and falls back to a safe default.

P2547.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal A High
P2547.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом A — высокий

d.en: Torque management input A reads stuck high — analog short to reference voltage or message stuck at maximum value. The ECM rejects the request to avoid running unintended high-torque commands.

P2548.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal B
P2548.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом B

d.en: General electrical fault on the second torque-management request input B. Used when more than one module needs to request torque adjustments — typically TCM on input A and ABS/ESC on input B, or chassis vs powertrain. With B invalid, only the A-side request is honoured.

P2549.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal B Range/Performance
P2549.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Input B is electrically intact but the values are implausible — same failure mode as the A-side performance fault, applied to the second torque-management channel.

P254A.ru: Датчик/выключатель 1 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The PTO speed-selector switch 1 input is open. This switch lets the operator pick a preset PTO operating speed (idle, 800, 1200 rpm, etc.). With the input broken, the ECM cannot apply any operator-selected speed and falls back to a default speed.

P254B.ru: Датчик/выключатель 1 выбора оборотов PTO — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The selector input is electrically intact but the value is implausible — multiple positions asserted at once, or a value that cannot map to any of the configured speed presets. Often a sticky multi-position switch or a contaminated rotary contact.

P254C.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 1 Circuit Low
P254C.ru: Датчик/выключатель 1 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: PTO speed selector 1 input reads stuck low — short to ground or analog signal pegged at minimum. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P254D.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 1 Circuit High
P254D.ru: Датчик/выключатель 1 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: PTO speed selector 1 input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or analog signal pegged at maximum.

P254E.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 1 Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P254E.ru: Датчик/выключатель 1 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The PTO speed selector signal jumps or drops out — usually a worn rotary contact or vibration on the work attachment.

General electrical fault on the engine hood (bonnet) switch circuit. The hood switch tells the body controller and (on hybrids) the high-voltage system that the hood is open — used for security, alarm and HV-safety interlock. With the input invalid, alarm logic and HV interlock fall back to a safe state.

P2550.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal B Low
P2550.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом B — низкий

d.en: Torque management input B reads stuck low — short to ground or message at minimum. ECM rejects the request, only A-side is used.

P2551.en: Torque Management Request Input Signal B High
P2551.ru: Входной сигнал запроса управления моментом B — высокий

d.en: Torque management input B reads stuck high — short to reference voltage or message at maximum. ECM rejects the request to avoid unintended high-torque commands.

General electrical fault on the throttle/fuel inhibit input A. This input lets external safety functions (immobilizer, hybrid HV interlock, anti-theft) override the throttle or cut fuel delivery. With the input invalid the safety override is unreliable, so the ECM falls back to its safe default — typically inhibit asserted to err on the side of safety.

P2553.ru: Ограничение дросселя/топлива A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The throttle/fuel inhibit A signal is electrically intact but its value does not match the system context — for example asserted while the immobilizer reports OK, or de-asserted while a hybrid HV interlock is active. The ECM cannot trust the signal.
Throttle/fuel inhibit A reads stuck low — short to ground or permanently asserted. ECM may treat it as continuous inhibit and refuse normal operation.
Throttle/fuel inhibit A reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. ECM cannot read the inhibit state and falls back to the safe default.

General electrical fault on the engine coolant level sensor/switch circuit. Many vehicles use a simple float-switch in the expansion tank, others use a continuous-level analog sensor. With the input invalid the ECM cannot warn for low coolant before overheating starts.

P2557.en: Engine Coolant Level Sensor/Switch Circuit Range/Performance
P2557.ru: Датчик/выключатель уровня ОЖ двигателя, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The coolant level sensor is electrically intact, but the readings are implausible — for example a level that does not move at all over many drive cycles, or jumps that cannot match real coolant loss. Often a stuck float, contaminated electrode or air-locked sensor.

P2558.en: Engine Coolant Level Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
P2558.ru: Датчик/выключатель уровня ОЖ двигателя, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Coolant level sensor signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground or internal short. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2559.en: Engine Coolant Level Sensor/Switch Circuit High
P2559.ru: Датчик/выключатель уровня ОЖ двигателя, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Coolant level sensor signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P255A.ru: Датчик/выключатель 2 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The second PTO speed-selector switch input is open. Switch 2 typically encodes a binary or multi-bit code together with switch 1 — together they select one of several preset PTO speeds. With switch 2 broken, only the half of the bit pattern is available, so several presets cannot be reached.

P255B.ru: Датчик/выключатель 2 выбора оборотов PTO — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: PTO speed selector switch 2 is electrically intact but its value does not match a valid bit pattern — multiple positions asserted, or values that do not map to any preset.

P255C.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 2 Circuit Low
P255C.ru: Датчик/выключатель 2 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: PTO speed selector 2 input reads stuck low — short to ground or analog signal pegged at minimum. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P255D.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 2 Circuit High
P255D.ru: Датчик/выключатель 2 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: PTO speed selector 2 input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or analog signal pegged at maximum.

P255E.en: PTO Speed Selector Sensor/Switch 2 Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P255E.ru: Датчик/выключатель 2 выбора оборотов PTO — цепь, нестабильный сигнал

d.en: PTO speed selector 2 signal jumps or drops out — usually a worn rotary contact or vibration on the work attachment.

P255F.ru: Запрос A/C A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The A/C request input A is electrically intact, but its value does not match the system context — for example asserted while the HVAC controller reports off, toggling rapidly, or sustained while compressor pressures cannot support it. The ECM disables A/C clutch engagement until the input becomes plausible.

The coolant level monitor reports the engine coolant below the safe minimum after sensor checks pass. Continued operation risks overheating, head warping and head-gasket failure. The driver is warned and the ECM may reduce engine power until the level is restored.

P2561.en: A/C Control Module Requested MIL Illumination
P2561.ru: Блок управления A/C — запрос включения лампы MIL

d.en: The A/C / HVAC control module has requested the ECM to illuminate the malfunction indicator (MIL) because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side. The original fault is stored in the HVAC module — this code only signals that the ECM has honoured the request.

P2562.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor A Circuit
P2562.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины A — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the turbocharger boost control position sensor A — the feedback sensor on the wastegate or VGT actuator (often a contactless Hall sensor). Without valid position feedback the ECM cannot close the loop on boost control and falls back to open-loop duty cycle.

P2563.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor Circuit
P2563.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины — цепь

d.en: The position feedback sensor on the variable-geometry or wastegate turbocharger actuator is not communicating or is implausible. Without position feedback, boost control runs in default mode and power is reduced.

P2564.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor A Circuit Low
P2564.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины A — низкий сигнал

d.en: Position sensor A signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground in the signal line or open reference voltage at the sensor.

P2565.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor A Circuit High
P2565.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Position sensor A signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage in the signal line or open signal return.

P2566.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor Range/Performance
P2566.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The turbocharger actuator position sensor reports a value, but it does not track commanded vane or wastegate position within tolerance. Often a sticky VTG mechanism due to soot.

P2567.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor Circuit Low
P2567.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины — низкий сигнал

d.en: The turbocharger position sensor signal is below the lower limit — short to ground or sensor at zero stop.

P2568.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor Circuit High
P2568.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины — высокий сигнал

d.en: The turbocharger position sensor signal is above the upper limit — short to supply, open ground or sensor failed high.

P2569.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Low
P2569.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — низкий сигнал

d.en: Direct Ozone Reduction (DOR) catalysts are coated radiator surfaces or dedicated catalysts that decompose tropospheric ozone passing over the radiator — used for low-emissions vehicles. The temperature sensor monitoring the DOR brick reads stuck low — short to ground or sensor short.

P256A.en: Engine Idle Speed Selector Sensor/Switch Circuit/Open
P256A.ru: Датчик/выключатель выбора холостых оборотов, цепь — обрыв

d.en: The idle-speed selector input is open. On commercial vehicles this switch lets the operator pick a fast-idle setpoint (for example to keep auxiliary loads supplied). With the input broken, the ECM cannot apply an operator-selected idle speed.

P256B.en: Engine Idle Speed Selector Sensor/Switch Range/Performance
P256B.ru: Датчик/выключатель выбора холостых оборотов — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The idle-speed selector input is electrically intact but the value does not match a valid preset — multiple positions or a non-mappable value. Often a sticky multi-position switch.

P256C.en: Engine Idle Speed Selector Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
P256C.ru: Датчик/выключатель выбора холостых оборотов, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Idle-speed selector input reads stuck low — short to ground or analog signal at minimum. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P256D.en: Engine Idle Speed Selector Sensor/Switch Circuit High
P256D.ru: Датчик/выключатель выбора холостых оборотов, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Idle-speed selector input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or analog signal at maximum. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P256E.en: Engine Idle Speed Selector Sensor/Switch Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P256E.ru: Датчик/выключатель выбора холостых оборотов, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The idle-speed selector signal jumps or drops out — usually a worn rotary contact or vibration. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P256F.ru: Запрос A/C B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: A/C request input B is electrically intact but its value does not match the system context — same failure mode as the input A performance fault, applied to the second HVAC channel.

P2570.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit High
P2570.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — высокий сигнал

d.en: The DOR catalyst temperature sensor reads stuck high — short to reference voltage or open signal return. Without a valid temperature the ECM cannot enable the DOR efficiency monitor.

P2571.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P2571.ru: Датчик температуры катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The DOR catalyst temperature sensor signal jumps or drops out — typically loose connectors or chafed wiring near the radiator pack.

P2572.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Deterioration Sensor Circuit
P2572.ru: Датчик износа катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the DOR catalyst deterioration sensor circuit. This sensor estimates the remaining ozone-conversion capacity of the DOR coating — coating worn off the radiator surface, contaminated by salt or grime, or thermally aged. Without a valid signal the deterioration monitor is disabled.

P2573.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Deterioration Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P2573.ru: Датчик износа катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The DOR deterioration sensor is electrically intact but its readings drift or do not match the model — for example a deterioration value that does not move with km/h driven, or moves implausibly fast.

P2574.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Deterioration Sensor Circuit Low
P2574.ru: Датчик износа катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — низкий сигнал

d.en: The DOR deterioration sensor signal voltage reads below the lower limit — short to ground or internal short.

P2575.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Deterioration Sensor Circuit High
P2575.ru: Датчик износа катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — высокий сигнал

d.en: The DOR deterioration sensor signal voltage reads above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P2576.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Deterioration Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P2576.ru: Датчик износа катализатора DOR (снижение озона) — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The DOR deterioration sensor signal jumps or drops out — typically loose connectors or chafed wiring near the radiator.

P2577.en: Direct Ozone Reduction Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold
P2577.ru: Катализатор DOR (снижение озона) — эффективность ниже порога

d.en: The DOR catalyst no longer reduces tropospheric ozone with the required efficiency, based on the deterioration sensor and operating-time model. Coating worn off the radiator surface, contaminated by road salt and grime, or thermally aged after many heat cycles. Replacing the affected radiator/coating restores function.

P2578.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины/нагнетателя A — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the turbocharger/supercharger shaft speed sensor A — a high-frequency Hall or eddy-current sensor on the compressor shaft. The ECM uses turbo speed for overspeed protection (typically 200,000+ rpm) and for closed-loop boost on VGT systems. With no valid speed the ECM limits boost.

P2579.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Speed Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
P2579.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины/нагнетателя A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Turbo speed sensor A is electrically intact, but the speed reading does not match the model — for example a speed that does not climb when boost rises, drifts away from the air-mass-flow estimate, or jumps. Often blade-fouling, a contaminated sensor tip or aged element.

The control circuit that drives the vacuum reservoir control valve (or vacuum pump motor) is open. The ECM cannot energise the actuator, so vacuum is no longer maintained on demand and consumers like brake booster, EGR or HVAC dampers may run out of vacuum.

P257B.ru: Вакуумный ресивер — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: The vacuum reservoir control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The actuator may be energised continuously when it should be off.

P257C.ru: Вакуумный ресивер — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: The vacuum reservoir control circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil. The driver cannot pull the line low to actuate the valve/motor.

P257D.ru: Выключатель капота, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The hood switch is electrically intact, but its state is implausible — for example reporting hood-open while vehicle speed is rising, or rapid toggles. Usually a worn switch with high contact bounce or a misaligned hood actuator.
The hood switch input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed switch. The body controller may treat the hood as permanently open and refuse to arm the alarm or close the HV interlock.
The hood switch input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open switch return. The body controller cannot detect when the hood is opened.

P2580.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Speed Sensor A Circuit Low
P2580.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины/нагнетателя A — низкий сигнал
