d.en: Turbo speed sensor A signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground in the signal line or open supply.

P2581.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Speed Sensor A Circuit High
P2581.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины/нагнетателя A — высокий сигнал

d.en: Turbo speed sensor A signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P2582.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Speed Sensor A Circuit Intermittent
P2582.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины/нагнетателя A — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Turbo speed sensor A signal jumps or drops out — vibration, oil mist on the sensor tip, or chafed wiring near the hot turbo.

P2583.en: Cruise Control Front Distance Range Sensor Single Sensor or Center
P2583.ru: Круиз-контроль — передний датчик дистанции (единственный или центральный)

d.en: General fault on the radar/lidar/camera distance-range sensor used by adaptive cruise control. On systems with a single sensor or three sensors with a center unit, this code refers to the central sensor — without it, ACC distance control is disabled and the system falls back to plain cruise.

P2584.en: Fuel Additive Control Module Requested MIL Illumination
P2584.ru: Блок управления топливной присадкой запросил включение MIL

d.en: The fuel additive control module — typical for diesel cars with a separate Eolys/Cerine additive tank that aids DPF regeneration — has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side. The original fault is in the additive module itself.

P2585.en: Fuel Additive Control Module Warning Lamp Request
P2585.ru: Блок управления топливной присадкой — запрос сигнальной лампы

d.en: The fuel additive control module asks for the additive-low warning lamp to be illuminated — the additive tank (Eolys/Cerine, used to lower DPF regen temperature) is approaching empty or has reached a service threshold. Continued driving without refilling will eventually disable DPF regeneration.

P2586.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Circuit
P2586.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the turbocharger boost control position sensor B — second position sensor on the same actuator (redundant Hall) or on a second turbo (twin-turbo, sequential or two-stage). With B invalid the ECM cannot cross-check actuator A and falls back to limited boost control.

P2587.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P2587.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Position sensor B is electrically intact, but the reading does not track sensor A or the actuator-command model. Often a misaligned redundant sensor or aged element on a second turbo.

P2588.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Circuit Low
P2588.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Position sensor B signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground or open reference. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P2589.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Circuit High
P2589.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Position sensor B signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

The control circuit driving the electric vacuum pump (used to maintain brake-booster vacuum on direct-injection or hybrid powertrains where the engine is not always running) is open. The ECM cannot run the pump on demand — booster vacuum drops, pedal feel hardens, brake assist may be reduced.

P258B.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit A Range/Performance
P258B.ru: Вакуумный насос A — цепь управления вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The vacuum pump control circuit is electrically intact, but the pump response does not match the model — pump runs longer than expected to reach setpoint, current draw rises (mechanically tight) or vacuum does not build at all. Aged motor brushes, dry vanes or a leaking line are typical causes.

P258C.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit A Low
P258C.ru: Вакуумный насос A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: The electric vacuum pump control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The pump may run continuously, drawing current and overheating, until the ECM disables the channel.

P258D.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit A High
P258D.ru: Вакуумный насос A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: The vacuum pump control circuit reads stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return. The driver cannot pull the line low to start the pump.

The PTO enable switch is electrically intact but its state does not match operating conditions — for example asserted while the vehicle is rolling above the PTO speed limit, or asserted/de-asserted in fast succession. The ECM rejects the request to avoid unsafe PTO engagement.

The ECM/PCM produces a torque-management output signal for downstream consumers (TCM during shifts, hybrid module, transfer case) and detects a fault on this output — open, short, or feedback voltage outside expected range. Without it, downstream modules cannot synchronise their behaviour with the engine.

P2590.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P2590.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Position sensor B signal jumps or drops out — vibration on the actuator, oil mist contamination or chafed wiring near the hot turbo.

P2591.en: Cruise Control Front Distance Range Sensor Left

d.en: General fault on the left-side front distance-range sensor used by adaptive cruise. Multi-sensor radar arrays use left/center/right sensors for wider field-of-view and lane discrimination — without left, ACC may degrade to single-target tracking.

P2592.en: Cruise Control Front Distance Range Sensor Right

d.en: General fault on the right-side front distance-range sensor used by adaptive cruise. Same role as the left sensor but covering the right field-of-view.

P2593.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины B — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the second turbocharger speed sensor B — used on twin-turbo, sequential or two-stage installations to read the second compressor shaft speed. Same role as sensor A on the second turbo.

P2594.en: Turbocharger Speed Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P2594.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: Turbo speed sensor B is electrically intact, but the speed reading does not match the boost or air-mass model — same failure mode as sensor A performance fault, applied to the second turbo.

P2595.en: Turbocharger Speed Sensor B Circuit Low
P2595.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Turbo speed sensor B signal voltage below the lower limit — short to ground or open supply. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P2596.en: Turbocharger Speed Sensor B Circuit High
P2596.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Turbo speed sensor B signal voltage above the upper limit — short to reference voltage or open signal return.

P2597.en: Turbocharger Speed Sensor B Circuit Intermittent
P2597.ru: Датчик частоты вращения турбины B — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: Turbo speed sensor B signal jumps or drops out — vibration, oil mist or chafed wiring at the second turbo.

P2598.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor A Performance - Stuck Low
P2598.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины A — характеристика, завис на низком уровне

d.en: Position sensor A reports a value stuck near the low end of its travel even when the actuator is commanded to move. Either the actuator is mechanically stuck closed (wastegate jammed shut, VGT vanes seized at minimum opening) or the sensor itself is pegged low. Boost is uncontrolled — overboost on diesels with VGT, underboost on wastegate-stuck systems.

P2599.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor A Performance - Stuck High
P2599.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины A — характеристика, завис на высоком уровне

d.en: Position sensor A reports a value stuck near the high end of its travel — actuator stuck open (wastegate held wide open, VGT vanes seized at maximum opening) or sensor pegged high. Boost suffers — typically underboost on VGT, overboost-protection-off on wastegate.

P259A.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Performance - Stuck Low
P259A.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — характеристика, завис на низком уровне

d.en: Same condition as the A-side stuck-low fault, but on the second sensor / second turbo. Position sensor B reads stuck near the low end while the actuator is commanded.

P259B.en: Turbocharger Boost Control Position Sensor B Performance - Stuck High
P259B.ru: Датчик положения управления наддувом турбины B — характеристика, завис на высоком уровне

d.en: Same as the A-side stuck-high fault, applied to sensor B / turbo B. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P259C.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Turbocharger A Boost Control
P259C.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления наддувом турбины A

d.en: After start-up the boost-control loop on turbo A takes longer than the calibration limit to transition from open-loop to closed-loop control. Typically a slow-warming actuator (VGT vanes carbonised), a sluggish position sensor or a leaky pneumatic actuator that cannot follow setpoints quickly enough.

P259D.en: Excessive Time To Enter Closed Loop Turbocharger B Boost Control
P259D.ru: Слишком долгий переход в замкнутый контур управления наддувом турбины B

d.en: Same condition as the turbo A excessive-warm-up fault, applied to the second turbo. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P259E.en: Turbocharger A Boost Control Position At Low Limit
P259E.ru: Положение управления наддувом турбины A — нижний предел

d.en: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the low end of its travel for too long — the closed-loop controller is saturated against the lower stop trying to reach the boost setpoint. Indicates either a leak (wastegate held closed but boost still escapes) or commanded boost above what the engine can produce.

P259F.en: Turbocharger A Boost Control Position At High Limit
P259F.ru: Положение управления наддувом турбины A — верхний предел

d.en: The boost-control actuator on turbo A has been operating at the high end of its travel — the controller is saturated against the upper stop trying to bleed off boost. Indicates either a wastegate stuck closed, oversized turbo for the calibration, or commanded boost limits being exceeded by ambient conditions (cold dense air).

P25A0.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At Low Limit
P25A0.ru: Положение управления наддувом турбины B — нижний предел

d.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At Low Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.

P25A1.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At High Limit
P25A1.ru: Положение управления наддувом турбины B — верхний предел

d.en: Turbocharger B Boost Control Position At High Limit: the control module has detected this fault condition. This affects turbo/supercharger boost-pressure control.

P25A2.en: Brake System Control Module A Requested MIL Illumination
P25A2.ru: Блок управления тормозной системой A — запрос включения MIL

d.en: The primary brake system control module (ABS/ESC/iBooster) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side — for example a regenerative braking fault on a hybrid that affects driveline torque flow. The original fault is in the brake module.

After plausibility checks the body controller has concluded that the engine hood is genuinely open while the vehicle is operating. Used to suspend HV operation on hybrids/EVs (HV interlock), block remote engine start, and trigger the alarm if armed.

General electrical fault on the fuel mode select switch — used on bi-fuel vehicles (CNG/LPG/H2/gasoline) so the driver can pick the active fuel. With the input invalid, the ECM falls back to the default fuel and disables operator-selectable switching.

The fuel mode select switch is electrically intact, but its state does not match operating conditions — switched to gas while gas tank is empty, or fast toggling. The ECM rejects the request to avoid stalling.

P25A6.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit Low
P25A6.ru: Переключатель выбора режима топлива, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P25A7.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit High
P25A7.ru: Переключатель выбора режима топлива, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: Fuel mode switch input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P25A8.en: Fuel Mode Select Switch Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P25A8.ru: Переключатель выбора режима топлива, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: Fuel mode switch signal jumps or drops out — worn contact or vibration. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P25A9.ru: Масло охлаждения поршней — цепь управления, обрыв

d.en: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit is open. Modern engines with under-piston oil jets switch them on under high load to cool the piston crown — controlled by a solenoid valve in the oil gallery. With the circuit broken, jets cannot be commanded on or stay locked off, raising piston temperatures under load.

P25AA.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Low
P25AA.ru: Масло охлаждения поршней — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: The piston-cooling oil-jet control circuit reads stuck low — short to ground or low-side driver stuck on. The jets may be enabled continuously, raising oil pump load and lowering oil pressure to other consumers.

P25AB.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit High
P25AB.ru: Масло охлаждения поршней — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Control circuit stuck high — short to battery voltage or open coil/return. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P25AC.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
P25AC.ru: Масло охлаждения поршней — цепь управления, характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: The control circuit is electrically intact, but the solenoid valve does not open when commanded — confirmed by oil-pressure or oil-temperature feedback that does not change after the activation pulse. Piston cooling does not engage under high load — risk of piston-crown overheating and ring-land cracks.

P25AD.en: Piston Cooling Oil Control Circuit Stuck On
P25AD.ru: Масло охлаждения поршней — цепь управления, заклинил включённым

d.en: The piston cooling solenoid does not close when commanded off — jets remain active when not needed. Oil pressure to top-end consumers may sag, and warm-up takes longer because the cooling jets remove heat from the pistons during cold start.

P25AE.en: Piston Cooling Oil Pressure Too Low
P25AE.ru: Давление масла охлаждения поршней слишком низкое

d.en: With the piston-cooling jets commanded on, the dedicated oil-pressure sensor in that gallery reads below the safe threshold. Insufficient flow to the jets means real piston cooling is not happening — the ECM warns the driver and may reduce torque to protect the pistons.

P25AF.en: Coolant Temperature Control Module Requested MIL Illumination
P25AF.ru: Блок управления температурой ОЖ — запрос включения MIL

d.en: A dedicated coolant-temperature control module (used on engines with electric coolant pumps and electronic thermostats to keep the cylinder head and block at independent setpoints) has requested the ECM to illuminate the MIL because of an emissions-relevant fault on its side. Original fault is in that module.

Fuel level sensor A (typically the float in the main fuel tank section) reports a value that does not change over a long driving distance — the float is mechanically stuck against the tank wall, baffle or pump module. Without level changes the EVAP monitor cannot run and remaining-range estimates are wrong.

Same condition as sensor A stuck, applied to the second fuel level sensor B. Saddle tanks (often AWD vehicles) and large trucks use two sensors — one per tank chamber — averaged for total level. A stuck B leaves only A and reduces accuracy.

P25B2.en: Fuel Level Sensor A or B Stuck
P25B2.ru: Датчик уровня топлива A или B — заклинил

d.en: The ECM detects that one of the two level sensors is stuck but cannot identify which from the available signals — for example because the saddle-tank algorithm sees implausible delta only intermittently. Both sensors should be inspected.

P25B3.ru: Перепускной клапан (wastegate) турбины/нагнетателя A — заклинил открытым

d.en: Wastegate A is mechanically stuck open. Exhaust gas bypasses the turbine even at low load — turbo cannot reach target speed, boost is permanently low and the engine feels asthmatic. Common causes are seized linkage, broken return spring or carbon-locked wastegate flap.

P25B4.ru: Перепускной клапан (wastegate) турбины/нагнетателя A — заклинил закрытым

d.en: Wastegate A is mechanically stuck closed. The turbo cannot bleed off exhaust at high load — boost overshoots the setpoint, risking overboost cut-off and damage to the turbo bearing. Carbon-locked flap, seized linkage or aged actuator are typical causes.

P25B5.ru: Перепускной клапан (wastegate) турбины/нагнетателя B — заклинил открытым

d.en: Same as wastegate A stuck open, applied to the second wastegate (twin-turbo, sequential or two-stage). Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P25B6.ru: Перепускной клапан (wastegate) турбины/нагнетателя B — заклинил закрытым

d.en: Same as wastegate A stuck closed, applied to the second wastegate. Boost control tracks commanded vs. actual manifold pressure; persistent deviation means wastegate, vanes, hose or actuator are not delivering the requested pressure.

P25B7.en: Auxiliary Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit
P25B7.ru: Дополнительный выключатель зажигания, положение ON/START — цепь

d.en: General electrical fault on the auxiliary ignition switch On/Start input. Used on commercial vehicles or upfit applications where a second ignition switch (in a sleeper cab, work platform or crew compartment) can crank the engine.

P25B8.en: Auxiliary Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit Low
P25B8.ru: Дополнительный выключатель зажигания, положение ON/START — низкий сигнал

d.en: Auxiliary ignition switch On/Start input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P25B9.en: Auxiliary Ignition Switch On/Start Position Circuit High
P25B9.ru: Дополнительный выключатель зажигания, положение ON/START — высокий сигнал

d.en: Auxiliary ignition switch On/Start input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The DPF/SCR forced-regeneration request switch — used on commercial vehicles to let the operator force a parked regeneration when the automatic regen has been postponed too often — is open. The ECM cannot honour an operator request for forced regen.

P25BB.ru: Выключатель управления регенерацией — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: Regeneration control switch input reads stuck low — short to ground or stuck-closed contact. The ECM may see a constant regen request which it cannot service while the vehicle is moving.

P25BC.ru: Выключатель управления регенерацией — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: Regeneration control switch input reads stuck high — short to battery voltage. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

The engine controller commanded a forced shutdown after detecting unmetered fuel reaching the combustion chambers. Common on diesels with leaking turbo seals or cracked intercoolers that drip oil into the intake — the engine then runs on the oil and can overspeed.

P25BE.en: Alternative Fuel Disable Control Circuit / Open
P25BE.ru: Цепь управления отключением альтернативного топлива — обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the alternative-fuel disable line that switches a bi-fuel vehicle (CNG, LPG, hydrogen) back to gasoline. An open detected on the control side blocks the safety shutoff for the gas system.

P25BF.en: Alternative Fuel Disable Control Circuit High
P25BF.ru: Цепь управления отключением альтернативного топлива — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the alternative-fuel disable control line is above the expected window. Often a short to battery upstream of the relay or a stuck-on driver in the control module.

P25C0.en: Alternative Fuel Disable Control Circuit Low
P25C0.ru: Цепь управления отключением альтернативного топлива — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the alternative-fuel disable control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a failed driver pulling the line low.
The feedback signal that confirms the alt-fuel disable command was carried out is missing or out of range. The fuel system cannot verify that the gas circuit is shut.

P25C2.en: Alternative Fuel Disable Signal Circuit High
P25C2.ru: Сигнал отключения альтернативного топлива — высокий сигнал

d.en: The disable feedback signal sits above its valid window. Typical cause is a short to battery on the feedback wire or a failed pull-up in the input stage.

P25C3.en: Alternative Fuel Disable Signal Circuit Low
P25C3.ru: Сигнал отключения альтернативного топлива — низкий сигнал

d.en: The disable feedback signal sits below its valid window. Usually a short to ground or an open pull-up that lets the input float low.

P25C4.en: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor A Circuit
P25C4.ru: Датчик температуры A усилителя тормозов — цепь

d.en: The temperature sensor monitoring the electric brake booster (iBooster, eBooster) returns no usable signal. Without temperature feedback the controller derates booster assist to protect the motor.

P25C5.en: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
P25C5.ru: Датчик температуры A усилителя тормозов — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The booster temperature sensor reading is implausible relative to commanded assist or coolant temperature. The signal moves too slowly, sticks, or never reaches expected values during operation.

P25C6.en: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor A Circuit Low
P25C6.ru: Датчик температуры A усилителя тормозов — низкий сигнал

d.en: The booster temperature signal is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Typical causes are a shorted sensor element or a short to ground in the harness.

P25C7.en: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor A Circuit High
P25C7.ru: Датчик температуры A усилителя тормозов — высокий сигнал

d.en: The booster temperature signal is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Common causes are an open sensor or a short to a 5 V reference in the harness.

P25C8.en: Brake Booster Temperature Sensor A Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P25C8.ru: Датчик температуры A усилителя тормозов — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The booster temperature signal jumps or drops out for short moments. Usually a loose connector or a chafed wire that opens during vibration or thermal expansion.

P25C9.en: Brake System Control Module B Requested MIL Illumination
P25C9.ru: Блок управления тормозной системой B — запрос включения MIL

d.en: A second brake system control module (typically the redundant secondary unit on by-wire or AV-grade brake systems) has signalled an emissions-relevant fault and requested the engine controller to switch on the MIL.

P25CA.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit / Open Bank 1
P25CA.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 1 — цепь/обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the park-lock pin that secures the intake camshaft phaser on bank 1 in its base position at engine off. Without the lock, the next start can suffer poor combustion or rough idle until the phaser builds oil pressure.

P25CB.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P25CB.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 1 — низкий сигнал

d.en: The intake camshaft park-lock control line on bank 1 is below the expected voltage window. Usually a short to ground or a low-side driver shorted internally.

P25CC.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit High Bank 1
P25CC.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 1 — высокий сигнал

d.en: The intake camshaft park-lock control line on bank 1 is above the expected voltage window. Typical causes are a short to battery or a stuck-on driver in the controller.

P25CD.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit / Open Bank 2
P25CD.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 2 — цепь/обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the park-lock pin that secures the intake camshaft phaser on bank 2 in its base position at engine off. Without the lock, the next start can suffer poor combustion or rough idle until the phaser builds oil pressure.

P25CE.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit Low Bank 2
P25CE.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 2 — низкий сигнал

d.en: The intake camshaft park-lock control line on bank 2 is below the expected voltage window. Usually a short to ground or a low-side driver shorted internally.

P25CF.en: Intake Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit High Bank 2
P25CF.ru: Управление стопором привода впускного распредвала, банк 2 — высокий сигнал

d.en: The intake camshaft park-lock control line on bank 2 is above the expected voltage window. Typical causes are a short to battery or a stuck-on driver in the controller.

P25D0.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit / Open Bank 1
P25D0.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — обрыв, банк 1

d.en: The controller cannot drive the park-lock pin that secures the exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 1 in its base position at engine off. Without the lock, the next start can suffer poor combustion or rough idle until the phaser builds oil pressure.

P25D1.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P25D1.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The exhaust camshaft park-lock control line on bank 1 is below the expected voltage window. Usually a short to ground or a low-side driver shorted internally.

P25D2.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit High Bank 1
P25D2.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The exhaust camshaft park-lock control line on bank 1 is above the expected voltage window. Typical causes are a short to battery or a stuck-on driver in the controller.

P25D3.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit / Open Bank 2
P25D3.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — обрыв, банк 2

d.en: The controller cannot drive the park-lock pin that secures the exhaust camshaft phaser on bank 2 in its base position at engine off. Without the lock, the next start can suffer poor combustion or rough idle until the phaser builds oil pressure.

P25D4.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit Low Bank 2
P25D4.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: The exhaust camshaft park-lock control line on bank 2 is below the expected voltage window. Usually a short to ground or a low-side driver shorted internally.

P25D5.en: Exhaust Camshaft Actuator Park Lock Control Circuit High Bank 2
P25D5.ru: Фиксатор привода распредвала выпуска, цепь управления — высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: The exhaust camshaft park-lock control line on bank 2 is above the expected voltage window. Typical causes are a short to battery or a stuck-on driver in the controller.

P25D6.en: Exhaust Heat Exchanger Exhaust Bypass Valve A Position Sensor Stop Performance
P25D6.ru: Датчик положения выпускного перепускного клапана A теплообменника выхлопа — характеристика по упору

d.en: During self-calibration of the exhaust heat exchanger bypass valve A, the position sensor never reached the expected mechanical stop. The controller cannot zero the position reference, so commanded openings will be inaccurate.
A third fuel level sensor (C) used on multi-tank trucks, dual-saddle SUVs, or auxiliary fuel systems returns no usable signal. Without it, calculated fuel level and EVAP monitor enabling will be off.
The third fuel level sensor reading does not change as expected with consumption or refuelling. Float may be sticking, or the resistor track has localised wear.

P25D9.en: Fuel Level Sensor C Circuit Low
P25D9.ru: Датчик уровня топлива C, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: The third fuel level sensor signal is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Usually a shorted sender or a short to ground in the harness.

P25DA.en: Fuel Level Sensor C Circuit High
P25DA.ru: Датчик уровня топлива C, цепь — высокий сигнал

d.en: The third fuel level sensor signal is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Common causes are an open sender or a short to the 5 V reference.

P25DB.en: Fuel Level Sensor C Circuit Intermittent
P25DB.ru: Датчик уровня топлива C, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The third fuel level sensor signal jumps or drops out for short moments. Usually a loose connector or a chafed wire that opens during driving vibration.
The third fuel level sensor reads a constant value across known consumption or refuelling events. Float arm or resistor wiper is mechanically stuck.

P25DD.en: A Camshaft Position - Stuck In Locked Position Bank 1
P25DD.ru: Распредвал A — заклинил в заблокированном положении, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 1 will not unlock from its base position. The phaser stays at the park-lock angle and cannot be advanced or retarded as commanded.

P25DE.en: A Camshaft Position - Unable to Achieve Locked Position Bank 1
P25DE.ru: Распредвал A — не удаётся достичь заблокированного положения, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 1 cannot reach its base position at engine shutdown so the lock pin never engages. Next cold start may run rough until oil pressure builds.

P25DF.en: A Camshaft Position Control Performance Bank 1
P25DF.ru: Управление положением распредвала A — характеристика, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 1 follows the commanded angle too slowly, oscillates, or shows steady-state error outside tolerance. Closed-loop control of cam timing is degraded.

P25E0.en: A Camshaft Position - Stuck In Locked Position Bank 2
P25E0.ru: Распредвал A — заклинил в заблокированном положении, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 2 will not unlock from its base position. The phaser stays at the park-lock angle and cannot be advanced or retarded as commanded.

P25E1.en: A Camshaft Position - Unable to Achieve Locked Position Bank 2
P25E1.ru: Распредвал A — не удаётся достичь заблокированного положения, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 2 cannot reach its base position at engine shutdown so the lock pin never engages. Next cold start may run rough until oil pressure builds.

P25E2.en: A Camshaft Position Control Performance Bank 2
P25E2.ru: Управление положением распредвала A — характеристика, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser A on bank 2 follows the commanded angle too slowly, oscillates, or shows steady-state error outside tolerance. Closed-loop control of cam timing is degraded.

P25E3.en: B Camshaft Position - Stuck In Locked Position Bank 1
P25E3.ru: Распредвал B — заклинил в заблокированном положении, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 1 will not unlock from its base position. The phaser stays at the park-lock angle and cannot be advanced or retarded as commanded.

P25E4.en: B Camshaft Position - Unable to Achieve Locked Position Bank 1
P25E4.ru: Распредвал B — не удаётся достичь заблокированного положения, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 1 cannot reach its base position at engine shutdown so the lock pin never engages. Next cold start may run rough until oil pressure builds.

P25E5.en: B Camshaft Position Control Performance Bank 1
P25E5.ru: Управление положением распредвала B — характеристика, банк 1

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 1 follows the commanded angle too slowly, oscillates, or shows steady-state error outside tolerance. Closed-loop control of cam timing is degraded.

P25E6.en: B Camshaft Position - Stuck In Locked Position Bank 2
P25E6.ru: Распредвал B — заклинил в заблокированном положении, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 2 will not unlock from its base position. The phaser stays at the park-lock angle and cannot be advanced or retarded as commanded.

P25E7.en: B Camshaft Position - Unable to Achieve Locked Position Bank 2
P25E7.ru: Распредвал B — не удаётся достичь заблокированного положения, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 2 cannot reach its base position at engine shutdown so the lock pin never engages. Next cold start may run rough until oil pressure builds.

P25E8.en: B Camshaft Position Control Performance Bank 2
P25E8.ru: Управление положением распредвала B — характеристика, банк 2

d.en: Camshaft phaser B on bank 2 follows the commanded angle too slowly, oscillates, or shows steady-state error outside tolerance. Closed-loop control of cam timing is degraded.

The clutch that engages the mechanical supercharger to the engine drive will not close. The supercharger stays disengaged so boost from this stage is unavailable, which limits torque and may also affect cooling pump drives shared with the same belt.

The clutch that engages the mechanical supercharger to the engine drive will not open. The supercharger remains coupled at all loads, increasing parasitic loss and fuel consumption when boost is not needed.

P25EB.ru: Муфта отключения нагнетателя — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The supercharger clutch control current does not match the commanded value within tolerance. Either coil resistance has drifted or the driver feedback is implausible.
Voltage on the supercharger clutch control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted clutch coil.
Voltage on the supercharger clutch control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open coil that lets the driver float high.

P25EE.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit B / Open

d.en: The controller cannot drive the secondary electric vacuum pump (B). Brake servo or HVAC actuators that depend on engine vacuum may not get enough vacuum during low-load operation or with engine off in stop-start mode.

P25EF.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit B Range/Performance
P25EF.ru: Вакуумный насос B — цепь управления вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The secondary vacuum pump does not produce the expected vacuum within the commanded run time. Leak in the pump line or worn pump diaphragm reduces output.

P25F0.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit B Low
P25F0.ru: Вакуумный насос B — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary vacuum pump control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted motor winding.

P25F1.en: Vacuum Pump Control Circuit B High
P25F1.ru: Вакуумный насос B — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary vacuum pump control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open motor that lets the driver float high.
A third boost pressure sensor (C) used on twin-stage or sequential boost systems returns no usable signal. Without it, boost control of the third stage runs open-loop or is disabled.

P25F3.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor C Circuit Range/Performance
P25F3.ru: Датчик наддува турбины/нагнетателя C — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The third boost pressure sensor reading is implausible compared with manifold pressure or commanded boost. Either drift, leak in the sensing line, or contamination on the sensor diaphragm.

P25F4.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor C Circuit Low
P25F4.ru: Датчик наддува турбины/нагнетателя C — низкий сигнал

d.en: The third boost pressure sensor signal is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Usually a shorted sensor element or a short to ground.

P25F5.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Boost Sensor C Circuit High
P25F5.ru: Датчик наддува турбины/нагнетателя C — высокий сигнал

d.en: The third boost pressure sensor signal is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Common causes are an open sensor or a short to the 5 V reference.
A general fault in the second secondary air injection (AIR) circuit. Detected by the O2 sensors which expect a lean swing during cold-start AIR pump operation but do not see one.

P25F7.en: AIR System B Incorrect Flow Detected
P25F7.ru: Система AIR B — обнаружен неверный расход

d.en: The second AIR system delivers measurably more or less air than expected. Often a partially blocked pipe, a worn pump, or a leak between pump and check valve.

P25F8.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve C Control Circuit
P25F8.ru: Перепускной клапан турбины/нагнетателя C — цепь управления

d.en: A third bypass (recirculation or wastegate) valve used in three-stage charging systems is not responding to control commands. Boost balancing across stages can no longer be achieved.

P25F9.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve C Control Circuit Low
P25F9.ru: Перепускной клапан турбины/нагнетателя C — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the third bypass valve control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P25FA.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve C Control Circuit High
P25FA.ru: Перепускной клапан турбины/нагнетателя C — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the third bypass valve control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P25FB.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve C Control Circuit Range/Performance
P25FB.ru: Перепускной клапан турбины/нагнетателя C — цепь управления вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The third bypass valve current does not match the commanded value within tolerance. Drifted coil resistance or high-resistance contact in the connector.
The third bypass valve is mechanically jammed. Solenoid is energised correctly but the valve flap or disc does not move as expected.

P25FD.en: Turbocharger/Supercharger Bypass Valve C Temperature Too High
P25FD.ru: Перепускной клапан турбины/нагнетателя C — слишком высокая температура

d.en: The third bypass valve has reached over-temperature. Either coil duty cycle is too high for too long, or cooling air flow around the valve is restricted.
A general performance fault in the supercharger disconnect clutch. Engagement or release is slow, sticky, or out of tolerance without a clear electrical-side cause.

P25FF.en: Electrical System Voltage Stabilizer Control Module Performance

d.en: The voltage stabiliser module (DC/DC converter for stop-start engine cranking events) does not maintain the regulated 12 V output during high transient loads. Sensitive electronics may reset during cranking.

P2600.en: Coolant Pump A Control Circuit / Open
P2600.ru: Помпа ОЖ A, цепь управления — цепь / обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the electric coolant pump A control line. Without circulation, engine and aftertreatment can overheat or warm up incorrectly.

P2601.en: Coolant Pump A Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
P2601.ru: Помпа ОЖ A, цепь управления — характеристика / заклинила выключенной

d.en: The electric coolant pump A is commanded on but does not run. Coolant temperature climbs faster than expected with no flow detected.
The ECU detects an open circuit on the electric coolant pump control line. Without pump control the engine cannot actively manage warm-up and cool-down phases.

P2603.ru: Помпа ОЖ, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: The electric coolant pump drive line reads below the lower threshold — typically a short to ground or a failed driver stage.

P2604.ru: Помпа ОЖ, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: The electric coolant pump drive line reads above the upper threshold — usually a short to positive or a stuck-on driver stage.

P2605.en: Intake Air Heater B Circuit / Open

d.en: The controller cannot drive the secondary intake air heater (heater grid B) used on diesel engines for cold-start support. The grid stays cold so cold-start emissions and white smoke increase.

P2606.en: Intake Air Heater B Circuit Range/Performance
P2606.ru: Нагреватель впускного воздуха B — вне диапазона

d.en: The secondary intake air heater current does not match expected resistance. Either the grid is partially open or the relay contacts have high resistance.

P2607.en: Intake Air Heater B Circuit Low
P2607.ru: Нагреватель впускного воздуха B — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary intake air heater control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted relay coil.

P2608.en: Intake Air Heater B Circuit High
P2608.ru: Нагреватель впускного воздуха B — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary intake air heater control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open relay coil.

The intake air heater system did not raise intake temperature by the expected amount during cold-start support. Suggests low current draw, poor connection to the grid, or a failed temperature feedback path.
The controller cannot drive the power take-off (PTO) engagement line on commercial vehicles. The PTO will not engage even when commanded by the body controller or operator switch.
Voltage on the PTO engagement control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.
Voltage on the PTO engagement control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.
The dashboard PTO engaged lamp control circuit is faulty. Driver may not see whether the PTO is currently driving an external accessory.

P260E.en: Particulate Filter Regeneration Lamp Control Circuit
P260E.ru: Лампа регенерации сажевого фильтра — цепь управления

d.en: The DPF regeneration warning lamp circuit is faulty. The driver may not be alerted to a required highway run that supports passive regeneration.
The dedicated EVAP monitoring processor (often a small auxiliary CPU inside the engine controller or a separate module) does not pass its self-test or runs out of step with the main monitor logic.

P2610.en: ECM/PCM Internal Engine Off Timer Performance
P2610.ru: ECM/PCM — характеристика внутреннего таймера выключенного двигателя

d.en: The engine controller's internal soak-time/engine-off timer fails its plausibility check — for example readings claim instant cool-down or never-cooled. Cold-start enrichment, EVAP and catalyst monitors depend on this timer; a fault freezes those readiness monitors.

P2611.en: A/C Refrigerant Distribution Valve A Control Circuit / Open
P2611.ru: Распределительный клапан хладагента A — цепь управления, обрыв

d.en: The A/C refrigerant distribution valve A (used to switch refrigerant flow between front and rear evaporators or between cabin and battery cooling on EVs) cannot be driven by the controller.

P2612.en: A/C Refrigerant Distribution Valve A Control Circuit Low
P2612.ru: Распределительный клапан хладагента A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the A/C distribution valve A control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2613.en: A/C Refrigerant Distribution Valve A Control Circuit High
P2613.ru: Распределительный клапан хладагента A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the A/C distribution valve A control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.
The camshaft position output signal sent from the ECU to other modules is interrupted. Other systems that rely on the cam reference (e.g. transmission, hybrid module) do not receive a valid signal.

P2615.en: Camshaft A Position Signal Output Circuit Low Bank 1
P2615.ru: Выходной сигнал положения распредвала A — низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The buffered camshaft A position output that the engine controller sends to other modules (transmission, body, ignition module) is below the expected level on bank 1. Other modules cannot use the cam phase reference for synchronisation.

P2616.en: Camshaft A Position Signal Output Circuit High Bank 1
P2616.ru: Выходной сигнал положения распредвала A — высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The buffered camshaft A position output is above the expected level on bank 1. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open output stage.

P2617.en: Crankshaft Position Signal Output Circuit / Open
P2617.ru: Выходной сигнал положения коленвала — цепь / обрыв

d.en: The buffered crankshaft position output that the engine controller sends to ignition modules and the transmission cannot drive its line. Open detected on the output side.

P2618.en: Crankshaft Position Signal Output Circuit Low
P2618.ru: Выходной сигнал положения коленвала — низкий сигнал

d.en: The buffered crankshaft position output is below the expected level. Usually a short to ground on the output line or a failed buffer.

P2619.en: Crankshaft Position Signal Output Circuit High
P2619.ru: Выходной сигнал положения коленвала — высокий сигнал

d.en: The buffered crankshaft position output is above the expected level. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open output stage.

P261A.en: Coolant Pump B Control Circuit / Open
P261A.ru: Помпа ОЖ B, цепь управления — цепь / обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the second electric coolant pump (B). Often used for aftertreatment, turbo cool-down, or hybrid battery loops — fault stops circulation in that loop.

P261B.en: Coolant Pump B Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
P261B.ru: Помпа ОЖ B, цепь управления — характеристика / заклинила выключенной

d.en: The second electric coolant pump is commanded on but does not run. Cooling demand of the connected loop is not satisfied.

P261C.en: Coolant Pump B Control Circuit Low
P261C.ru: Помпа ОЖ B, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the second coolant pump control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted motor winding.

P261D.en: Coolant Pump B Control Circuit High
P261D.ru: Помпа ОЖ B, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the second coolant pump control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open motor winding.

P261E.en: Coolant Pump B Control Circuit Stuck On
P261E.ru: Помпа ОЖ B, цепь управления — заклинила включённой

d.en: The second coolant pump runs even when no command is active. Driver is stuck on or the wire is shorted to a permanent supply.

P261F.en: Coolant Pump A Control Circuit Stuck On
P261F.ru: Помпа ОЖ A, цепь управления — заклинила включённой

d.en: The first coolant pump runs even when no command is active. Driver is stuck on or the wire is shorted to a permanent supply.
A general electrical fault on the ECU output that broadcasts the throttle position signal to other modules — for example to the transmission control or hybrid drive controller.

P2621.ru: Выходная цепь положения дросселя — низкий сигнал

d.en: The buffered throttle position output that the engine controller sends to the transmission and body modules is below the expected level. Usually a short to ground or a failed output stage.

P2622.ru: Выходная цепь положения дросселя — высокий сигнал

d.en: The buffered throttle position output is above the expected level. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open output stage.

P2623.en: Injector Control Pressure Regulator Circuit / Open

d.en: The Injector Control Pressure (ICP) regulator on hydraulically actuated injectors (HEUI diesel) or the high-pressure regulator on common-rail systems cannot be driven. Injection pressure cannot be controlled, engine may not start.

P2624.en: Injector Control Pressure Regulator Circuit Low
P2624.ru: Регулятор давления управления форсунками — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the ICP regulator control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted regulator coil.

P2625.en: Injector Control Pressure Regulator Circuit High
P2625.ru: Регулятор давления управления форсунками — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the ICP regulator control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open regulator coil.

P2626.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit/Open Bank 1 Sensor 1
P2626.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, обрыв

d.en: The ECU detects an open in the pumping current trim circuit of the wide-band oxygen sensor on bank 1 sensor 1. Without trim correction, the lambda value reported by the sensor is not accurate.

P2627.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit Low Bank 1 Sensor 1
P2627.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, низкий сигнал

d.en: On a wide-band (broadband) O2 sensor, the trim resistor circuit that calibrates the pumping current is reading low on bank 1 sensor 1. Air-fuel feedback gain is wrong, causing rich or lean offsets.

P2628.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit High Bank 1 Sensor 1
P2628.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, высокий сигнал

d.en: The wide-band trim resistor circuit on bank 1 sensor 1 reads high. Air-fuel feedback gain is wrong, causing offsets that the controller cannot compensate.

P2629.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit / Open Bank 2 Sensor 1
P2629.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, обрыв

d.en: The wide-band trim resistor circuit on bank 2 sensor 1 is open. Air-fuel feedback for bank 2 cannot be calibrated, fuel control runs degraded.

P262A.en: Fuel Injector - Pilot Injection Not Learned

d.en: The pilot (pre) injection learning routine on a common-rail diesel did not complete successfully. Without learned pilot quantity, combustion noise increases and NOx may rise.

P262B.en: Control Module Power Off Timer Performance
P262B.ru: Таймер отключения питания блока управления — характеристика

d.en: The internal power-down timer of the engine controller does not run as expected. The module either stays awake too long after key-off (battery drain) or shuts down too early (no aftertreatment cool-down or learn-write).

P262C.en: Sensor Reference Voltage G Circuit / Open
P262C.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков G — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The 5 V reference G output that the engine controller supplies to a group of sensors is open. All sensors fed from this rail will report invalid readings.

P262D.en: Sensor Reference Voltage G Circuit Low
P262D.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков G — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: The 5 V reference G voltage is below the expected level. Usually a short to ground or excessive load from a downstream sensor pulling the rail down.

P262E.en: Sensor Reference Voltage G Circuit High
P262E.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков G — цепь, высокий сигнал

d.en: The 5 V reference G voltage is above the expected level. Typical causes are a short to battery or an internal regulator failure.

P262F.en: Sensor Reference Voltage G Circuit Range/Performance
P262F.ru: Опорное напряжение датчиков G — цепь, вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The 5 V reference G voltage is within range but unstable or offset against expected. Loose ground or marginal regulator load.

P2630.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit Low Bank 2 Sensor 1
P2630.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, низкий сигнал

d.en: The wide-band trim resistor circuit on bank 2 sensor 1 reads low. Air-fuel feedback gain on bank 2 is wrong, causing rich or lean offsets.

P2631.en: O2 Sensor Pumping Current Trim Circuit High Bank 2 Sensor 1
P2631.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — цепь подстройки тока накачки, высокий сигнал

d.en: The wide-band trim resistor circuit on bank 2 sensor 1 reads high. Air-fuel feedback gain on bank 2 is wrong, the controller cannot compensate the offset.

P2632.en: Fuel Pump B Control Circuit / Open
P2632.ru: Топливный насос B, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the secondary fuel pump (B). Common on dual-tank trucks, GDI lift-pump systems, or alt-fuel installations — fault stops fuel delivery from this stage.

P2633.en: Fuel Pump B Control Circuit Low
P2633.ru: Топливный насос B, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the second fuel pump control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted motor winding.

P2634.en: Fuel Pump B Control Circuit High
P2634.ru: Топливный насос B, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the second fuel pump control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open motor winding.

P2635.en: Fuel Pump A Low Flow / Performance
P2635.ru: Топливный насос A — малая подача / характеристика

d.en: The ECU detects insufficient fuel flow from fuel pump A. Either the pump is worn out, the supply line is restricted, or the pressure regulator does not allow proper flow.

P2636.ru: Топливный насос B — малая подача / характеристика

d.en: The second fuel pump runs but does not deliver expected volume or pressure. Worn pump, restricted filter, or leaking pressure regulator.

P2637.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом A

d.en: The torque feedback signal A from the transmission or other torque user is missing or invalid. The engine controller cannot reduce torque on shift requests, which can cause harsh shifts.

P2638.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal A Range/Performance
P2638.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом A — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The torque feedback signal A is present but its value is implausible against measured engine load and speed. Sender calibration or sensor offset is suspected.

P2639.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal A Low
P2639.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом A — низкий

d.en: The torque feedback signal A reads below its valid range. Either the source reports a value below physical possibility or the bus signal is stuck low.

P263A.ru: Лампа MIL — цепь управления, низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the malfunction indicator lamp control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted bulb driver.

P263B.ru: Лампа MIL — цепь управления, высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the malfunction indicator lamp control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open lamp.
The glow plug control driver does not respond to commands within tolerance. Cold-start glow function is degraded so cold starting can be delayed and white smoke increases.
The reductant (AdBlue) tank or line heater driver does not switch as expected. AdBlue may freeze in cold weather, blocking SCR dosing.

P263E.en: Glow Plug Control Module 1 Over Temperature

d.en: The first glow plug control module reports over-temperature. Sustained current draw or insufficient cooling has driven the module above its rated temperature.

P263F.en: Glow Plug Control Module 2 Over Temperature

d.en: The second glow plug control module reports over-temperature. Sustained current draw or insufficient cooling has driven the module above its rated temperature.

P2640.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal A High
P2640.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом A — высокий

d.en: The torque feedback signal A reads above its valid range. Source module sends an implausibly high value or the bus signal is stuck high.

P2641.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом B

d.en: The torque feedback signal B from a second torque user is missing or invalid. The engine controller cannot coordinate torque reduction with this user.

P2642.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal B Range/Performance
P2642.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The torque feedback signal B is present but its value is implausible against measured engine load and speed. Sender calibration or sensor offset is suspected.

P2643.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal B Low
P2643.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом B — низкий

d.en: The torque feedback signal B reads below its valid range. Source sends a value below physical possibility or the bus signal is stuck low.

P2644.en: Torque Management Feedback Signal B High
P2644.ru: Сигнал обратной связи управления моментом B — высокий

d.en: The torque feedback signal B reads above its valid range. Source sends an implausibly high value or the bus signal is stuck high.

P2645.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit / Open Bank 1
P2645.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 1

d.en: The controller cannot drive the rocker arm switching actuator A on bank 1 (used in cylinder deactivation systems such as VTEC, AFM, MDS). The valve lift mode cannot be switched.

P2646.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator System Performance/Stuck Off Bank 1
P2646.ru: Система привода коромысла A — характеристика / заклинила выключенной, банк 1

d.en: The rocker arm actuator A on bank 1 is commanded to engage (high lift or all-cylinder mode) but does not switch. Engine stays in low-lift or deactivated mode under load, causing reduced power.

P2647.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator System Stuck On Bank 1
P2647.ru: Система привода коромысла A — заклинила включённой, банк 1

d.en: On variable valve lift systems (e.g. Honda VTEC) the ECU detects that the bank 1 rocker arm actuator is stuck in the engaged (high lift) position. Idle quality and fuel economy are affected.

P2648.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P2648.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator A control line on bank 1 is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2649.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit High Bank 1
P2649.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator A control line on bank 1 is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P264A.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Bank 1
P264A.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — цепь, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor that confirms the A rocker arm switching state on bank 1 returns no usable signal. Closed-loop control of valve lift cannot verify the state.

P264B.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1
P264B.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor reading does not transition cleanly between the two valve lift modes on bank 1. Sensor drift or mechanical wear leaves the signal between expected values.

P264C.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Low Bank 1
P264C.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Usually a shorted sensor or short to ground in the harness.

P264D.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit High Bank 1
P264D.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Common causes are an open sensor or a short to the 5 V reference.

P264E.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic Bank 1
P264E.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal jumps or drops out intermittently. Usually a loose connector or a chafed wire in the harness.

P264F.en: Engine Serial Number Not Programmed or Incompatible
P264F.ru: Серийный номер двигателя не запрограммирован или несовместим

d.en: The engine controller cannot read a valid engine serial number from its non-volatile memory, or the stored value does not match the expected pattern. Calibration sets keyed to the serial number cannot be applied.

P2650.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit / Open Bank 1
P2650.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 1

d.en: The controller cannot drive the rocker arm switching actuator B on bank 1. The second valve lift mode cannot be commanded.

P2651.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator System Performance/Stuck Off Bank 1
P2651.ru: Система привода коромысла B — характеристика / заклинила выключенной, банк 1

d.en: The rocker arm actuator B on bank 1 is commanded to engage but does not switch. Engine stays in the wrong lift or cylinder mode under load.

P2652.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator System Stuck On Bank 1
P2652.ru: Система привода коромысла B — заклинила включённой, банк 1

d.en: The rocker arm actuator B on bank 1 stays in the activated state when commanded off. Engine cannot return to the alternate lift or cylinder mode.

P2653.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit Low Bank 1
P2653.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator B control line on bank 1 is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2654.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit High Bank 1
P2654.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator B control line on bank 1 is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P2655.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit / Open Bank 2
P2655.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 2

d.en: The controller cannot drive the rocker arm switching actuator A on bank 2. The valve lift mode cannot be switched on this bank.

P2656.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator System Performance/Stuck Off Bank 2
P2656.ru: Система привода коромысла A — характеристика / заклинила выключенной, банк 2

d.en: The rocker arm actuator A on bank 2 is commanded to engage but does not switch. Engine stays in the wrong lift mode under load on this bank.

P2657.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator System Stuck On Bank 2
P2657.ru: Система привода коромысла A — заклинила включённой, банк 2

d.en: The rocker arm actuator A on bank 2 stays in the activated state when commanded off.

P2658.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit Low Bank 2
P2658.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator A control line on bank 2 is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2659.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit High Bank 2
P2659.ru: Привод коромысла A — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator A control line on bank 2 is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P265A.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Bank 1
P265A.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла B — цепь, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor that confirms the B rocker arm switching state on bank 1 returns no usable signal.

P265B.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1
P265B.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла B — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor reading does not transition cleanly between the two valve lift modes for actuator B on bank 1.

P265C.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Low Bank 1
P265C.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла B — низкий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator B on bank 1 is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P265D.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit High Bank 1
P265D.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла B — высокий сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator B on bank 1 is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P265E.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic Bank 1
P265E.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла B — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал, банк 1

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator B on bank 1 jumps or drops out intermittently. Usually a loose connector or a chafed wire.

P265F.en: Variable A/C Compressor Control Circuit Range/Performance
P265F.ru: Компрессор кондиционера с переменной производительностью — цепь управления вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The variable-displacement A/C compressor control valve does not respond to commands within tolerance. Refrigerant flow regulation is degraded so cabin temperature varies or efficiency drops.

P2660.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit / Open Bank 2
P2660.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, обрыв, банк 2

d.en: The controller cannot drive the rocker arm switching actuator B on bank 2.

P2661.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator System Performance/Stuck Off Bank 2
P2661.ru: Система привода коромысла B — характеристика / заклинила выключенной, банк 2

d.en: The rocker arm actuator B on bank 2 is commanded to engage but does not switch.

P2662.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator System Stuck On Bank 2
P2662.ru: Система привода коромысла B — заклинила включённой, банк 2

d.en: The rocker arm actuator B on bank 2 stays in the activated state when commanded off.

P2663.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit Low Bank 2
P2663.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator B control line on bank 2 is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2664.en: B Rocker Arm Actuator Control Circuit High Bank 2
P2664.ru: Привод коромысла B — цепь управления, высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: Voltage on the rocker arm actuator B control line on bank 2 is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P2665.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve B Control Circuit / Open
P2665.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива B, цепь управления — обрыв

d.en: The controller cannot drive the secondary fuel shutoff valve. Engine cannot be commanded off through this path during a safety event.

P2666.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve B Control Circuit Low
P2666.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива B, цепь управления — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary fuel shutoff valve control line is below the expected window. Usually a short to ground or a shorted solenoid coil.

P2667.en: Fuel Shutoff Valve B Control Circuit High
P2667.ru: Отсечной клапан топлива B, цепь управления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the secondary fuel shutoff valve control line is above the expected window. Typical causes are a short to battery or an open solenoid coil.

P2668.en: Fuel Mode Indicator Lamp Control Circuit
P2668.ru: Индикаторная лампа режима топлива — цепь управления

d.en: The fuel mode indicator lamp circuit (showing whether a bi-fuel vehicle currently runs on gasoline or alternative fuel) is faulty. Driver may not know the active fuel.

P2669.en: Actuator Supply Voltage B Circuit / Open
P2669.ru: Напряжение питания привода B — цепь, обрыв

d.en: The second power feed used to supply actuators (relays, solenoids, motor drivers) is open. All loads on this rail are powerless and report follow-on faults.

P266A.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Bank 2
P266A.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — цепь, банк 2

d.en: The position sensor that confirms the A rocker arm switching state on bank 2 returns no usable signal.

P266B.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2
P266B.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — вне диапазона / характеристика, банк 2

d.en: The position sensor reading does not transition cleanly between the two valve lift modes for actuator A on bank 2.

P266C.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Low Bank 2
P266C.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — низкий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator A on bank 2 is below the lower diagnostic threshold. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P266D.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit High Bank 2
P266D.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — высокий сигнал, банк 2

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator A on bank 2 is above the upper diagnostic threshold. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P266E.en: A Rocker Arm Actuator Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic Bank 2
P266E.ru: Датчик положения привода коромысла A — прерывистый/нестабильный сигнал, банк 2

d.en: The position sensor signal for actuator A on bank 2 jumps or drops out intermittently. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P266F.en: A/C Refrigerant Distribution Valve A Control Circuit Driver Current/Temperature Too High
P266F.ru: Распределительный клапан хладагента A — цепь управления, ток/температура драйвера слишком высоки

d.en: The driver stage for the A/C refrigerant distribution valve A is in current limit or over-temperature. Sustained overload from a partially shorted load or excessive switching frequency.

P2670.en: Actuator Supply Voltage B Circuit Low
P2670.ru: Напряжение питания привода B — цепь, низкий сигнал

d.en: The supply voltage to actuator group B (e.g. solenoids, valves driven by ECU) is below the calibrated threshold. The affected actuators may be slow or unable to switch.

P2671.en: Actuator Supply Voltage B Circuit High

P26FC.en: EGR Cooler Bypass Control Stuck Closed Bank 2

d.en: Voltage on the clutch B pressure sensor signal line is below the expected window. Wire shorted to ground or sensor short.

P28DE.en: Clutch B Pressure Sensor Circuit High
P28DE.ru: Сцепление B — датчик давления — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the clutch B pressure sensor signal line is above the expected window. Wire shorted to B+ or sensor open.

P28DF.en: Clutch B Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P28DF.ru: Сцепление B — датчик давления — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The clutch B pressure signal does not match plausibility checks against actuator commands. Sensor drift or installation offset.

P28E0.en: Shift Motor Phase U-V-W Circuit Low
P28E0.ru: Двигатель переключения, фазы U-V-W — низкий сигнал

d.en: The output stage for the shift motor reports a low phase voltage on at least one of the U/V/W phases. Short to ground or interrupted half-bridge.

P28E1.en: Shift Motor Phase U-V-W Circuit High
P28E1.ru: Двигатель переключения, фазы U-V-W — высокий сигнал

d.en: The output stage for the shift motor reports a high phase voltage on at least one of the U/V/W phases. Short to B+ or interrupted load.
The output stage for the shift motor cannot drive current through at least one of the U/V/W phases. Open wire or open winding.
The phase currents of the shift motor do not match the commanded commutation pattern within tolerance. Sensor or driver synchronisation off.

P28E4.en: Shift Motor Driver Current/Temperature Too High
P28E4.ru: Двигатель переключения — ток/температура драйвера слишком высокие

d.en: The output driver for the shift motor reports current or junction temperature above its protection threshold. Sustained high load or short-circuit fault.
The shift motor does not move the gear actuator within the calibrated time window. Mechanical resistance, weakened motor, or supply voltage low.
The shift motor exceeds the calibrated maximum speed. Mechanical load lost or rotor position offset.
The TCM cannot read a valid signal from the shift motor rotor position sensor. Open wiring or sensor failure.

P28E8.en: Shift Motor Position Sensor Circuit High
P28E8.ru: Датчик положения двигателя переключения — высокий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the shift motor position sensor signal line is above the expected window. Wire shorted to B+ or sensor open.

P28E9.en: Shift Motor Position Sensor Circuit Low
P28E9.ru: Датчик положения двигателя переключения — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the shift motor position sensor signal line is below the expected window. Wire shorted to ground or sensor short.

P28EA.en: Shift Motor Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P28EA.ru: Датчик положения двигателя переключения — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The shift motor position signal does not correlate with the commanded commutation. Sensor offset or signal integrity degraded.
The TCM has not learned the end-stop calibration for the shift motor. Gear positions cannot be commanded with full precision until adaptation completes.

P28EC.en: Shift Motor Position Sensor Exceeded Learning Limit
P28EC.ru: Датчик положения двигателя переключения — превышен предел обучения

d.en: The required adaptation offset for the shift motor position sensor exceeds the calibrated learning window. Sensor or mechanism out of nominal range.

P28ED.en: Electric/Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump B Overspeed
P28ED.ru: Электрический/вспомогательный насос масла КПП B — превышение оборотов

d.en: The auxiliary transmission fluid pump B exceeds the calibrated maximum speed for the commanded duty. Mechanical load on the pump unexpectedly low.

P28EE.en: Electric/Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump B Underspeed
P28EE.ru: Электрический/вспомогательный насос масла КПП B — недостаточные обороты

d.en: The auxiliary transmission fluid pump B falls below the calibrated minimum speed for the commanded duty. Mechanical resistance high or supply voltage low.

P28EF.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Actuator Performance/Stuck Off
P28EF.ru: Привод муфты отключения двигателя — характеристика / заклинил выключенным

d.en: The engine disconnect clutch actuator is commanded to engage but does not produce the expected motion. Actuator stuck in disengaged position.

P28F0.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Actuator Stuck On
P28F0.ru: Привод муфты отключения двигателя — заклинил включённым

d.en: The engine disconnect clutch actuator stays in the engaged state when release is commanded. Pure electric driving is not available.

P28F1.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Pressure Sensor Circuit
P28F1.ru: Датчик давления муфты отключения двигателя — цепь

d.en: The hybrid control module detects a generic fault on the engine disconnect clutch pressure sensor circuit. Engagement pressure cannot be monitored reliably.

P28F2.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
P28F2.ru: Датчик давления муфты отключения двигателя, цепь — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The engine disconnect clutch pressure signal does not match plausibility checks against actuator commands. Sensor drift or installation offset.

P28F3.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Pressure Sensor Circuit Low
P28F3.ru: Датчик давления муфты отключения двигателя, цепь — низкий сигнал

d.en: Voltage on the engine disconnect clutch pressure sensor signal line is below the expected window. Wire shorted to ground or sensor short.

P28F5.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Pressure Sensor Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
P28F5.ru: Датчик давления муфты отключения двигателя, цепь — прерывистый / нестабильный сигнал

d.en: The engine disconnect clutch pressure sensor signal drops out or jumps intermittently. Loose connector or noisy ground reference.

P28F6.en: Engine Disconnect Clutch Actuator Circuit Intermittent
P28F6.ru: Привод муфты отключения двигателя, цепь — прерывистый сигнал

d.en: The control circuit of the engine disconnect clutch actuator drops out intermittently. Loose connector or vibration-sensitive wiring.
The exhaust pressure measured on bank 1 exceeds the calibrated maximum. Common causes are clogged DPF, restricted exhaust path, or stuck exhaust brake/back-pressure valve.
The exhaust pressure measured on bank 2 exceeds the calibrated maximum. Common causes are clogged DPF, restricted exhaust path, or stuck exhaust brake/back-pressure valve.
The exhaust pressure measured on bank 1 falls below the calibrated minimum. Common causes are leaks upstream of the sensor, missing DPF substrate, or sensor calibration drift.
The exhaust pressure measured on bank 2 falls below the calibrated minimum. Common causes are leaks upstream of the sensor, missing DPF substrate, or sensor calibration drift.

P2A00.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д1 — вне диапазона / характеристика

P2A01.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1 Sensor 2
P2A01.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д2 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The rear oxygen sensor on bank 1 does not show the expected slow steady-state behaviour after the catalyst. Either the sensor is degraded or the catalyst itself behaves abnormally.

P2A02.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1 Sensor 3
P2A02.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д3 — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The optional third oxygen sensor on bank 1 (typically downstream of a second catalyst) returns implausible values during long-term monitoring.

P2A03.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2 Sensor 1
P2A03.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д1 — вне диапазона / характеристика

P2A04.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д2 — вне диапазона / характеристика

P2A05.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 2 Sensor 3
P2A05.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д3 — вне диапазона / характеристика

P2A06.en: O2 Sensor Circuit Range/Performance Bank 1 Sensor 4
P2A06.ru: Датчик O2 Б1Д4 — вне диапазона / характеристика

P2A07.ru: Датчик O2 Б2Д4 — вне диапазона / характеристика
