P2A08.en: O2 Sensor Negative Voltage Bank 1 Sensor 3

d.en: The ECM detects a negative voltage on the signal line of oxygen sensor 3 on bank 1. This is unusual for narrow-band sensors and often indicates a short to a negative reference, ground offset, or a wide-band sensor wired incorrectly.

P2A09.en: O2 Sensor Negative Voltage Bank 2 Sensor 1

d.en: The ECM detects a negative voltage on the signal line of oxygen sensor 1 on bank 2. This is unusual for narrow-band sensors and often indicates a short to a negative reference, ground offset, or a wide-band sensor wired incorrectly.

P2A0A.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor B Circuit

P2A0B.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor B Circuit Range/Performance
P2A0B.ru: Датчик MAP B — вне диапазона / характеристика

d.en: The MAP B signal does not correlate with TPS, MAF, or RPM as expected. Vacuum leak, restricted port, or sensor drift.

P2A0C.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor B Circuit Low

d.en: Voltage on the MAP B signal line is below the expected window. Wire shorted to ground or sensor short.

P2A0D.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor B Circuit High

d.en: Voltage on the MAP B signal line is above the expected window. Wire shorted to B+ or sensor open. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.

P2A0E.en: Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor B Circuit Intermittent/Erratic

d.en: The MAP B signal drops out or jumps intermittently. Loose connector or noisy ground reference. Wiring faults of this kind typically come from chafing, water ingress at connector seals, or pin push-back — a wiggle test on the harness while the code is active often confirms the location.
The fuel supply heater does not raise fuel temperature within the calibrated time window. Common in diesel and biofuel installations to prevent paraffin or fat crystallisation in cold weather.

P2A10.en: O2 Sensor Negative Voltage Bank 2 Sensor 2

d.en: The ECM detects a negative voltage on the signal line of oxygen sensor 2 on bank 2. This is unusual for narrow-band sensors and often indicates a short to a negative reference, ground offset, or a wide-band sensor wired incorrectly.

P2A11.en: O2 Sensor Negative Voltage Bank 2 Sensor 3

P3467.en: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 1 Performance

P3470.en: Cylinder Deactivation Hydraulic Circuit Bank 2 Open

A general fault on the high-speed CAN bus has been detected. This bus typically connects powertrain modules (ECM, TCM, ABS) at 500 kbit/s and a fault disables communication between them, often triggering multiple secondary DTCs in other modules.

U0002.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus Performance

d.en: The high-speed CAN bus is functional but performance is degraded — frame errors, bit errors or excessive bus load have been detected. Communication may be intermittent rather than completely lost, leading to sporadic warning lamps.

U0003.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (+) Open

d.en: The CAN-High line of the high-speed bus is open. Without the differential pair, the controller cannot decode any traffic and reports loss of all participating modules at once. Often follows a wiring repair, accident damage, or a corroded connector pin.

U0004.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (+) Low

d.en: The CAN-High signal stays below its valid voltage window. Common cause is a short to ground on the CAN-H wire or a transceiver that pulls the line down. The bus stops working until the offending node is isolated.

U0005.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (+) High

d.en: The CAN-High line is held above its valid voltage range, usually because of a short to battery voltage. Bus communication collapses for every connected module.

U0006.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (-) Open

d.en: The CAN-Low wire of the high-speed bus is open. The differential signal can no longer be evaluated correctly, so all bus participants report communication loss simultaneously.

U0007.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (-) Low

d.en: The CAN-Low line is shorted to ground or held below its valid recessive level. The differential pair cannot transmit data and the bus is effectively dead.

U0008.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (-) High

d.en: The CAN-Low signal is held above its valid range, typically because of a short to battery voltage on the CAN-L wire. Bus communication is lost for every node sharing this segment.

U0009.en: High Speed CAN Communication Bus (-) Shorted to Bus (+)
U0009.ru: Скоростная шина CAN (-) — замыкание на шину (+)

d.en: CAN-High and CAN-Low are shorted together. The differential signal collapses to zero and the bus controller can no longer separate dominant from recessive bits, so all communication stops.

A fault on the medium-speed CAN bus has been detected. This bus (typically 125 kbit/s) connects body and comfort modules — BCM, climate, doors, infotainment. A failure usually disables comfort functions but leaves the powertrain operational.

U0011.en: Medium Speed CAN Communication Bus Performance

d.en: The medium-speed CAN bus is operating but with degraded performance — frame errors or excessive error counters. Comfort and infotainment functions may operate intermittently.

U0012.en: Medium Speed CAN Communication Bus (-) Open

The ECM/PCM "A" has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. As this is the engine controller itself, the engine usually will not start or run while the message is missing. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

The ECU has stopped receiving messages from the transmission control module. The transmission falls into limp-home mode (typically locked in 3rd or 4th gear), the speedometer may stop working, and shift adaptation freezes.

U0102.en: Lost Communication with Transfer Case Control Module
U0102.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления раздаточной коробкой

d.en: The Transfer Case Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Four-wheel-drive range selection and torque distribution become unavailable. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0103.en: Lost Communication with Gear Shift Module
U0103.ru: Нет связи с модулем переключения передач

d.en: The Gear Shift Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Shift-by-wire gear selection can fail and leave the transmission in a default position. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0104.en: Lost Communication with Cruise Control Module

d.en: The Cruise Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Cruise control and speed-hold functions stop working. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0105.en: Lost Communication with Fuel Injector Control Module
U0105.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления форсунками

d.en: The Fuel Injector Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Injection-timing data is lost, which can stall the engine or prevent a start. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0106.en: Lost Communication with Glow Plug Control Module
U0106.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления свечами накаливания

d.en: The Glow Plug Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Cold-start pre-heating is no longer coordinated, causing hard diesel starts. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0107.en: Lost Communication with Throttle Actuator Control Module
U0107.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления приводом дросселя

d.en: The Throttle Actuator Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Electronic throttle control can drop to limp mode with sharply reduced power. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U0108.en: Lost Communication With Alternative Fuel Control Module
U0108.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления альтернативным топливом

d.en: The ECU has lost CAN communication with the alternative fuel control module (CNG/LPG/H2 systems). Either the module is not responding or the bus path is broken.

U0109.en: Lost Communication with Fuel Pump Control Module
U0109.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления топливным насосом

d.en: The Fuel Pump Control Module has stopped transmitting on the vehicle data bus, so other control units no longer receive its messages. Fuel-delivery control is lost, which can starve the engine of fuel. Typical causes are loss of power or ground at the module, an open or shorted CAN/LIN bus wire, a connector fault, or an internal module failure.

U010A.en: Lost Communication With Exhaust Gas Recirculation Control Module A
U010A.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления EGR A

d.en: ECU has lost CAN communication with the EGR control module A. A communication loss with this module breaks any function relying on its data — diagnostic tools may show 'no response' and dependent modules can fall into limp mode.

U010B.en: Lost Communication With Exhaust Gas Recirculation Control Module B
U010B.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления EGR B

d.en: ECU has lost CAN communication with the EGR control module B. A communication loss with this module breaks any function relying on its data — diagnostic tools may show 'no response' and dependent modules can fall into limp mode.

U010C.ru: Нет связи с блоком управления турбиной/нагнетателем A

A controller flags that the data received over the bus is implausible without identifying a specific source. Used as a generic placeholder when the more specific U04xx codes do not apply.

The ECM/PCM is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Implausible engine data can force limp mode or stall the engine. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.
A control module is communicating with the transmission control module but receives implausible data — wrong checksum, frozen value, or out-of-range value. Often results in transmission limp-home.

d.en: The Cruise Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Cruise control is disabled. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0406.en: Invalid Data Received from Cruise Control Front Distance Range Sensor
U0406.ru: Неверные данные от датчика дистанции круиз-контроля спереди

d.en: ACC receives bus messages from the radar but their content is implausible (e.g. negative distances, jittering targets). Adaptive cruise is disabled until the radar reports plausible data again.

U0407.en: Invalid Data Received from Steering Angle Sensor Module
U0407.ru: Неверные данные от модуля датчика угла поворота руля

d.en: ESP receives steering angle data that does not match yaw or wheel speeds. ESP and lane-keeping are deactivated until the steering angle sensor is recalibrated.

U0408.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Immobilizer Control Module

d.en: The ECU receives an authorisation message from the immobilizer that does not match the expected rolling code. Engine start is blocked.

U0409.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Security Control Module
U0409.ru: Неверные данные от блока охранной системы

d.en: The vehicle security / alarm controller is sending implausible status data (e.g. armed/unarmed jitter). Alarm and immobilizer behaviour can become unpredictable.

U040A.en: Invalid Data Received From Air Conditioning Control Module
U040A.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кондиционером

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the A/C control module. Compressor enable, blower or refrigerant pressure values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U040B.en: Invalid Data Received From Exhaust Gas Recirculation Control Module A
U040B.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления EGR A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from EGR control module A. Valve position, flow or temperature values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U040C.en: Invalid Data Received From Exhaust Gas Recirculation Control Module B
U040C.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления EGR B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from EGR control module B. Valve position, flow or temperature values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U040D.en: Invalid Data Received From Turbocharger/Supercharger Control Module A
U040D.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления турбиной/нагнетателем A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from boost control module A. Wastegate/VTG position or boost pressure values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U040E.en: Invalid Data Received From Turbocharger/Supercharger Control Module B
U040E.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления турбиной/нагнетателем B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from boost control module B. Wastegate/VTG position or boost pressure values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U040F.en: Invalid Data Received From Reductant Control Module
U040F.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления реагентом

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the reductant control module. Dosing rate, tank level or pressure values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U0410.en: Invalid Data Received from Parking Brake Control Module
U0410.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления стояночным тормозом

d.en: The vehicle network receives EPB data that contradicts other inputs (e.g. brake reported applied while moving). Auto-Hold is disabled and EPB warnings are shown.

U0411.en: Invalid Data Received from Wheel Speed Sensor (Front, Driver Side)
U0411.ru: Неверные данные от датчика скорости колеса (переднего, со стороны водителя)

d.en: ABS reports invalid front-driver wheel speed data. ABS, ESP and traction control are deactivated; the speedometer can be inaccurate.

U0412.en: Invalid Data Received from Wheel Speed Sensor (Front, Passenger Side)
U0412.ru: Неверные данные от датчика скорости колеса (переднего, со стороны пассажира)

d.en: ABS receives invalid front-passenger wheel speed data. ABS/ESP are deactivated until the signal becomes plausible again.

U0413.en: Invalid Data Received from Wheel Speed Sensor (Rear, Driver Side)
U0413.ru: Неверные данные от датчика скорости колеса (заднего, со стороны водителя)

d.en: ABS receives implausible rear-driver wheel speed data. ESP and traction control are deactivated. Wheel-speed signals feed ABS, ESC, traction control, transmission and odometer — a single dropped signal disables all of these safety functions until repaired.

U0414.en: Invalid Data Received from 4WD Clutch Control Module
U0414.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления муфтой полного привода

d.en: The 4WD Clutch Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. All-wheel-drive engagement becomes unreliable. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0415.en: Invalid Data Received from ABS Control Module
U0415.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления ABS

d.en: A control module is communicating with the ABS module but receives implausible data — wrong wheel speeds, checksum errors or out-of-range values. ESP/ESC and traction control deactivate and adaptive cruise control becomes unavailable.

U0416.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Dynamics Control Module
U0416.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления динамикой ТС

d.en: The Vehicle Dynamics Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Stability control (ESP) is disabled. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0417.en: Invalid Data Received from Park Assist Control Module
U0417.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления парктроником

d.en: The park assist controller is sending implausible distance or steering data. Park Assist functions are disabled.

U0418.en: Invalid Data Received from Brake System Control Module
U0418.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления тормозной системой

d.en: The Brake System Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. ABS and ESP functions are limited. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0419.en: Invalid Data Received from Brake System Control Module
U0419.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления тормозной системой

d.en: The Brake System Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. The redundant brake controller's data is rejected and the brake assists are limited. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U041A.en: Invalid Data Received From Battery Isolation/Voltage Stabilization Control Module
U041A.ru: Неверные данные от блока изоляции и стабилизации напряжения батареи

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the battery isolation / voltage stabilization module (typical in start/stop systems). Switching state or stabilizer voltage values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U041B.en: Invalid Data Received From Exhaust Gas Sensor Module A
U041B.ru: Неверные данные от модуля датчика ОГ A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from exhaust gas sensor module A (smart wide-range O2 / lambda module). Lambda or pumping current values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U041C.en: Invalid Data Received From Rocker Arm Control Module A
U041C.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления коромыслами A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from rocker arm actuator module A (variable valve lift / cylinder deactivation). Position or pressure feedback fails plausibility checks and is rejected.

U041D.en: Invalid Data Received From Rocker Arm Control Module B
U041D.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления коромыслами B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from rocker arm actuator module B (variable valve lift / cylinder deactivation). Position or pressure feedback fails plausibility checks and is rejected.

U041E.en: Invalid Data Received From All Wheel Drive Control Module
U041E.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления полным приводом

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the AWD control module. Torque distribution or clutch position values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U041F.en: Invalid Data Received From Throttle Actuator B Control Module
U041F.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления приводом дросселя B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from throttle actuator B control module. Position commanded vs. actual or motor current values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0420.en: Invalid Data Received from Power Steering Control Module
U0420.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления усилителем руля

d.en: The Power Steering Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Power-steering assist may be reduced or disabled. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0421.en: Invalid Data Received from Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor
U0421.ru: Неверные данные от датчика положения дросселя/педали

d.en: The ECU receives implausible accelerator pedal or throttle data over the bus. The engine drops to limp-mode with reduced power.

U0422.en: Invalid Data Received from Body Control Module
U0422.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM)

d.en: The Body Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Body functions such as lighting or central locking may misbehave. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0423.en: Invalid Data Received from Information Center

d.en: The Information Center is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Driver-display content may be wrong or missing. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0424.en: Invalid Data Received from HVAC Control Module
U0424.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления климатом (HVAC)

d.en: The HVAC Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Automatic climate control behaves erratically. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0425.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Immobilizer Control Module

d.en: The ECU receives an authorisation message from the immobilizer that is corrupted or out of range. Engine start is blocked.

U0426.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Immobiliser Control Module

d.en: The Vehicle Immobiliser Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Start authorisation may fail. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0427.en: Invalid Data Received from Vehicle Security Control Module
U0427.ru: Неверные данные от блока охранной системы

d.en: The vehicle security controller delivers data that does not pass plausibility checks. Alarm system or remote unlocking can behave erratically.

U0428.en: Invalid Data Received from Steering Angle Sensor Module
U0428.ru: Неверные данные от модуля датчика угла поворота руля

d.en: The Steering Angle Sensor Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Stability control loses a trustworthy steering-angle value and usually disables ESC. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0429.en: Invalid Data Received from Steering Wheel Angle Sensor
U0429.ru: Неверные данные от датчика угла поворота руля

d.en: The Steering Wheel Angle Sensor is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Stability control loses a trustworthy steering-angle value. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U042A.en: Invalid Data Received From V2X Module

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the V2X (vehicle-to-everything) communication module. Position, V2V/V2I message content or signal-quality flags fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U042B.en: Invalid Data Received From Chassis Control Module A
U042B.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления шасси A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from chassis control module A. Vehicle dynamics, ride-height or damper command values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U042C.en: Invalid Data Received From Chassis Control Module B
U042C.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления шасси B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from chassis control module B. Vehicle dynamics, ride-height or damper command values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U042D.en: Invalid Data Received From Active Vibration Control Module
U042D.ru: Неверные данные от блока активного гашения вибраций

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the active vibration control module (active engine mounts / electric counter-vibration). Command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U042E.en: Invalid Data Received From Generator A Control Module
U042E.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления генератором A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from generator (alternator) control module A. Field excitation, output current or voltage values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U042F.en: Invalid Data Received From Camshaft Position Control Module
U042F.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления положением распредвала

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the camshaft position actuator module. Phase angle command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0430.en: Invalid Data Received from Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor
U0430.ru: Неверные данные от датчика давления в шинах

d.en: The Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Tire-pressure readings become unreliable. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0431.en: Invalid Data Received from Body Control Module
U0431.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM)

d.en: Other modules receive implausible body status data (e.g. all doors reported closed while ajar). Comfort and lighting features can behave inconsistently.

U0432.en: Invalid Data Received from 4-Wheel Drive Clutch Control Module
U0432.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления муфтой полного привода

d.en: The 4WD coupling controller delivers implausible torque or temperature data. AWD operation is degraded; on many vehicles the driveline warning lamp illuminates.

U0433.en: Invalid Data Received From Front Distance Range Sensor — Single Sensor or Center
U0433.ru: Неверные данные от датчика расстояния спереди, одиночный или центральный

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the front distance range sensor (single or center-mounted long-range radar/lidar). Distance/closing-speed values fail plausibility checks and are rejected by ACC/AEB.

U0434.en: Invalid Data Received From Active Roll Control Module
U0434.ru: Неверные данные от блока активной стабилизации крена

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the active roll control module (active anti-roll bars). Hydraulic/electric actuator command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0435.en: Invalid Data Received From Power Steering Control Module — Rear
U0435.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления усилителем руля, сзади

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the rear power steering control module (rear-wheel steering). Steer angle command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0436.en: Invalid Data Received From Differential Control Module — Front
U0436.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления дифференциалом, спереди

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the front differential control module (electronic LSD or torque vectoring). Clutch/torque command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0437.en: Invalid Data Received From Differential Control Module — Rear
U0437.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления дифференциалом, сзади

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the rear differential control module (electronic LSD or torque vectoring). Clutch/torque command vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0438.en: Invalid Data Received from Park Brake Control Module
U0438.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления стояночным тормозом

d.en: The Park Brake Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Electronic parking-brake operation may be limited. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0439.en: Invalid Data Received From All Terrain Control Module
U0439.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления режимами бездорожья

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the all-terrain (drive mode) control module. Selected mode, throttle map or stability target values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U043A.en: Invalid Data Received From Suspension Control Module B
U043A.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления подвеской B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from suspension control module B. Damper command, ride-height or air-pressure values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U043B.en: Invalid Data Received From Front Distance Range Sensor — Left
U043B.ru: Неверные данные от датчика расстояния спереди, слева

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the front-left distance range sensor (corner radar). Distance/azimuth values fail plausibility checks and are rejected by ADAS functions.

U043C.en: Invalid Data Received From Front Distance Range Sensor — Right
U043C.ru: Неверные данные от датчика расстояния спереди, справа

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the front-right distance range sensor (corner radar). Distance/azimuth values fail plausibility checks and are rejected by ADAS functions.

U043D.en: Invalid Data Received From Accelerator Pedal Module
U043D.ru: Неверные данные от модуля педали газа

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the accelerator pedal module. Pedal position channels A and B disagree or fall outside calibration limits, and the engine reverts to a fail-safe pedal map.

U043E.en: Invalid Data Received From Vacuum Sensor A
U043E.ru: Неверные данные от датчика разрежения A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from vacuum sensor A (typically brake booster vacuum). Pressure values fail plausibility checks against engine load and are rejected.

U043F.en: Invalid Data Received From Vacuum Sensor B
U043F.ru: Неверные данные от датчика разрежения B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from vacuum sensor B (typically brake booster vacuum). Pressure values fail plausibility checks against engine load and are rejected.

U0440.en: Invalid Data Received from Drive Motor Control Module
U0440.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления тяговым электродвигателем

d.en: The Drive Motor Control Module is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. The receiving modules reject the data. Electric-drive torque control becomes unreliable. Causes include a faulty sensor feeding the module, internal computation errors, a software or calibration mismatch after a repair, or bus interference corrupting the frames.

U0441.en: Invalid Data Received From Emissions Critical Control Information
U0441.ru: Неверные критичные для выбросов данные управления

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data tagged as emissions-critical (CARB OBD requirement). The receiver discards the message and may set the MIL because emissions monitors cannot run.

U0442.en: Invalid Data Received From ECM/PCM B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the second engine/powertrain control module (ECM/PCM B — used on V-engines with one ECU per bank or master/slave architectures). Engine torque, RPM or load values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0443.en: Invalid Data Received From Body Control Module B
U0443.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM) B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from body control module B. BCM-relayed signals (door/lock/lighting state, ignition, theft) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0444.en: Invalid Data Received From Body Control Module C
U0444.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM) C

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from body control module C. BCM-relayed signals (door/lock/lighting state, ignition, theft) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0445.en: Invalid Data Received From Body Control Module D
U0445.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM) D

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from body control module D. BCM-relayed signals (door/lock/lighting state, ignition, theft) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0446.en: Invalid Data Received From Body Control Module E
U0446.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления кузовом (BCM) E

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from body control module E. BCM-relayed signals (door/lock/lighting state, ignition, theft) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0447.en: Invalid Data Received from Gateway A

d.en: A subscriber module reports that the central gateway is forwarding implausible or malformed messages. Multiple modules can show seemingly unrelated faults until the gateway is repaired or reflashed.

U0448.en: Invalid Data Received from Gateway B

d.en: A second gateway component (or sub-gateway) is forwarding implausible data. Cross-segment functions misbehave until the affected gateway is reset or reflashed.

U0449.en: Invalid Data Received From Serial Data Gateway Module C
U0449.ru: Неверные данные от шлюза последовательных данных C

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from serial data gateway C. Bridged messages between sub-buses (CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U044A.en: Invalid Data Received From Serial Data Gateway Module D
U044A.ru: Неверные данные от шлюза последовательных данных D

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from serial data gateway D. Bridged messages between sub-buses (CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U044B.en: Invalid Data Received From Battery Energy Control Module C
U044B.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления энергией батареи C

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from battery energy control module C. SoC, SoH, current or voltage values fail plausibility checks against other inputs and are rejected.

U044C.en: Invalid Data Received From Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charging Module
U044C.ru: Неверные данные от модуля индуктивной зарядки высоковольтной батареи

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the inductive (wireless) HV battery charging module. Coil power, alignment or temperature values fail plausibility checks and are rejected, halting the wireless charge session.

U044D.en: Invalid Data Received From Generator B Control Module
U044D.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления генератором B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from generator (alternator) control module B. Field excitation, output current or voltage values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U044F.en: Invalid Data Received From Mirror Control Module B
U044F.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления зеркалами B

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from mirror control module B. Mirror position, fold/unfold state or heating values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0451.en: Invalid Data Received From Serial Data Gateway Module E
U0451.ru: Неверные данные от шлюза последовательных данных E

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from serial data gateway E. Bridged messages between sub-buses (CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet) fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0452.en: Invalid Data Received From Restraints Control Module
U0452.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления SRS

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the restraints control module (airbag/SRS). Crash sensor or seat-belt status data fails plausibility checks and is rejected; airbag deployment thresholds may revert to a default map.

U0453.en: Invalid Data Received From Side Restraints Control Module — Left
U0453.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления боковыми SRS, слева

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the left side restraints control module (side airbag/curtain controller). Side-impact sensor data fails plausibility checks and is rejected.

U0454.en: Invalid Data Received From Side Restraints Control Module — Right
U0454.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления боковыми SRS, справа

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the right side restraints control module (side airbag/curtain controller). Side-impact sensor data fails plausibility checks and is rejected.

U0455.en: Invalid Data Received From Restraints Occupant Classification System Module
U0455.ru: Неверные данные от модуля классификации пассажиров SRS

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the restraints occupant classification system (OCS) module. Seat-weight or pressure-mat values fail plausibility checks; passenger airbag enable/disable may default to enabled with the warning lamp on.

U0456.en: Invalid Data Received From Coolant Temperature Control Module
U0456.ru: Неверные данные от блока управления температурой ОЖ

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the coolant temperature (electric thermostat) control module. Temperature setpoint vs. actual values fail plausibility checks and are rejected.

U0457.en: Invalid Data Received From Information Center A
U0457.ru: Неверные данные от центра информации A

d.en: A receiving module detected implausible data from the driver information center A (instrument cluster information area). Display state or warning indicator data fails plausibility checks and is rejected.

A control module reports that its non-volatile memory has been reset (lost adaptions, lost coding, lost trip counters). Often appears after battery disconnects, voltage drops below operating limit, or module reflashes.
